projects.title: Smart Sadu Robot
projects.desc:
Smart Sadu Robot  is an innovative project that combines robotics and artificial intelligence to preserve the Saudi heritage of Sadu weaving. The project includes a smart robot and an AI-powered website that tracks and analyzes hand movements while learning Sadu techniques.
The system provides guidance and feedback to help users learn the correct movements and improve their skills. It also aims to preserve the knowledge and experience of traditional Sadu artisans by

projects.title: ?Why Am I Scrolling
projects.desc: Teenagers often open social media without consciously deciding to—when bored, waiting, stressed, or before sleep. “Why Am I Scrolling? – لماذا فتحت جوالي؟” shifts the focus from screen time to intention. Instead of blocking apps, it creates a brief moment of reflection before opening: “Why did you open this app?” The goal is simple: turn automatic scrolling into a conscious choice—without restriction, judgment, or guilt.

projects.title: لايسنشيلد هو نظام لحماية المنتجات الرقمية من التسريب والنسخ غير…
projects.desc: لايسنشيلد هو نظام لحماية المنتجات الرقمية من التسريب والنسخ غير المصرح به والتلاعب بالملفات حيث يجمع بين تشفير المنتجات وإدارة الرخص وربط الرخصة بالجهاز والتحقق من صلاحيتها عن طريق سيرفر مركزي كما يسجل محاولات التشغيل ويرصد المحاولات المشبوهة ويتيح للمطور إيقاف الرخصة في أي وقت ويتميز النظام بأنه لا يعتمد على لغة برمجية واحدة ويمكن دمجه مع أنواع مختلفة من المنتجات الرقمية مما يساعد المطورين على حماية منتجاتهم والتحكم في طريقة استخدامها وتوزيعها وتقليل خسائرهم الناتجة عن التسريب وإعادة التوزيع بس

projects.title: Nanofunctionalized Linen Textile Using TiO₂ and AgNPs (ظلال)
projects.desc: نطوّر نسيجًا وظيفيًا من الكتان باستخدام ثاني أكسيد التيتانيوم (TiO₂) وجسيمات الفضة النانوية (AgNPs) بهدف تعزيز الحماية من الأشعة فوق البنفسجية ودراسة الاستجابة الحرارية لسطح القماش. يعتمد المشروع على مقارنة القماش غير المعالج بالمعالجات الفردية والمشتركة، مع قياس UPF ودرجة حرارة السطح وتحليل العلاقة بينهما. ويطمح الحل إلى تقديم أساس علمي لتطوير منسوجات أكثر ملاءمة للبيئات المشمسة والاستخدامات المستقبلية.

projects.title: Smart Weather Alert System
projects.desc:
منبّه المطر وعواصف الرمل الذكي
جهاز ذكي يراقب حالة الجو باستخدام مستشعرات للمطر والغبار. إذا اكتشف نزول المطر أو ارتفاع مستوى الغبار، يعطي تنبيهًا على شاشة ويصدر صوت إنذار، بحيث يساعد على معرفة تغيّر حالة الطقس بسرعه ؟

1. مستشعر المطر يراقب وجود قطرات الماء.
2. مستشعر الغبار يقيس مستوى الجسيمات الموجودة في الهواء.
3. الـArduino يستقبل القراءات ويحللها.
4. تظهر النتيجة على الشاشة، مثل:
    * ☀️ Normal
    * 🌧️ Rain Detected
    * 🌪️ High Dust
5. عند اكتشاف المطر أو ارتفاع الغبار، يعمل الـBuzze

projects.title: Smart Bio-Composite Against Fusarium Wilt in Date Palms
projects.desc: Smart Bio-Composite Against Fusarium Wilt in Date Palms Date palms in Al-Ahsa face vascular wilt caused by Fusarium proliferatum and F. solani. CELL is a fully biodegradable local biocomposite made from shrimp-shell chitosan, beneficial Bacillus from the palm rhizosphere, and palm-waste nanocellulose. It targets the root zone, controls moisture and bacterial release, and achieved 72.4% and 69.2% fungal inhibition, 64% lower disease severity, and improved root biomass and chlorophyll.

projects.title: Visible-Light Non-Oxidative Methane Coupling using Pd–Bi-Loaded CQD-Sensitized Ga₂O₃
projects.desc: This project develops a visible-light photocatalyst for converting methane into valuable chemical products without using oxygen or producing carbon dioxide as a primary oxidant. The system combines palladium–bismuth active sites, carbon quantum dots, and gallium oxide to improve light absorption, charge separation, and methane activation. This approach could enable cleaner methane utilization while reducing greenhouse-gas emissions and dependence on fossil-based chemical production.

projects.title: The Smart Air Defense Ghost Drone
projects.desc:
An innovative air defense system that combines smart sensors and AI to detect, analyze, and track threats.
By bringing these technologies together in one system, the project improves response speed and support defense decisions. A 3D model presents the full concept, turning a complex idea into an understandable vision for national security.

projects.title: Intelligent Cable Monitoring and Prediction of Remaining Time to Critical Condition
projects.desc:
على الرغم من تطور تقنيات حماية كابلات الإنترنت البحرية، لا تزال الكابلات معرضة لمخاطر متعددة مثل حركة السفن والعوامل البيئية والأنشطة البحرية، مما يجعل اكتشاف المخاطر والتدخل لحماية الكابلات تحديًا مستمرًا. فهل يمكن أن يكون التدخل أكثر ذكاءً واستباقية؟

اقترحت جهازًا ذكيًا يعتمد على الذكاء الاصطناعي وكاميرا ذكية لمراقبة البيئة المحيطة بالكابلات البحرية، وتحليل سلوك السفن والأجسام والأحياء البحرية، والتنبؤ بالمخاطر المحتملة قبل حدوثها، مع التعلم المستمر واكتشاف وتوثيق الأحياء البحرية. وبذلك تتحول

projects.title: أمان ذكي
projects.desc:
My Innovation Goal:

“My innovation aims to organize worker data, reduce cases of absconding, and protect the rights of both employers and workers, while using tracking only when there is an official report.”

Preventive Alert Feature:

“The alert feature before the expiration of a worker’s documents or permits is an important part of the innovation. It adds a preventive aspect to the project, rather than only searching for a worker after they have absconded.”

projects.title: Smart Speed Bumps for Individual Safety and Traffic Congestion Reduction
projects.desc: A smart speed bump that rises and lowers automatically on a programmed schedule, designed for locations with short peak periods such as mosques and schools. It protects people during peak hours and reduces congestion the rest of the day. It is IP67-rated against dust and water, powered by energy generated from vehicle wheel pressure with solar backup, and offers manual control or an emergency alarm. It supports Vision 2030, smart cities, smoother traffic flow, and fewer injuries.

projects.title: Fiber Plus: Functional Gluten-Free Date Byproduct Noodles
projects.desc: Fiber Plus is a sustainable food innovation that upcycles date industry byproducts (date press cake and date pit powder) into high-fiber, gluten-free instant noodles. Free from MSG and refined palm oil, the product delivers ≥ 8.5 g/100 g of dietary fiber and 4x higher antioxidants with a 78% sensory acceptance rate. Fully compliant with GSO 1871:2022 standards, Fiber Plus supports public health and Saudi Vision 2030.

projects.title: ShamsGuard: The Intelligent Saudi Building Shield
projects.desc: ShamsGuard is an AI-assisted adaptive building façade designed for Saudi Arabia’s extreme heat. Small movable panels respond to sunlight and temperature sensors to reduce solar heat entering buildings. A miniature prototype will compare a conventional room with a ShamsGuard room, measuring indoor temperature and energy use. The project aims to improve comfort, reduce air-conditioning demand, and support smarter, more energy-efficient buildings.

projects.title: OptiHealth is a smart, non-invasive clip device designed to measure…
projects.desc: OptiHealth is a smart, non-invasive clip device designed to measure and analyze blood hemoglobin levels without pain or needle pricks. Utilizing scanning and artificial intelligence technologies, the device automatically adapts to varying skin thicknesses across different age groups; it then wirelessly transmits readings to a mobile app that provides instant analysis, personalized dietary plans, and precise family health tracking. This project represents a cost-effective, homegrown solution that

projects.title: This project presents smart shoes that help visually impaired…
projects.desc: This project presents smart shoes that help visually impaired individuals navigate indoor environments safely and independently. The system combines Wi-Fi RSSI positioning, a compass, voice guidance, and kinetic energy harvesting. Tests achieved an average positioning error below 2.6 m, 95% navigation success, and a 1.5-second voice response time. Energy harvesting generated approximately 1.8 mW during walking, supporting the device’s operation.

projects.title: 🛡️ | Smart Guardian
projects.desc:
Smart Guardian 
What if security became smarter, faster, and more proactive? Smart Guardian is an AI-powered robotic security system that continuously monitors facilities, detects unusual patterns and situations requiring attention, and sends instant alerts to the relevant authorities. 🚨 It transforms traditional security monitoring into proactive protection while supporting security personnel in large and hard-to-monitor areas. 🤖 Designed for government facilities, hospitals,،،

projects.title: Hydrogen production catalyst by smr
projects.desc: We developed a low-cost Ni-Co/CeO₂ catalyst for hydrogen production via steam methane reforming (SMR), alloying nickel with cobalt on a ceria support. Costly SMR catalysts deactivate at high temperatures through coking and sintering. Prepared by thermal precipitation and tested against Ni/CeO₂ and Co/CeO₂, it combined Ni's activity with Co's stability. Over 24 hours it averaged 50% H₂ yield, 11% CO yield and an H₂/CO ratio of 11, resisting coking without precious metals for scalable H₂ output.

projects.title: اللاصقة الذكية لمراقبة الجفاف ابتكار تقني يهدف إلى توفير وسيلة سهلة…
projects.desc: اللاصقة الذكية لمراقبة الجفاف ابتكار تقني يهدف إلى توفير وسيلة سهلة ومستمرة لمتابعة مؤشرات مرتبطة بترطيب الجسم، خاصة أثناء ممارسة الرياضة أو التعرض للأجواء الحارة. تعتمد اللاصقة على مستشعرات صغيرة تراقب مؤشرات مثل الرطوبة ودرجة الحرارة وخصائص العرق، ثم ترسل البيانات إلى تطبيق ذكي لتحليلها وعرضها بطريقة مبسطة. وعند ظهور مؤشرات تستدعي الانتباه، يمكن للنظام إصدار تنبيه للمستخدم. تتميز اللاصقة بصغر حجمها وخفة وزنها وسهولة ارتدائها، مع إمكانية تطويرها مستقبلًا لتصبح أكثر دقة وارتباطًا بالذكاء الاصطنا

projects.title: SeaScan Pro
projects.desc: SeaScan Pro روبوت برمائي مقترح يعمل بالطاقة الشمسية النظيفة لإنقاذ الشواطئ وحماية البيئة. يكتشف الغرق بالذكاء الاصطناعي، يطلق كرات إنقاذ تنتفخ عند ملامسة الماء، وينبه المنقذين. يتميز بـ مختبر صغير منفصل مزود بنظام تتبع GPS لتحليل نسب الكربون، التلوث، والميكروبلاستيك بدقة. حل مستدام لمستقبل شواطئ آمنة.

projects.title: SAHMX: Provable Digital Truth Infrastructure for Cybersecurity
projects.desc: SAHMX is a cybersecurity platform built around Provable Digital Truth Continuity. Instead of automatically trusting security logs, it verifies whether digital evidence is complete, causally consistent, and trustworthy. It detects evidence gaps, builds Digital Truth States, identifies the Last Provably Trusted State, supports forensic reconstruction, evidence-based recovery, and continuous security verification.

projects.title: Nano Alumina-Based Insulating Coating for Thermal Protection During Hajj
projects.desc: Saudi Arabia experiences extreme temperatures and intense solar radiation, especially during the Hajj season, increasing the risk of heat stress among pilgrims. This project develops a Nano Alumina-Based Insulating Coating using aluminum oxide nanoparticles (Al₂O₃ NPs) to reduce heat absorption and improve thermal protection. The coating is designed for fabrics, umbrellas, and temporary structures, providing a lightweight, sustainable, and passive cooling solution suitable for hot climate enviro

projects.title: Hoops Without Limits: AI & Assistive Technology
projects.desc:
🏀 AI-Powered Basketball: Play Without Limits. Play Fair.

What if technology could make basketball more inclusive—and more fair?

Our project brings together Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Smart Wearable Technology to solve two important challenges in basketball: accessibility and fair play.

🤖 1. Assistive Robotic Hand — Play Without Limits

For someone without a hand or fingers, playing basketball can seem impossible.

Our Assistive Robotic Hand Prototype is designed to change that.

projects.title: BadL For Students
projects.desc: BadL for Students turns student skills into real value. Supervised students, alone or in teams, deliver services such as design, photography, video and data analysis to small businesses. In return, they earn verified experience and BadL Credits they can spend at any business in the network. Businesses settle in kind with their own products instead of cash. Generative AI turns informal requests into clear services, and smart matching finds the right student or team.

projects.title: الدرع الذكي للمنشآت لاستجابة طوارئ
projects.desc: NEXUS SHIELD هو نظام ذكي للاستجابة للطوارئ داخل المنشآت الحيوية، يجمع بين إنترنت الأشياء والتوأم الرقمي وتحليل البيانات وتتبع الأشخاص ومحرك ذكي لاتخاذ قرار الإخلاء. يحدد النظام موقع الخطر، يحلل حالة المخارج والمسارات والمناطق الآمنة، يستبعد المسارات المتأثرة بالخطر، ويقترح مسارًا مناسبًا إلى نقطة التجمع مع متابعة حالة الإخلاء. يهدف المشروع إلى تحويل الاستجابة للطوارئ من إنذار فقط إلى منظومة متكاملة تشمل الاستشعار والتحليل واتخاذ القرار والإخلاء والمتابعة، لدعم استجابة فعالة عند تغير ظروف المنشأة

projects.title: PulseWay
projects.desc: مشروع PulseWay هو نظام عبور مشاة ذكي يهدف لرفع أمان الطرق في المدن الذكية باستخدام تقنيات إنترنت الأشياء (IoT). يعتمد النظام على حساسات تفاعلية تكشف وجود المشاة لحظياً، وتفعل إشارات ضوئية وتنبيهات تفاعلية تنبه السائقين وتوفر عبوراً آمناً وسلساً لجميع الفئات، خاصة كبار السن وذوي الإعاقة، مع تقليل الازدحام المروري وضمان انسيابية حركة السيارات.

projects.title: Aperi
projects.desc:
**Aperi — Short Summary**

Aperi is an AI companion that tells you what product labels won't. Search any product, ingredient, or medication and it uncovers what brands leave out: hidden risks, side effects, regulatory red flags, and misleading marketing claims — all verified with clickable sources from the FDA, PubMed, and independent watchdogs.

Every analysis gets a **safety score (0–100)** with a plain-English explanation of how it was calculated — so you instantly know how risky something is

projects.title: Hydrogen could be the backbone of a clean energy future, but…
projects.desc:
Hydrogen could be the backbone of a clean energy future, but there's a surprisingly mundane problem holding it back: bubbles. When you split water into hydrogen and oxygen, gas bubbles get stuck to the electrode surface, blocking the very reaction that made them and quietly driving up energy costs across the whole hydrogen industry. This project goes after that problem with sound.
We submerge an ultrasound probe in the electrolysis cell and use high-frequency sound waves to shake bubbles loose a

projects.title: Autonomous shape reconfiguration Rover
projects.desc: Exploration rovers are built to one fixed body size, so they can enter only those passages wider than themselves, and reaching those sections means sending a second, smaller rover. AdaptX changes its own body shape to fit the space available. Its hinged chassis needs no dedicated folding actuator, the drive system itself does the work. Sensors read the gap ahead and the rover reconfigures on its own, widening the range of passages a single rover can explore.

projects.title: HemoOptix
projects.desc: HemoOptix estimates hemoglobin levels non-invasively without pain or blood sampling. Iron deficiency is common but current tests can be painful, costly, and require lab visits. Our device uses multi-wavelength light through the skin or fingernail. The main challenge is differences in skin tone, melanin, and thickness. Our smart algorithm reduces the effect of these factors to improve hemoglobin estimation making HemoOptix a fast, safe, and wearable health monitoring solution.

projects.title: Edge AI-Managed Nano-Hydrogels for Autonomous Closed-Loop Solid Tumor Eradication
projects.desc: The DHOVA project proposes a closed-loop cyber-bio system for targeted tumor therapy. It utilizes carbon dots, Edge AI tracking (15ms), and NIR laser activation to reach 42°C. This triggers chitosan polymerization (Sol-to-Gel) into a nanoscale shell (<2nm) to mechanically choke the tumor by blocking glucose and oxygen in an in vitro proposed model.

projects.title: SmartSign: IoT-Enabled Assistive Sign Language Translation Glove with Dual Speech & Text Synthesis
projects.desc: SmartSign is an IoT-enabled assistive glove designed to reduce communication barriers between sign-language users and non-signers. It combines five custom flex sensors, a 6-DOF MPU-6050 IMU, ESP32 processing, BLE, and a mobile app for real-time bilingual text and speech translation. Across 500 trials, SmartSign achieved 98.4% mean recognition accuracy and 135 ms response time. With a prototype cost below $42, it demonstrates an affordable, portable, and accessible communication solution.

projects.title: MUNSEF
projects.desc:
Every school has problems. But how many are truly heard?

Munsef turns student voices into meaningful action. It provides a safe and flexible way to report concerns, track their progress, and communicate privately with school administration. Its AI analyzes reports to uncover recurring issues, identify priorities, and reveal what needs attention most. Instead of letting concerns get lost, Munsef transforms them into clear insights that help schools understand what students truly need.

projects.title: Ammonia (NH₃) has emerged as a promising carbon-free fuel; however…
projects.desc: Ammonia (NH₃) has emerged as a promising carbon-free fuel; however, its practical implementation in combustion systems is limited by low reactivity and high nitrogen oxide (NOₓ) emissions. In this study, the combustion characteristics of NH₃/CH₄/air mixtures are experimentally investigated using a KAUST Double Swirl Burner (KDSB) to evaluate flame stability, structure, and NO emissions under varying operating conditions.

projects.title: KNOWLAGE: Every age has something to share
projects.desc: KNOWLAGE blends “knowledge” and “age” because every generation has something to share. This AI-assisted platform connects learners, teachers, and hosts to exchange skills across communities. It suggests teachers, places, and first lessons based on goals and preferences. People confirm each session. The concept respects Saudi culture and privacy, with parent-managed, supervised participation for children.

projects.title: AeroPulse-AI
projects.desc: نظام ذكي لحماية الملاحة الجوية والفضائية من هجمات تزييف الـ GPS. يكشف النظام الاختراق فوراً ويعزل الإشارة المزيفة، ثم يتحول تلقائياً إلى الملاحة البصرية والمغناطيسية عبر الذكاء الاصطناعي (Edge-AI) لمواصلة الطيران بدقة وبدون إنترنت، مع إرسال إنذار أمني مشفر عبر الأقمار الصناعية المصغرة لحماية المركبات المجاورة

projects.title: MATRIX
projects.desc: AI data-center energy use is skyrocketing, with 60–80% wasted shuttling data. This project presents a fully bio-derived, inkjet-printed chitosan-rGO memristor on paper for eco-friendly neuromorphic computing. Using dual computational models (VTEAM and 1-D drift-diffusion), we pinpoint an optimal ~14 wt% rGO loading below the percolation threshold, achieving smooth analog switching, sub-1V operating voltage, 6 synaptic states, and sub-$1 cost from waste feedstock.

projects.title: Design of an Electro-Absorptive Timer for Delayed Activation of High-Risk Devices
projects.desc: This project presents an electro-absorptive timer that uses liquid absorption through a porous rod to generate an adjustable time delay. As absorption progresses, the rod’s electrical resistance decreases, increasing divider-circuit voltage and activating a transistor–relay system. Experiments demonstrated delayed lamp activation after approximately 8 minutes. The concept may support delays of 5–40 minutes and improve safety in hazardous industrial, military, and high-voltage applications.

projects.title: DateCycle
projects.desc: DateCycle transforms date palm waste into eco-friendly nursery pods that help plants grow while reducing plastic waste. Durable, water-retaining, and fully plantable, each pod naturally decomposes in the soil and returns organic nutrients to the plant. By turning agricultural waste into a valuable growing solution, DateCycle offers a smarter, more sustainable choice for nurseries, farmers, and eco-conscious growers.

projects.title: Amjad AI
projects.desc: Amjad AI is an intelligent Web-Agent AI assistant designed to excel in software development, deep research, Coding, Teaching, and web design, it helps Students turn ideas into real projects by generating high-quality code, researching complex topics, and creating modern digital experience. Amjad aims to make advanced AI tools more accessible, efficient, and user-full for students, developers, and creators.

projects.title: Echo Nakhla
projects.desc: Red palm weevil larvae destroy date palms from the inside, and farmers usually notice when it is too late. Roaming Palm Listener uses a small set of cheap clip-on sensors that hear larvae chewing. Every evening, a farm gateway picks the highest-risk palms and the sensors are moved there. In our 1,000-palm simulation, 20 roaming sensors cut palm losses by 89% at about 2% of the hardware cost of one sensor per palm. A working prototype is currently being built.

projects.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Ultrafast Optimization of GaN Power Converters
projects.desc: This project introduces a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) surrogate model for Gallium Nitride (GaN) power switching circuits. By embedding power loss physics into PyTorch, the model predicts switching loss (R2 = 0.9914) and efficiency across 90,000 design points in just 6.55 ms. This replaces 100 hours of heavy LTspice simulations with a 54-million-times speedup, enabling real-time optimal operating point selection.

projects.title: Development of Smart Membrane for Solar Water Desalination
projects.desc: Water desalination is essential to address the freshwater crisis, but conventional methods consume energy. This research develops photothermal PVDF-HFP membranes containing ZnO and MXene to enhance solar absorption, heating, water flux, and desalination efficiency. Membranes are fabricated using phase inversion and evaluated for physical, thermal, and mechanical properties. They aim to produce high purity water using the sunlight while reducing energy consumption and reducing wetting and fouling

projects.title: Smart Color-Changing Wound Dressing for Early wound monitoring
projects.desc: Meet the next generation of healing: a smart adhesive bandage equipped with an advanced, color changing sensor that reacts in real-time to your wound's health. Paired with our innovative mobile app, simply snap a picture for instant analysis. The app accurately assesses your wound status whether it's stable, needs disinfection, or requires a specialist's review—and sends instant alerts straight to your phone. Experience peace of mind and proactive care, right in the palm of your hand

projects.title: Mangrove Guardian
projects.desc: Mangrove Guardian: An innovative Saudi prototype combining robotics and clean energy to protect coastal ecosystems. It features an automated system to safely clear macroalgae biofouling from aerial roots without damage, while converting harvested biomass into clean energy via solar drying. A sustainable solution empowering circular economy and Saudi Vision 2030

projects.title: AI-SSMANI - AI Saudi Sign Model for Accessibility & Natural Interpretation
projects.desc: AI-SSMANI is a Saudi sign language interpreter to help commenicating with deaf and hard-of-hearing people. We made it using YOLOv8 and used a dataset for the letters of 14000 pre-labelled images as well as created our own dataset for Arabic words consists of 29 videos. The new dataset was labelled to train and test AI model. The results were excellent with a precision of 98% for letters & 55% for words and a recall of 97% for letters & 45% for words. It can be used in many applications & places.

projects.title: AirPalm: Turning Date Palm Waste into Carbon That Cleans the Air
projects.desc: Every year, Saudi Arabia burns or buries over a million tons of date palm waste. We asked: what if the palm could clean the air it grew in? Activated by Nature turns discarded leaves and seeds into advanced carbon that traps CO₂. Our novel dual activation with CaCO₃ and KOH captures nearly twice as much as earlier palm-based carbons. Free raw material. Local solution. Global impact. From the farms of Qassim to a cleaner planet.

projects.title: EcoPod: IoT-Based Automated Indoor Hydroponic System for Urban Water and Space Optimization
projects.desc:
EcoPod هي كبسولة زراعة مائية ذكية للمنازل والمكاتب صُممت لحل مشكلة قلة المساحات وهدر المياه في المدن.
تعتمد الكبسولة على شريحة ESP32 وحساسات ذكية تقيس الرطوبة والحرارة ومستوى الماء لتشغيل الري وإضاءة الـ LED تلقائياً فور حاجة النبتة دون أي تدخل يدوي. ترتبط الكبسولة بتطبيق جوال يتيح لك متابعة كبسولات متعددة مثل نبات اللوتس والبامبو وتلقي تنبيهات فورية.
.هدف EcoPod الأساسي: تحقيق توفير يصل إلى 80% من استهلاك المياه مقارنة بالزراعة التقليدية، وتسهيل الزراعة دون الحاجة للعناية اليدوية اليومية.

projects.title: NeuroPlay — When a System Doesn’t Just Measure Your Performance, but Understands Your State
projects.desc:
In esports, we can see what happens inside the game—but what happens inside the player while they play?
NeuroPlay is an intelligent system that connects the brain, eyes, body, movement, and gameplay, using AI to understand the player’s state and build a personalized cognitive profile.
Instead of training everyone the same way, NeuroPlay adapts to the player, recommends personalized interventions, and measures their response to continuously improve the training process.

projects.title: بصيرة تقنية Basira Digital
projects.desc: Basira Digital is a smart wearable glove designed to help people with visual impairment navigate safely and independently. It combines a camera for obstacle detection, distance sensors, GPS navigation, and a five-zone vibration language to provide tactile alerts and directional guidance. It can be further developed to integrate with smart pathways using Beacons and enhanced with AI.

projects.title: Solar hydrogen production is often presented as a near-solved…
projects.desc: Solar hydrogen production is often presented as a near-solved problem: split water with sunlight, and clean fuel follows. In practice, most photoelectrochemical (PEC) devices are developed and characterized exclusively under standard AM1.5G (1 sun) illumination, a condition rarely met outdoors, where cloud cover, shading, and low solar angles routinely reduce irradiance to a fraction of full sun. Cu2O, a widely studied p-type photocathode material valued for its favorable band gap, low cost, and

projects.title: Nephra
projects.desc: NEPHRA is a proposed transport-optimized sorbent cartridge architecture for portable artificial kidney systems. It aims to improve urea removal during continuous blood flow by distributing flow more uniformly through the sorbent bed, reducing channeling and improving sorbent utilization. The design combines a flow-distribution layer, momentum-equalization region, graded-porosity sorbent bed, and outlet collection plenum. Its performance is evaluated using breakthrough time, dynamic capacity, sor

projects.title: الحذاء الذكي هو ابتكار تقني يهدف إلى مساعدة المكفوفين وضعاف البصر…
projects.desc: الحذاء الذكي هو ابتكار تقني يهدف إلى مساعدة المكفوفين وضعاف البصر على التنقل بأمان واستقلالية أكبر. يعتمد الحذاء على مستشعرات ذكية تكتشف العوائق أمام المستخدم وتقيس المسافة بينها وبينه، ثم تنبهه من خلال إشارات صوتية متدرجة حسب قرب العائق. يجمع الابتكار بين سهولة الاستخدام والتكلفة المناسبة، ليقدم حلاً عمليًا يمكن ارتداؤه يوميًا، ويسهم في تقليل مخاطر الاصطدام والسقوط وتعزيز ثقة المستخدم أثناء الحركة والتنقل في مختلف الأماكن.

projects.title: SARAB – Cooperative Defense Against GPS Spoofing in Drone Swarms
projects.desc: SARAB is a software defense for drone swarms against GPS spoofing. Detect: one spoofer gives every drone the same fake position, so the known formation spacing collapses and the attack is flagged within one GPS sample. Contain: all drones switch automatically to inertial navigation. Deceive: a receive-only decoy logs the fake signal to fingerprint the attack. Python simulation, 500 runs: 0 false alarms; position error ~221 m to ~8 m at 30 s. No signals transmitted.

projects.title: Development of Smart Clay: Eco-Friendly, High-Performance Materials for Defense
projects.desc: This project up-cycles Saudi date-pit waste with a natural starch binder into a 3D-printable, biodegradable composite for defense applications. Aligned with Saudi Vision 2030, it advances GAMI defense localization targets and Saudi Green Initiative circular economy goals, with ongoing laboratory testing evaluating its mechanical strength, thermal stability, and durability.

projects.title: SealGruard
projects.desc: SealGuard is a multilayer tamper-evident security label designed to detect package opening and attempts to remove the security label itself through distinct and visible responses. The label maintains visible evidence after tampering, making it difficult to restore the package to its original appearance without detection. Its design is simple, low-cost, and adaptable to different products and packaging

projects.title: Our project is a first-of-its-kind recycling initiative in Saudi…
projects.desc: Our project is a first-of-its-kind recycling initiative in Saudi Arabia that goes far beyond being just an app  it’s a social platform designed to connect people, promote sustainability, and inspire nationwide participation in the Kingdom’s Vision 2030 goals. The platform allows users to easily locate nearby recycling drop-off points and rewards them with points every time they recycle, creating a fun and competitive community through a national leaderboard.

projects.title: Conceptual Design of an Adaptive Reconfigurable Solar Array for Orbital Debris Impact Mitigation
projects.desc: This project aims to make spacecraft solar arrays safer from tracked orbital debris. When a threat is detected the most exposed section can move to reduce its exposure. If an impact happens the damaged section can be isolated so the rest of the array keeps working. The main idea is to combine protection before impact with damage control after impact to improve spacecraft safety and power reliability.

projects.title: Smart Electronic Splint with Integrated Sensors and Functional Electrical Stimulation - FES
projects.desc: PhysioSmart is an AI-powered smart splint, specially designed to meet the needs of the elderly and children during fracture recovery. The splint relies on cellular micro-vibrations technology to accelerate tissue regeneration and bone healing, and is reinforced with a biosensor network that monitors swelling, temperature, and bone stability in real time. The splint provides an interactive dashboard for clinicians that facilitates accurate remote screening and tracking, reducing t

projects.title: Nano-Biofilters Using Algae for Water Treatment with Quality Monitoring
projects.desc: Water pollution is a growing environmental challenge, with contaminants such as heavy metals and organic pollutants affecting water quality. This project proposes a sustainable filtration system combining Spirulina algae, ZnO nanoparticles, and PLA polymer. A smart monitoring system using pH, TDS, and turbidity sensors is also proposed. Preliminary UV–Vis and FTIR results support further investigation of the prepared materials and their potential for sustainable water treatment.

projects.title: This study presents a Smart Goggle system designed to improve…
projects.desc: This study presents a Smart Goggle system designed to improve independent mobility for visually impaired individuals. Three ultrasonic sensors detect near, distant, and floor-level obstacles, while a live camera and microphone support real-time scene interpretation and remote assistance. Sensor data are converted into directional audio and tactile feedback. Testing demonstrated high detection accuracy, rapid response, and user adaptation. The accessible design provides an assistive solution.

projects.title: نظارة ذكية
projects.desc: نظارة ذكية تعمل بالذكاء الاصطناعي متعدد الوسائط (Multimodal AI) لفك شفرة التواصل غير اللفظي والصوتي لمن يعانون من إعاقات حركية ونطقية شديدة. تعتمد النظارة على دمج قراءة إيماءات الوجه وحركة العين الدقيقة مع تحليل النبرات الصوتية الضعيفة لحظياً، وتوليد كلام مسموع وسياقي مكتمل عبر مكبرات صوت مدمجة، مما يمنح المستفيدين استقلالية تامة للتعبير والتفاعل المباشر مع المجتمع بدون الحاجة لوسيط

projects.title: This project develops a smart fire rescue robot that prioritizes…
projects.desc: This project develops a smart fire rescue robot that prioritizes saving lives before fire suppression. It uses thermal imaging and sensors to detect victims fire heat and toxic gases. It locates trapped people and identifies safe evacuation routes. Responsive victims receive voice guidance while unresponsive victims locations are sent to rescue teams. After rescue the robot supports fire suppression and scans for remaining hot spots to reduce re ignition risk.

projects.title: EcoHybrid: Sustainable Cement–Epoxy Composite
projects.desc: EcoHybrid is an innovative cement–epoxy composite incorporating fly ash, recycled glass powder, and silica powder to reduce conventional cement dependency while improving mechanical performance and durability. The project targets 15–30% lower production costs and 20–40% lower CO₂ emissions through recycled material integration and reduced cement use, offering a more sustainable and cost-effective solution for future construction applications.

projects.title: NEURO-ADAPT: A Smart EEG-Guided Elbow Orthosis with Adaptive Mechanical Assistance
projects.desc: What if an elbow orthosis could detect when you want to move, measure how much strength you have, and give you only the help you need? NEURO ADAPT combines EEG signal filtering, machine learning, and force sensing to make this possible. While noisy brain signals, user-specific training, safety, and cost make this challenging, the project tackles these problems through a simpler, computer-based design and low-cost components exploring a more accessible future for personalized biomedical assistant

projects.title: Sanad A Robot Assistant for Wheelchair User
projects.desc:
Sanad | A Smart Robot Assistant for Wheelchair Users
For a wheelchair user, a high shelf or a phone dropped on the floor can mean waiting for someone to help, many times a day.
Sanad ends that wait: it hears a voice command, finds the item with its camera, reaches from the floor to the top shelf, and hands it over at hand level.
No waiting. No reaching. No risk.
Sanad: because independence is a right.

projects.title: Real-Time Physiological Arousal Management Using Haptic Stimulation
projects.desc: This project showcases a wearable device designed to help manage high physiological arousal from stress,anxiety attacks, panic attacks, emotional overload and other intense states. It consists of a dedicated PPG sensor and an accelerometer and gyroscope, which the ESP32 uses to calculate heart rate, HRV and movement data in real time. The system compares these with a personalized baseline calculated while u wear the watch and activates an LRA vibration stimulus when sustained arousal is detected

projects.title: Standard approaches for monitoring the state of biodiversity depend…
projects.desc: Standard approaches for monitoring the state of biodiversity depend on cloud-computing, which exhibits poor performance in terms of latencies and power requirements in remote areas where there is limited bandwidth and connectivity. To address this challenge, we develop Eco-Edge-Twin, an edge native monitoring framework based on spike-based neural networks (SNNs). The system integrates bioacoustic and microclimatic signals using a cross-modal spike-based attention network.

projects.title: Innovative Nano‑Ceramic‑Polymer Membranes for Drug Delivery: AI‑Agents Performance Evaluation
projects.desc: Glioblastoma remains difficult to treat due to the BBB and tumor complexity, requiring smarter drug‑delivery systems. This project develops innovative nano‑ceramic‑polymer membranes and evaluates them using AI agents: the Performance Agent analyzes release efficiency, the Safety Agent checks toxicity, the Optimization Agent improves structure, and the Decision Agent integrates all results to determine overall therapeutic success.

projects.title: After a worker on my grandfather's date farm fell from a palm tree…
projects.desc: After a worker on my grandfather's date farm fell from a palm tree and fractured his leg, I designed PalmPollen Drone: a low-cost, sub-250 g quadcopter that pollinates palms from the air, so farmers no longer need to climb. Flown with a PS4 controller, it hovers steadily above the crown while a servo hopper releases a measured dose of pollen. Future versions will add a camera for early disease detection, targeted pesticide spraying, and support for harvesting and pruning.

projects.title: Physical Twin System for Remote Motion Control via Computer Vision
projects.desc:
The project aims to present a test model of an artificial palm that represents a "Physical Twin." It moves with high precision to simulate human hand movements remotely without any physical contact, using Computer Vision technology.
This system allows control signals to be transferred smoothly and accurately, which helps in executing fine motor tasks. It is also characterized by low manufacturing costs and ease of development and maintenance for various fields.

projects.title: GOVX
projects.desc: GOVX هو إطار ومنصة ذكاء اصطناعي تحلل رحلة المستفيد الحكومية من البداية إلى النهاية، وتقيس الاحتكاك والعبء الإداري داخلها، وتتنبأ بنقاط التعثر قبل حدوثها، وتقترح تدخلاً مناسبًا، ثم تقيس تجريبيًا هل أدى هذا التدخل إلى تحسين الرحلة.

projects.title: Detection of annular casing leaks in HPHT oil wells is limited by…
projects.desc: Detection of annular casing leaks in HPHT oil wells is limited by battery depletion, since downhole batteries cannot be replaced. This project proposes a self-powered sensor node in which an electromagnetic vibration harvester and PMIC charge heat-resilient supercapacitors instead of batteries. An ultra-low-power MCU running Edge AI analyzes MEMS pressure and vibration data to detect micro pressure drops (<0.05 psi) in real time for proactive, maintenance-free leak prediction.

projects.title: Hajj secure ID
projects.desc: Hajj Secure ID is a dual-layer smart identity prototype designed for pilgrims and emergency responders. It integrates an encrypted NFC wristband for secure medical data access and a public QR code for rapid pilgrim identification. The solution enhances crowd security, speeds up field medical triage, and ensures offline data protection during high-density events.

projects.title: راﺻــــــــــﺪ
projects.desc: راصد: لأن اكتشاف الخطر قبل وقوعه قد يصنع الفارق. منصة أمنية ذكية تحمي الحدود والأرواح، وتمنح مراكز القيادة إنذارًا مبكرًا يصل إلى 180 ثانية قبل وصول التهديد، بفضل رادار AESA X-Band. يحلل راصد الإشعاع ويقيّم مستوياته ودرجة الضرر والخطورة، كما يرصد الألغام ضمن نطاق عمله، مع تطوير قدرته على تحديد مواقعها وإرسال الإنذار لمركز القيادة دون تدخل بشري

projects.title: An AI-powered smart system designed for early stroke risk…
projects.desc: An AI-powered smart system designed for early stroke risk prediction using machine learning and real-time health indicators. The system integrates vital signs and health risk factors, analyzes them using a trained machine-learning model, and provides an immediate risk assessment through an interactive interface. It aims to support early detection and preventive healthcare through an accessible, intelligent, and cost-effective solution.

projects.title: قبعة ذكية لكشف العوائق لذوي الإعاقة البصرية
projects.desc: ابتكار " قبعة الملاحة الذكية " لمساعدة المكفوفين وضعاف البصر على التنقل بأمان . تعتمد الفكرة على دمج مستشعر مسافة (Ultrasonic) بمقدمة القبعة يرتبط ببرمجية (Arduino) وطنان صوتي . عند الاقتراب من الجدران أو العوائق المرتفعة التي يصعب كشفها بالعصا التقليدية ، تطلق القبعة طنيناً تحذيرياً تتغير حدته حسب القرب . تمتاز القبعة بتكلفة اقتصادية، وسهولة استخدام تترك اليدين حرتين ، مما يرفع مستوى الأمان والاستقلالية للمستخدم .

projects.title: Medicool
projects.desc:
MediCool — Smart Medication Refrigerator

MediCool is a smart medical refrigerator designed to make medication management more organized, accessible, and reliable. It combines controlled medication storage with smart scheduling, temperature monitoring, personalized alerts, and a digital interface that displays patient, medication, dose, and timing information.

Designed for hospitals and homes, MediCool can support patients, nurses, doctors, caregivers, and families by helping organize multiple

projects.title: REIMAGINING THE SCHOOL DESK: From a Traditional Desk to a Connected Learning Environment
projects.desc: What if the school desk became a connected learning workspace? REIMAGINING THE SCHOOL DESK proposes a dedicated desk combining digital textbooks, writing space, assignments, and classroom interaction, with learning continuing on a home device. A foam scale model and a one-lesson browser demo illustrate the concept. The aim is fewer printed materials and a more organized learning experience; classroom benefits remain to be tested.

projects.title: PulseFence – نظام ذكي منخفض التكلفة لحماية شبكات المدن الذكية من الإشارات اللاسلكية المزيفة
projects.desc: يهدف مشروع PulseFence إلى تطوير طبقة حماية ذكية ومنخفضة التكلفة لشبكات المستشعرات اللاسلكية في المدن الذكية، للكشف عن هجمات إعادة إرسال الإشارات حتى عندما تكون البيانات صحيحة ومشفرة. يعتمد النظام على تحليل البصمة الراديوية وخصائص الإشارة الزمنية باستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي الطرفي (Edge-AI) للتحقق من هوية مصدر الإشارة، مع استخدام عدة وحدات استقبال لتقدير موقع مصدر الإشارة المشبوهة. ويُختبر النموذج لقياس دقة الكشف، ومعدل الإنذارات الخاطئة، وزمن الاستجابة، ودقة تحديد الموقع.

projects.title: المنقذ الصغير هو مشروع ابتكاري عبارة عن سيارة صغيرة ذكية تتجول داخل…
projects.desc: المنقذ الصغير هو مشروع ابتكاري عبارة عن سيارة صغيرة ذكية تتجول داخل المنزل، مزودة بحساسات حريق موزعة على أطرافها. عند اكتشاف حريق أو شعلة أو دخان، تتوجه السيارة فورًا إلى موقع الخطر للمساعدة في إطفائه، مع إرسال بلاغ إلى صاحب المنزل لتنبيهه بوجود الحريق .

projects.title: LifeDose: An Intelligent and Secure System for Diabetes Treatment Management
projects.desc: LifeDose is a smart and safe diabetes management ecosystem that connects patients, guardians, hospitals, wearable devices, AI, schools, and emergency services. It verifies treatment commands, protects patient data, detects unusual situations, and supports safe treatment management at home and outside. LifeDose aims to reduce treatment errors and improve patient safety through one connected digital system.

projects.title: Laniakea
projects.desc: What if we could stop a space disaster before it starts? As the threat of Kessler theoretical scenario grows. An AI powered system targets high risk objects before they become a greater threat. By detecting targets that the adaptive gripper captures, the drag sail pulls it towards the atmosphere. Don’t chase millions of fragments stop the first one that could create thousands more.

projects.title: تخيّل أن تتكلم مع شخص أصم دون أن تعرف لغة الإشارة
projects.desc: تخيّل أن تتكلم مع شخص أصم دون أن تعرف لغة الإشارة. SignBridge (جسر الإشارة) يحقق ذلك: اكتب أو تكلّم، فتؤدي يدان روبوتيتان الإشارة أمامه، وحين يؤشر هو تقرأ الكاميرا إشاراته وتحوّلها إلى نص وصوت فورا. نموذجنا، المدرب على أكثر من 94 ألف مقطع، يفهم 250 كلمة من لغة الإشارة بقراءة حركة اليد وموقعها من الوجه والجسم، ويعمل داخل جهازك دون رفع أي فيديو، بل يمكن للأصم أن يحاور اليد بنفسه. SignBridge.. لأن لكل شخص الحق في أن يفهم.

projects.title: حارس الهوية الرقمية
projects.desc:
اسم المشروع: حارس الهويه الرقميه

المشكلة: انتشار الحسابات الوهمية والمنتحلة التي قد تُستخدم في الاحتيال وسرقة المعلومات.

الحل: تطبيق يحلل المؤشرات العامة للحساب ويكشف علامات الاشتباه، مع توضيح أسبابها للمستخدم.

طريقة العمل: يدخل المستخدم رابط الحساب، ثم يحلل التطبيق عمر الحساب ونشاطه واسم المستخدم والصورة، ويعرض مستوى الاشتباه.

الهدف: تقليل مخاطر الاحتيال وانتحال الشخصية، ونشر الوعي بالأمن السيبراني.

الميزة: سهل الاستخدام ويشرح للمستخدم سبب الاشتباه بدل إعطائه نتيجة فقط.

projects.title: Asthma is a chronic disease whose sudden attacks can be dangerous…
projects.desc: Asthma is a chronic disease whose sudden attacks can be dangerous, especially for children, and warning signs often appear only after an attack begins. This project presents an early-warning system: a smart wristband and mobile app tracking breathing, blood oxygen and environmental factors such as dust and humidity. An AI model predicts attack risk and alerts the patient, family and doctor early. The prototype is being tested. It aims to reduce severe attacks and emergency visits.

projects.title: FLOW-THROUGH REMOVAL OF METHYL ORANGE USING PVA/MgAl-LDH COMPOSITE MEMBRANES
projects.desc: What happens to the dye after the fabric is colored? Too often, it ends up in our water. We built green, citric acid-crosslinked PVA membranes loaded with MgAl-LDH to catch Methyl Orange during flow-through filtration. Removal rose from 10.7% to 46.5% as LDH loading increased from 20% to 40%, but uptake per gram of LDH fell, a trade-off linked to LDH aggregation seen in SEM. So where does the dye go now? Into a green membrane, not our water. A promising step toward cleaner water.

projects.title: خوذة التوازن الذكى للدماغ
projects.desc: The Smart Brain Balance Helmet is a proposed wearable system integrating EEG and motion sensing to capture neural and movement data within one platform. Through multimodal data fusion it aims to generate a quantitative Balance Index for more comprehensive and objective balance assessment Potential applications include healthcare, rehabilitation sports, and safety The project supports Saudi Vision 2030 through healthcare innovation, digital transformation, prevention, and improved quality of life

projects.title: VTP NETWORK PLATFORM: EdTech & Esports Ecosystem
projects.desc: The VTP Network Platform is an EdTech ecosystem that uses gaming as a gateway to structured learning, teamwork, and skill development. Using Call of Duty Mobile as its initial prototype, VTP combines player profiling, squad management, and tactical analytics. By evaluating key gameplay variables, it supports balanced teams while developing strategic thinking, communication, and data literacy in a safe, moderated environment.

projects.title: This study investigated whether ethanolic Nigella sativa extract…
projects.desc: This study investigated whether ethanolic Nigella sativa extract (NSE) enhances doxorubicin (DOX) cytotoxicity against MCF-7 breast cancer cells. Using the MTT assay, NSE showed an IC₅₀ of 376.2 µg/mL and DOX 5.859 µg/mL. Combination treatment markedly enhanced efficacy, reducing doxorubicin's apparent IC₅₀ from 3.007 to 0.531 µg/mL with supportive morphological evidence of cell shrinkage. NSE shows promise as a natural chemosensitizer to improve breast cancer treatment outcomes.

projects.title: AI-Based Obstacle Detection for Wheelchair Mobility and Independence
projects.desc: This project develops an AI-based system to enhance wheelchair mobility and independence by detecting environmental obstacles. A YOLOv8 model was trained to identify mobility-related barriers and achieved 0.85 precision, 0.80 recall, 0.85 mAP@50, and 0.65 mAP@50–95. The proposed system combines obstacle detection with environmental sensing and a mobile application that provides obstacle information and supports assistance requests, aiming to improve safety and independent mobility.

projects.title: SWARM-X
projects.desc: SWARM-X is a bio-inspired intelligent micro-robot system designed to explore challenging environments. It combines three specialized robotic units: FALCON for aerial reconnaissance, FLY for narrow-space exploration, and LOCUST for ground inspection and obstacle navigation. All units connect to a unified control core that integrates human supervision with intelligent navigation and data analysis. SWARM-X aims to enable safer, smarter, and more comprehensive exploration for search and rescue, insp

projects.title: Solar panels can lose efficiency when hot spots develop unnoticed
projects.desc: Solar panels can lose efficiency when hot spots develop unnoticed. Our project introduces a thermal monitoring system that tracks temperature changes across solar cells. By analyzing temperature differences, the rate of temperature increase, and how long an abnormal change continues, the system provides an early warning of potential hot spots. This helps detect problems before they reduce energy output or damage solar cells, improving panel reliability and supporting efficient solar energy use.

projects.title: مشروع تفادي الصدمات لذوي الاحتياجات
projects.desc:
يمثل مشروع حماية ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة من الصدمات مبادرة نوعية تهدف إلى توفير بيئة آمنة وداعمة نفسياً واجتماعياً. يركز المشروع على تقديم برامج التأهيل النفسي، وتدريب الكوادر والأسر على أساليب الاحتواء المبكر، ورصد علامات التوتر قبل تفاقمها.
​كما يسعى إلى تكييف البيئة المحيطة وتقليل المثيرات المزعجة، مما يضمن تعزيز الأمن النفسي لديهم ورفد قدراتهم على التكيف بثقة مع متطلبات الحياة اليومية

projects.title: MissionLatch-ROS: Mission-Bound Motion Authorization for ROS 2 Robots
projects.desc: MissionLatch-ROS نموذج لحماية أوامر حركة روبوتات ROS 2 عند تغيّر المهمة. يربط الأمر بتصريح للمهمة الحالية ويرفض أمر المهمة السابقة حتى إن أعاد إرساله ناشر مصرح له. أثبت اختبار ROS 2 Jazzy مع SROS2 Enforce حركة روبوت افتراضي في Gazebo بأوامر المهمة الحالية وعدم حركته بنوعين من أوامر المهمة السابقة. لم يُختبر روبوت فعلي بعد.

projects.title: Algae‑based Bio‑Cell Battery is a next‑generation, eco‑friendly…
projects.desc: Algae‑based Bio‑Cell Battery is a next‑generation, eco‑friendly energy technology that uses living algae—specifically photosynthetic cyanobacteria—to generate continuous electrical power. The core idea is simple but powerful: algae naturally produce electrons during photosynthesis (in light) and respiration (in darkness). A bio‑cell captures a tiny portion of these electrons using electrodes, creating a small but steady electrical current.

projects.title: Smart Medicine Box: Automated Pill Dispensing & Reminder System
projects.desc: Smart Medicine Box automates daily medication management for seniors and chronic patients. Featuring dual audio-visual alerts, real-time LCD tracking, and an interactive confirmation button, it prevents missed or double doses. Its intelligent snooze algorithm ensures full compliance, delivering a simple, reliable, and life-saving healthcare solution.

projects.title: Dual-Purpose Microalgal Systems for Wastewater Treatment and Biofuel Production
projects.desc: GreenFlow is a low-budget integrated system using microalgae for wastewater treatment while cultivating biomass for bio-fuel production. Combining in Biological, Solar, and Biomass processing, the single-stream process of the system enhances water quality, lowers costs, and recovers the resources sustainably. It is a versatile solution to water reclamation and environmental protection.

projects.title: وصل منظومة ذكية لإدارة واستلام الشحنات تجمع بين خزائن الاستلام…
projects.desc: وصل منظومة ذكية لإدارة واستلام الشحنات تجمع بين خزائن الاستلام الذكية، إنترنت الأشياء والذكاء الاصطناعي. تتيح حفظ الشحنات واستلامها بأمان عبر تقنيات مثل QR وOTP وNFC، مع مراقبة الحالة وتتبع الشحنات وتحليل البيانات. تستخدم وصل الذكاء الاصطناعي لتحسين مسارات التوصيل والتنبؤ بالطلب وتقليل الرحلات والتكاليف، بما يدعم كفاءة الخدمات اللوجستية وتكاملها مع المدن الذكية

projects.title: This project investigates the use of date-seed-derived magnetic…
projects.desc: This project investigates the use of date-seed-derived magnetic biosorbents for removing arsenic from contaminated water. The biosorbent is designed to adsorb arsenic from water, while its magnetic properties allow the material to be separated efficiently after treatment. The approach also provides a potential way to reuse date-seed waste for environmental applications.

projects.title: CyberShield AI is a cybersecurity prototype that analyzes emails…
projects.desc: CyberShield AI is a cybersecurity prototype that analyzes emails and messages for phishing and scam indicators. It identifies warning signs such as suspicious links, requests for sensitive information, and urgent language, then provides a Low, Medium, or High Risk result with the evidence behind it. Built with Xcode and SwiftUI, the prototype aims to improve cybersecurity awareness and help users recognize scams before taking action.

projects.title: RAWI | Water Consumption Reduction System
projects.desc: RAWI aims to develop a smart system that reduces water waste and promotes efficient water consumption by using sensors to measure water flow and monitor consumption patterns. The system can detect abnormal water flow or leaks and send alerts to the user, with the ability to automatically shut off the water supply when a leak is detected. The project aims to reduce water consumption, minimize waste, and raise awareness of the importance of water conservation through smart and sustainable technolo

projects.title: EMERGE
projects.desc: في لحظات الطوارئ لا يكفي أن نملك أدوات الإسعافات الأولية فقط بل أن نتصرف بطريقة صحيحة وسريعة ومن هنا جائت فكرة EMERGE، نظام إسعافات أولية ذكي يحوّل صندوق الإسعافات التقليدي إلى منظومة استجابة متكاملة يقيّم الإصابة ويحدد الأدوات اللازمة ويقدم إرشادات مرئية وإدارة ذكية للمخزون عن طريق التنبيه عند نقص الأدوات أو قرب انتهاء صلاحيتها إلى جانب مراقبة الحرارة والرطوبة للحفاظ على جودة المحتويات EMERGE يجعل الاستجابة أسرع، أوضح، وأكثر أمانًا لأن كل ثانية تمضي في حساب أرواحنا مهمة.

projects.title: Urban Space Command System for Environmental Security (SUSC)
projects.desc: An integrated Satellite-IoT-AI platform turning climate data into national resilience. SUSC predicts heatwaves, dust storms, and water stress 3 days ahead, enabling proactive decisions. Validated in Al-Ahsa: 25% energy savings, 18% water reduction, and a 3.2:1 ROI. It protects food systems, military assets, and public health, transforming fragmented data into a unified shield for smart cities and national security.

projects.title: A Layered Drone System for Highway Monitoring in Riyadh
projects.desc:
Propose a drone-based highway emergency response system for Riyadh City. Our solution cuts  down the response time to 5 minutes using AI-enabled drone fleets. Drones are scheduled for highway coverage depending on traffic density, drone coverage capacity and battery levels.
The system covers the  Riyadh highway network (15000 km + additional 500 km) in sections of 10 kilometers as drones can fly for 30 minutes to complete its route (10 km roundtrip).

projects.title: Rubidium-Doped Cs₂AgBiBr₅Cl Double Perovskite as a High-Performance Supercapacitor Electrode
projects.desc: Power systems eat up 20–30% of a spacecraft's mass, and low Earth orbit puts batteries through thousands of charge cycles a year, cutting mission life short. This project tests whether rubidium doping can turn Cs₂AgBiBr₅Cl perovskite into a lighter supercapacitor electrode. We synthesized and characterized it (XRD, SEM), then built and tested electrodes (CV, GCD, EIS). Doping improved crystallinity and surface uniformity. The electrode reached 127.8 F/g at 0.9 A/g with an ESR around 2 Ω.

projects.title: Antibacterial Activity of Saussurea Costus Against Multidrug-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus in Milk
projects.desc: This study evaluates the antibacterial activity of Saussurea costus extract and nanoparticles against multidrug-resistant Staphylococcus aureus in milk. Silver and zinc oxide nanoparticles were synthesized using green methods and characterized by XRD. Results demonstrated antibacterial activity with silver nanoparticles showing higher inhibition at higher concentrations. Findings highlight plant-mediated nanotechnology as an approach to developing antibacterial agents against resistant bacteria.

projects.title: MKSGT
projects.desc: Agriculture in arid and sandy environments faces persistent challenges in achieving consistent seed placement, controlling planting depth, and documenting the locations of agricultural operations. Previous research has developed manual planting tools and seed-metering mechanisms to improve singulation and emergence, while precision-agriculture systems have introduced GPS, GNSS, and GIS-based solutions for monitoring equipment and agricultural activities [1–8]. However, these solutions commonly

projects.title: القفاز الذكي للكشف المبكر عن ضعف التروية الدموية لدى كبار السن
projects.desc: يعاني كثير من كبار السن من ضعف التروية الدموية الطرفية الذي يبدأ ببرودة وتنميل في الأصابع، وقد يتطور بصمت الى تقرحات مزمنة او بتر بسبب غياب المراقبة المستمرة في المنزل. القفاز الذكي جهاز خفيف ومنخفض التكلفة يقيس حرارة الأصابع واستجابتها للاهتزاز وزمن التعافي الحراري، ويجمع بين هذي القياسات لكشف الإنذارات الأولية لضعف التروية الدموية بأقل إنذارات كاذبة، ليصل التنبيه فوراً للمستخدم ومقدم الرعاية عبر تطبيق جوال للتدخل قبل تفاقم الحالة. وقُدّم طلب براءة اختراع للابتكار.

projects.title: منصة إدامة النعم Sustaining Blessings
projects.desc:
“Edamat Al-Ni’am”
A digital platform that uses AI and the Internet of Things (IoT) to reduce food waste in Saudi Arabia. It predicts food demand using sales and event data, collects surplus food through smart containers, and connects it with charities for redistribution or converts it into compost and bioenergy. The platform helps restaurants, households, and businesses reduce costs, support those in need, and protect the environment, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030.

projects.title: This project develops a non-invasive AI approach to recognize…
projects.desc: This project develops a non-invasive AI approach to recognize imagined speech from EEG signals, aiming to support communication for people unable to speak due to paralysis or neurological conditions. EEG data from 23 participants were processed and analyzed across different frequency bands, tasks, and AI models. CNN-LSTM with Delta features achieved the highest accuracy of 94% in image-based tasks, providing a foundation for future non-invasive brain-computer communication systems.

projects.title: ACRS: Automated Compromise Response System
projects.desc:
Automated tools isolate every hacked machine, even critical ones. ACRS adapts its response, picking the smallest action that stops the attacker based on threat, evidence and machine importance. In a controlled 
.test of 41 attacks, it matched full isolation and cut critical outages from 7 to 2

projects.title: Smart-Chassis Transport Truck
projects.desc:

  Bad loading of fragile shipments leads to damage and delays

Innovation of a smart conveyor for transporting goods, or a high level of risk and damage.
the solution
Preliminary design of a cargo transport truck using a prototype robot that simulates the proposed vehicle
. The robot is divided into boxes, each with its own compartment, door, and barcode allowing the courier to scan it and instantly view container contents

The design provides an innovative shipping

projects.title: عين الماء | Ain Almaa
projects.desc:
عين الماء
نظام ذكي يحول اكتشاف تسربات المياه من رد فعل متأخر إلى وقاية استباقية. يعتمد على حساس تدفق المياه والضغط، وتحليل البيانات بالذكاء الاصطناعي للتعرف على أنماط الاستهلاك غير الطبيعية والتنبؤ بالاحتمالية وجود تسرب، حتى قبل ظهور آثاره. يرسل تنبيها يحدد المنطقة المحتملة للمشكلة، ويمكنه إغلاق الصمام تلقائيا عند وجود خطر. يهدف المشروع إلى حماية المياه وتقليل الأضرار والتكاليف وتعزيز الاستدامة في المنازل والمدارس والمنشآت

projects.title: Acoustic Shield: Autonomous Ultrasonic Sentry for Securing Air-Gapped Networks
projects.desc: Acoustic Shield protects air-gapped critical infrastructure from acoustic covert-channel data theft. Monitoring ultrasound (17.5–22 kHz) with standard sound hardware, it detects silent malware transmissions in under 100 ms. The out-of-band system mathematically drops human speech frequencies (<17.5 kHz) to guarantee privacy, and deploys closed-loop ultrasonic jamming with audible security sirens to actively scramble in-air signals and alert personnel without damaging hardware.

projects.title: Pyrolytic Transformation of Petcoke into Redox-Active Carbon Frameworks for Energy Storage
projects.desc: Petroleum coke (petcoke), a sulfur-rich refinery byproduct, poses major environmental and disposal challenges. This project converts petcoke into nitrogen-doped, redox-active carbon via KOH activation, melamine doping, and a controlled slow-ramp two-step pyrolysis designed to optimize porosity and nitrogen incorporation. Structural (XRD, SEM/EDX, BET, FTIR) and electrochemical (CV, GCD, EIS, stability) analyses evaluate its potential as a sustainable supercapacitor electrode material.

projects.title: Smart Heritage
projects.desc: Smart Heritage is an Arduino-based system that protects heritage sites around the clock. It covers five zones: a smart parking garage that guides visitors, a manuscripts museum that automatically controls temperature, humidity and gas, an artifacts museum with smart lighting that prevents light damage, an excavation site with early intrusion warnings, and a security control room with instant alerts. An integrated hardware and software solution to preserve our heritage.

projects.title: EcoVault
projects.desc: EcoVault is a cyber-secured ESG intelligence platform designed to support industrial sustainability in Saudi Arabia. It integrates IoT telemetry, PBFT blockchain verification, and LSTM-based predictive AI for carbon tracking, energy analytics, and anomaly detection. The prototype achieved 94% compliance accuracy and a 2-second data refresh rate, supporting ESG reporting, data integrity, cybersecurity monitoring, and alignment with Saudi Vision 2030 sustainability goals.

projects.title: GestureOS: Control your computer, without even touching it.
projects.desc:
If computers can see what we're doing, do we always need to touch them to interact with them?
GestureOS is a computer vision based project that allows a user to control their computer by tracking their hand movement, providing a potential solution for situations where physical contact can cause challenges. Our vision is to turn GestureOS into a modular and ready to implement package for developers to implement in their solutions.

projects.title: AI Defender
projects.desc: AI Defender is an AI-powered Chrome/Edge cybersecurity extension that provides real-time protection while browsing. It combines AI, API, rule-based, and fast scanners to detect harmful websites and URLs. The system monitors suspicious ports, detects sensitive password and payment fields, and alerts users to potential risks. It also includes Study Mode, website sandboxing, snapshot analysis, and security-awareness notifications. All data is stored locally to enhance user privacy and security.

projects.title: SandMonia
projects.desc: Sandmonia is a project that aims to produce green ammonia fertilizer on demand using glow discharge plasma and a catalyst made from iron-rich Al-Nafud desert sand. Instead of using the high temperatures and pressures of the Haber-Bosch process, the system uses nitrogen from the air and hydrogen from water electrolysis. The ammonia is then absorbed directly into irrigation water for use as fertilizer.

projects.title: Green Synthesis of Copper Nanoparticles Using Invasive Fig Plant for Antibacterial Activity
projects.desc: The project aims to produce copper nanoparticles using an eco-friendly biological method from an extract of the invasive prickly pear plant, instead of traditional methods requiring chemicals and high energy. The nanoparticles were characterized and tested against six bacterial strains. Results showed a clear ability to inhibit bacterial growth. The project combines an invasive plant with nanotechnology to create a sustainable solution with potential environmental and health applications.

projects.title: Purification of the Kingdom's water using diatomaceous earth, solar energy, and hybrid desalination.
projects.desc:
In the face of the water scarcity challenge in the Kingdom, my idea came to provide a more sustainable solution. In the face of the water scarcity challenge in the Kingdom, my idea came to provide a more sustainable solution.

I used diatomaceous earth with solar energy and hybrid desalination to purify and desalinate water, aiming to reduce energy consumption and environmental impact.

A Saudi solution for cleaner water, less energy, and a better environment. A Saudi solution for cleaner water,

projects.title: VeinSense
projects.desc:
VeinSense: The Smart Needle Innovation

A revolutionary medical innovation that transforms the injection and blood sampling experience! We developed the "Smart Needle" concept, integrated with infrared sensors and a camera to accurately detect veins before skin insertion.

This project aims to eliminate repetitive attempts, reduce patient pain and anxiety—especially for children and patients with hard-to-find veins—and empower healthcare professionals to achieve first-attempt success.

projects.title: Improving decision making in aviation troubles by visual monitoring to prevent accidents
projects.desc: This innovative solution enhances pilots' peripheral vision through advanced external cameras mounted on the aircraft's fuselage. The system provides a high-quality live feed that fully covers blind spots, granting the flight crew exceptional situational awareness during takeoff, landing, and adverse weather conditions. By helping to reduce accidents, improve decision-making in challenging weather, and elevate operational safety standards, the technology ensures a safer and smoother flight

projects.title: HYDRO-DEFENSE: Edge-AI Acoustic Spectrogram Analysis for Subsurface Water Pipeline Protection
projects.desc: HYDRO-DEFENSE is a stand-alone Edge-AI platform protecting the entire water grid for Saudi Vision 2030 economy. It employs edge acoustic sensor nodes with embedded 1D-CNN deep learning algorithms to transform in near real-time the vibrations picked from the ground into time-frequency power spectrograms; in turn, instantaneous detection of micro-fractures. By autonomously preventing leaks and pipe breaks, it makes it possible to save national water resources.

projects.title: Eco-Fert is a smart precision-farming system that monitors soil NPK…
projects.desc: Eco-Fert is a smart precision-farming system that monitors soil NPK nutrients and moisture in real time. Using Arduino, sensors, and automated valves, it delivers water and specific nutrients only when needed. By replacing fixed irrigation and fertilization with data-driven decisions, Eco-Fert helps farmers reduce resource waste, lower costs, improve soil management, and support sustainable agriculture.

projects.title: The idea uses smart bacteria to detect diseases early and precisely…
projects.desc: The idea uses smart bacteria to detect diseases early and precisely target affected cells.

projects.title: Aqua Smart Functional Dam
projects.desc: AquaSmart Functional Dam is a smart, sustainable water management system that integrates fog harvesting, automated irrigation, flood prevention, water filtration, hydropower, and environmental monitoring. The dam acts as a central decision making system, responding automatically to water level, rainfall, soil moisture, temperature, and humidity, while the AquaSmart AI Assistant analyzes and explains system decisions.

projects.title: Booth DBSurvive — Forensic Evidence Survivability in Databases
projects.desc:
Organisations test databases for performance and security, but not for the question that appears after an incident: can this be investigated at all?
DBSurvive is a digital forensics tool. Before an incident, it measures how long each type of evidence survives. After one, it reconstructs what happened from hash-verified copies, tracing every recovered value to its source.
On PostgreSQL 18.6: attribution is not recorded by default, and deleted content survives in the WAL after the heap loses it.

projects.title: نظام ضغط ذكي في بدلة رائد الفضاء
projects.desc: بدلة ذكية مبتكرة مصممة لدعم رواد الفضاء أثناء المهام الفضائية، من خلال دمج حجرات هوائية قابلة للتحكم مع وسائد مرنة داخل مناطق محددة من البدلة. تعمل الحجرات على تطبيق ضغط متتابع ومحسوب يحاكي التدليك، بهدف تقليل الإجهاد العضلي الناتج عن الجاذبية الصغرى، ودعم الراحة والحركة أثناء المهمات طويلة المدة. يتميز التصميم بخفة الوزن وإمكانية التحكم بدرجة الضغط وفق احتياج المستخدم، مما يجعله حلًا عمليًا قابلًا للتطوير لبيئات الفضاء.

projects.title: سند : منصة رقميه لتخصيص معلومات الأماكن وفق احتياجات الأشخاص ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصه
projects.desc: سَنَد منصة تفاعلية تمكّن الأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة من معرفة تفاصيل الأماكن قبل زيارتها، وفق احتياجاتهم الفردية. يتيح الموقع اختيار نوع الإعاقة لعرض معلومات مخصصة عن المداخل، المنحدرات، المصاعد، الإرشادات، التنبيهات والخدمات المتاحة، إلى جانب الصور والمسارات. لا يقرر سَنَد للمستخدم أين يذهب، بل يمنحه معلومات واضحة تساعده على اتخاذ قراره بنفسه، باستقلالية وراحة.

projects.title: Waterborne pathogens and corrosion threaten water systems, creating…
projects.desc: Waterborne pathogens and corrosion threaten water systems, creating a need for sustainable solutions. Fe₂O₃ nanoparticles were green-synthesized using Rosa rugosa flower extract and evaluated for antibacterial, antibiofilm, water treatment, and corrosion inhibition. The nanoparticles showed strong biofilm control and wastewater treatment potential, supporting applications in water disinfection, wastewater treatment, and corrosion control.

projects.title: Smart Sensing System for Enhancing Driving Safety via Submerged Pothole Detection (Road Sense)
projects.desc: innovation designed to enhance vehicle road safety under challenging weather and environmental conditions. It utilizes a smart sensing system—combining cameras and LiDAR—to detect potholes and structural road defects (including water-filled potholes) from a safe distance. By transmitting digital signals to a central processing unit, the system enables proactive measures such as changing lanes or alerting the driver, thereby reducing accidents and mechanical damage while improving overall safety

projects.title: Smart Cooling & Diagnostic Bandage (Therma-Cool Bandage)
projects.desc: Therma-Cool Bandage is a smart sports bandage that combines instant cooling with real-time injury diagnosis. Within 5 seconds, it detects injury severity—healthy, mild strain, moderate tear, or severe tear—and displays clear results on a built-in screen, while simultaneously cooling the area to relieve pain. It helps medical teams make fast, safe decisions on the field, protecting athletes during high-stakes tournaments like the World Cup.

projects.title: Crediona
projects.desc: Crediona enables educational and training organizations to design, issue, and verify digital certificates using artificial intelligence. Users describe a certificate in natural language and refine it interactively; once approved, certificates are issued in bulk from a spreadsheet of names. Each certificate carries a unique QR code linked to an instant public verification page, preventing forgery and giving institutions a credential system that is fast to produce and provably authentic.

projects.title: مشروع كاشف
projects.desc: كاشف منصة ذكية توظف الذكاء الاصطناعي لتحليل وربط البيانات المصرح باستخدامها، بهدف مساعدة المختصين على الوصول للمعلومات المهمة وفهم الروابط والأنماط بشكل أسرع وأكثر شمولًا. تجمع المنصة البيانات المتفرقة في صورة موحدة وواضحة، وتعرض العلاقات والنتائج بصورة تسهّل تحليل القضايا ودعم اتخاذ القرار. يسهم كاشف في تقليل الوقت والجهد، ورفع كفاءة العمل، وتحسين دقة التحليل، من خلال تحويل البيانات المتفرقة إلى معلومات مترابطة يمكن الاستفادة منها بفعالية.

projects.title: Smart Suit for muscle effort Monitoring \ البدلة الذكية لقياس الاجهاد العضلي
projects.desc: The Smart Suit uses EMG biosensors and AI to monitor muscle activity in real time, alerting factory and construction workers via vibration or light before fatigue causes injuries, while allowing supervisors to monitor team fatigue levels live—reducing downtime and boosting productivity.

projects.title: وشل - Washal
projects.desc: مشروع "وشل" يقدم حلاً طبيعياً لإسراف مياه الري وتراكم بقايا الأطعمة، كبديل للحبيبات الصناعية الضارة بالتربة. يعتمد الابتكار على تصنيع حبيبات حيوية من قشور الخيار والموز والرمان لتؤدي 3 وظائف في منتج واحد: يمتص الجزء الداخلي المصنوع من قشور الخيار والنشا الماء ليتضخم 4 أضعاف حجمه ويقلل الري، بينما يفرز الموز معادن البوتاسيوم والمغنيسيوم لتغذية الجذور. أما الغلاف الخارجي المنقوع بقشور الرمان فيحمي النبات من الفطريات. يحول وشل النفايات لمنتج آمن يقلل التكاليف ويتحلل بالكامل.

projects.title: Generative AI is used by 88.6% of students but suffers from a 20%…
projects.desc: Generative AI is used by 88.6% of students but suffers from a 20% hallucination rate, fabricating citations. Tools like Consensus are accurate but complex and lack Arabic support. This project introduces ArbConsensus, a student-centric, fully Arabized platform. By integrating external APIs and an automated Validity Score, it empowers Saudi students to easily verify research reliability, eliminate linguistic biases, and safeguard academic integrity in line with Vision 2030.

projects.title: Passive PVT System Using Nanofluid Thermosiphon for Dual Energy Output
projects.desc: An innovative 100% passive PVT system that eliminates external pumps and power. By combining a two phase closed thermosiphon with green synthesized graphene nanofluids, it significantly reduces solar panel temperatures, boosts electrical efficiency, and recovers waste heat for thermal building applications. A sustainable, high impact engineering solution fully backed by advanced numerical simulation and material characterization.

projects.title: كاشف مخاطر الجرائم الالكترونيه ( CyberCrime Risk Detector)
projects.desc: يهدف المشروع إلى تطوير أداة تعليمية تفاعلية تساعد المستخدمين على اكتشاف رسائل التصيد والاحتيال والهندسة الاجتماعية وتحليل الروابط والمرفقات المشبوهة دون فتحها تعتمد الأداة على محرك قواعد يحدد مؤشرات الخطر، مثل طلب كلمات المرور ورموز التحقق والتحويلات المالية وانتحال الجهات الرسمية، ثم يحدد نوع الهجوم ودرجة خطورته ويشرح أسباب التصنيف ويقترح الإجراء الأمني المناسب، فالمشروع لا يعتمد فقط على فكرة “اكتشاف الاحتيال”بل يجمع بين الكشف والتفسير والتوعيه مع إمكانية حفظ النتائج بصيغة CSV وإنشاء تقارير PDF

projects.title: Targeted and Sustained Alzheimer’s Therapy via Focused Ultrasound and 3D Hydrogel Matrix
projects.desc: A novel hybrid biomedical delivery system designed to overcome the Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB) in Alzheimer’s disease. By combining Low-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (LIFU) with microbubbles for safe, transient BBB permeabilization, and utilizing a biomimetic 3D hydrogel matrix for sustained local drug release at beta-amyloid plaque sites, this solution enhances therapeutic efficacy while minimizing systemic toxicity.

projects.title: شراب ذكي يعمل كإسعاف أولي تلقائي للاعبين
projects.desc: شراب ذكي يعمل كإسعاف أولي تلقائي للاعبين. الهدف: تقليص الدقائق الضائعة قبل أول تدخل إلى أجزاء من الثانية. يبني نطاقًا طبيعيًا لكل لاعب، ويكتشف الإصابة لحظيًا بحساسات ومعالج ذكي داخل الشراب، ويحدد موقعها وشدتها، ويطبّق ضغطًا وتبريدًا موضعيًا مستقلًا لكل منطقة من أربع: الكاحل والعرقوب والقوس ومقدمة القدم. الفرق عن المنتجات الحالية: تدخل تكيفي بدل شدة ثابتة. عند الشدة الحرجة يرسل تنبيهًا للمدرب أو الطبيب. يبدأ المشروع بنموذج للكاحل، ثم يتوسع تدريجيًا، مع الحاجة لبحث براءات احترافي قبل أي تقديم رسمي

projects.title: أمان هو تطبيق ذكي مبتكر لحماية الطلاب من روابط التصيد والاحتيال…
projects.desc: أمان هو تطبيق ذكي مبتكر لحماية الطلاب من روابط التصيد والاحتيال الإلكتروني، يفحص الروابط المشبوهة تلقائياً قبل فتحها وينبه المستخدم فوراً عند وجود خطر. يتميز بواجهة بسيطة وآمنة وإشعارات فورية وسجل للفحص ونصائح للتوعية الرقمية، ويهدف لرفع الوعي بالأمن السيبراني في المدارس عبر اختبارات تفاعلية ومحاكاة للتصيد ومتابعة تقدم الطلاب والمعلمين، كما يوفر تجربة تصفح آمنة مصممة خصيصاً للطلاب والمدارس في المملكة العربية السعودية لضمان تعلم مستمر وأثر قابل للقياس ويساعد على بناء جيل رقمي واع وآمن تماما الآن.

projects.title: AI AirGuard
projects.desc: نظام ذكي لتنقية ومراقبة جودة الهواء في المصانع والشوارع، يجمع بين الحساسات البيئية والرادار وإنترنت الأشياء والذكاء الاصطناعي. تقيس CO وCO₂ وVOCs وPM2.5 وPM10 وNOx وSO₂، بينما تراقب حساسات الرادار حركة المركبات وكثافة المرور لتحديد مصادر التلوث. يمر الهواء عبر فلاتر، ثم تُقاس جودته قبل وبعد التنقية لحساب الكفاءة، ويُعاد العلاج عند الحاجة. يحلل الذكاء الاصطناعي البيانات ويتحكم تلقائياً في التنقية، ويتنبأ بارتفاع التلوث والتنبيهات، مما يحسن جودة الهواء ويقلل استهلاك الطاقة ويدعم الصيانة الوقائية.!

projects.title: OsteoNova
projects.desc: 4D Smart Orthopaedic Delivery System: An Injectable Piezo-Immunomodulatory Nanocomposite Hydrogel Integrated with Elastocaloric Cooling for Critical Bone Defect Regeneration.

projects.title: BIOSORBENT TECHNOLOGY.
projects.desc: What if waste could help clean our water? BioSorb transforms discarded orange peels into biosorbent beads designed to remove pollutants from contaminated water. By turning an abundant waste material into a functional, recoverable treatment medium. It's performance is evaluated against plain-alginate beads through quantitative colour-removal analysis. BioSorb connects sustainability, innovation, and accessible water treatment in one idea. Paving the way for application at an industrial level.

projects.title: Mawthiq (موثّق) is an AI-powered cybersecurity shield designed to…
projects.desc:
Mawthiq (موثّق) is an AI-powered cybersecurity shield designed to safeguard Saudi Arabia's digital ecosystem against targeted phishing and domain impersonation.
Why It Matters:
 Tailored for Saudi Arabia: Validates links against official national registries (⁠.gov.sa⁠) and parses local dialect nuances.  
 Lightning-Fast Security: Blocks OTP theft and spoofed URLs in <0.8 seconds with a 99.4% precision rate.  
 Instant Visual Clarity: Displays clear threat badges (🟢 Official | 🔴 Phishing) befor

projects.title: Adaptive Smart Irrigation: A Soil-Moisture-Based System for Precise and Sustainable Watering
projects.desc: Smart Irrigation is an automated system designed to reduce water waste by monitoring soil moisture and providing water only when the plant needs it. The system uses a soil moisture sensor and Arduino controller and water pump to control irrigation automatically. It aims to improve water use efficiency and maintain suitable soil moisture while supporting sustainable agriculture. This makes it a practical solution for dry regions such as Saudi Arabia.

projects.title: NAJIX – Smart Dynamic Fire Evacuation System
projects.desc: «ناجيكس» نظام ذكي لإدارة الإخلاء أثناء الحرائق، يدمج أنظمة كشف الحرائق والإنذار مع الكاميرات وتقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي لمراقبة المبنى وتحليل حالته بشكل مستمر. يحدد النظام موقع الحريق ومستوى الخطر، ويرصد الدخان ومواقع الأشخاص والمناطق المتأثرة، ثم يستخدم خرائط المبنى لتحديد مسار الإخلاء الأكثر أمانًا. ومع تغير الخطر، يُحدّث المسار تلقائيًا ويوجّه الأشخاص عبر الإضاءة الذكية والإرشادات الصوتية، مع إرسال تنبيهات للجهات المختصة.

projects.title: FridgeMind: Sensor-Based Refrigerator Inventory & Automated Grocery Ordering System
projects.desc: FridgeMind is a sensor-based refrigerator inventory and automated grocery ordering system that monitors food quantities and detects when items need replenishment. It prepares grocery orders through compatible delivery applications based on user-defined thresholds and schedules, with optional user approval. Built-in spending limits, alerts, and duplicate-order protection provide safer and more controlled automation.

projects.title: Lamhah AI: Guided Hints, Not Final Answers
