projects.desc: Lamhah AI is an educational assistant that analyzes a student’s handwritten attempt, identifies the first incorrect step, and provides progressive hints without revealing the final answer. The student retries independently, while the teacher receives a dashboard of recurring misconceptions. The project promotes critical thinking, self-correction, personalized learning, and academic integrity in mathematics and science.

projects.title: Mana'a: Smart Scam Checker and Verification Guide
projects.desc: Mana'a is a web platform that stops scams before they succeed. Users paste a suspicious message, link or screenshot, or describe a call. Instead of guessing, Mana'a asks quick questions, like who started the contact and what a code is for, then uses AI to explain red flags in simple Arabic or English. Each answer ends with a clear action that is safe whether the caller is real or fake, like calling back on the official number. An "I already clicked" guide limits damage fast.

projects.title: أسمعُ بعيني/ Hear with my eyes
projects.desc: Hear with My Eyes—When AI Gives Silence a Voice A smart app, designed with cutting-edge AI to grant the deaf a window to the world. It turns speech into clear text while decoding tone and emotion, serving as a protective shield against dangers like alarms or screams. It is not merely a substitute ear, but an AI-powered seeing eye and a bridge collapsing isolation, because every sound deserves to be seen.

projects.title: الحارس الذكي: أجهزة مُتحكَّم بها تُقلِّل من طباعة الكتب المدرسية الورقية.
projects.desc: الحارس الذكي نظام مدرسي لإدارة ومراقبة أجهزة الطلاب، يتيح للمعلم التحكم في التطبيقات المسموحة، ومتابعة الأجهزة المتصلة، وتنبيه الطالب عند الخروج عن النظام لمدة 30 ثانية، ثم إبلاغ المعلم. يعتمد النظام أولًا على قواعد بسيطة ودقيقة، مثل التحقق من المواقع المسموحة وإشارة حياة كل 30 ثانية لاكتشاف انقطاع الجهاز. ويُستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي عند الحاجة لكشف الأنماط، وتصنيف المواقع الجديدة، وتلخيص التنبيهات، وترتيبها حسب أهميتها، يساعد هذا المشروع على التقليل من الهدر في طباعة الكتب الورقية.

projects.title: RAWI
projects.desc: راوي هو نظام روبوتي ذكي لاستكشاف وتوثيق المواقع التراثية باستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي. يجمع البيانات البصرية والمكانية عبر الكاميرات والمستشعرات، ويحللها باستخدام الرؤية الحاسوبية وتعلم الآلة لتحديد الخصائص وتقدير الفترة التاريخية، مع توظيف الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي لإعادة تصور الموقع تاريخيًا وبعد الترميم. يهدف المشروع إلى رفع كفاءة التوثيق وتقليل مخاطر الاستكشاف الميداني، ومن المتوقع أن يسهم في حفظ التراث ودعم البحث العلمي وتطوير التجارب السياحية.

projects.title: AI + AR Coach: A Personal Trainer for Speaking
projects.desc: The fear of public speaking (glossophobia) is the most common phobia, Common problem، and hindering professional and academic advancement. We developed an innovative AI, a personal public speaking coach using AI and interactive augmented reality. It analyzes tone of voice and body language, adapts text, and evaluates performance. Process: recording, defining topic and context, intelligent analysis, and practice, giving a comprehensive evaluation and feedback on areas for improvement

projects.title: نظام البلاغ عن الحوادث الذكي
projects.desc: تطبيق يتم تحميله على اجهزه الجوال وربطه ب GPS وعند حصول الحادث في مناطق وطرقات السفر من خلال صوت الاصطدام يصدر الهاتف رنين إذا تم إسكات الرنين من قبل الشخص يكون الشخص بخير واذا لم يتم يكون الشخص مصاب وفاقد للوعي فيتم إرسال رسائل إلى اقرب مركز شرطه وأقرب مركز اسعاف وايضاً ارقام يكون الشخص رابطها بالتطبيق من الاقارب ويرسل معها الموقع الدقيق

projects.title: مِرْصاد MIRSAD
projects.desc:
MERSAD is a centralized smart system that monitors school resources using sensors distributed across every floor and facility. The system collects and analyzes consumption data in real-time, displaying it on a unified dashboard that shows the status of each area. It issues alerts upon detecting abnormal consumption, potential leaks, or sudden spikes or drops in energy usage. In essence, MERSAD aims
 to provide school management with clearer visibility, enabling them to take appropriate actions

projects.title: SmartScan Oil is a portable olive oil screening prototype combining…
projects.desc: SmartScan Oil is a portable olive oil screening prototype combining visible and near-infrared measurements with a Random Forest classifier. Evaluated on 100 physical samples with sample-level separation between training and testing, it achieved 93% accuracy on 200 held-out scans in under 8 seconds per screening. It helps prioritize suspicious samples for laboratory confirmation, while low-level adulteration remains a key detection challenge.

projects.title: Mis Bus Tracker
projects.desc:
MIS Bus Tracker is a smart school bus safety system designed to protect students and prevent them from being left behind, forgotten, or delayed during transportation. Using facial recognition, GPS tracking, and instant alerts, the system records each student’s boarding status and helps schools monitor bus movement in real time.

It reduces manual work, saves time, improves punctuality, and gives parents confidence that their children arrive safely.

projects.title: sakk
projects.desc: SAKK is a sovereign zero-retention verification platform. It guarantees PDF integrity via SHA-256 and ECDSA (secp256r1) digital signatures stamped as vector QR seals. Files are processed purely in volatile memory (0 B disk retention), eliminating data breaches and ensuring 100% compliance with Saudi PDPL. Verified under 15ms latency with dual programmatic and optical channels. Live platform: https://sakk.site

projects.title: monipalm| مراقبة النخله
projects.desc: MoniPalm is a smart system that transforms traditional palm monitoring into proactive, data-driven care. Using IoT and multiple sensors, it monitors temperature, soil moisture, gases, and internal vibrations to detect early signs of pest infestation and tree stress. Machine learning analyzes the collected data and sends real-time, location-based alerts to farmers, enabling early intervention, reducing crop losses, and supporting smarter, more sustainable agriculture.

projects.title: يهدف المشروع إلى تطوير مؤشر رقمي لدراسة الإجهاد المعرفي باستخدام…
projects.desc: يهدف المشروع إلى تطوير مؤشر رقمي لدراسة الإجهاد المعرفي باستخدام حركة العين وزمن الاستجابة. يعتمد النظام على اختبار بصري عبر الهاتف، تُقاس خلاله سرعة الاستجابة، دقة الإجابات، الأخطاء وبعض مؤشرات حركة العين، ثم تُحلل البيانات إحصائيًا لمقارنة الأداء عند مستويات مختلفة من الحمل المعرفي. يسعى المشروع إلى معرفة إمكانية دمج هذه المؤشرات في نموذج واحد منخفض التكلفة، مع إمكانية تطويره مستقبلًا بالذكاء الاصطناعي، دون استخدامه للتشخيص الطبي.

projects.title: WadiGuard: A Kinematic Spatiotemporal Early Warning System for Flash Floods in Arid Wadis
projects.desc: Traditional wadi-monitoring stations alert only after water reaches their own location, leaving downstream areas with little to no warning time. WadiGuard addresses this gap through a network of sequential stations that track the spatial and temporal rate of water-level rise (dh/dt), enabling early warning before a flood wave reaches populated areas downstream. The system moves beyond single-point detection toward wave-behavior modeling across the wadi.

projects.title: مثبطات محتملة لعلاج داء السكري من النوع الثاني
projects.desc:
يهدف هذا المشروع إلى تصميم وتحضير مشتقات جديدة من خلال دمج هيكل 7-Azaindole مع مجموعة Sulfonyl لتطوير مثبطات محتملة لإنزيمي α-Amylase وα-Glucosidase، وهما إنزيمان رئيسيان في هضم الكربوهيدرات وارتفاع مستويات الجلوكوز بعد الوجبات. 
تم تحضير وتقييم عدد من المشتقات لدراسة تأثير نوع وموضع الاستبدال على النشاط التثبيطي. أظهرت النتائج اختلافًا واضحًا في الفعالية، حيث برز المركب 9 (4-CF₃) كأحد أكثر المركبات نشاطًا ضد الإنزيمين، مما يدعم إمكانية تطوير هذه المشتقات كمركبات واعدة للتحكم في ارتفاع الجلوكوز.

projects.title: building a dust emission index in desert environments
projects.desc: Development of a local framework for building a dust susceptibility index in desert environments using spatial analysis and satellite data : an applied study in the Prince Mohammed bin Salman royal reserve

projects.title: Sovereign Defender
projects.desc:
Sovereign Defender: A Zero-Egress Security Operations Platform with Kernel-Level XDP Containment and Provenance-Labeled Telemetry

1. Problem. Security teams often lose critical minutes between detecting and containing a threat, yet fully automated responses risk disrupting legitimate users. Because valid credentials no longer guarantee legitimate activity, every defensive action must be accountable. Many regulated organizations also cannot send telemetry to external clouds, and their dashboards

projects.title: AI-Powered Toxic Gas Extraction Device
projects.desc: OxyGuard Pro is a smart ceiling-mounted device designed to combat fire hazards and toxic gases like carbon monoxide. Powered by AI, it monitors room temperature, counts trapped occupants, estimates remaining safe oxygen time, and automatically extracts toxic gases. Equipped with a camera and microphone, it enables direct communication with those inside while sending phone alerts and linking directly to Civil Defense to prevent suffocation and speed up emergency response

projects.title: IAGSS
projects.desc: A mine-detecting drone utilizes an advanced sensor coil system consisting of two specialized coils: a transmitter coil and a receiver coil. The transmitter coil generates and emits electromagnetic waves toward the ground, while the receiver coil continuously monitors and captures the reflected electromagnetic signals. When a metallic object is present beneath the surface, the emitted electromagnetic waves interact with the metal and produce detectable changes in the reflected signal. The receive

projects.title: مشروع بحثي يهدف لتطوير محفز بيئي وفعال لتفكيك ملوثات المياه الخطيرة…
projects.desc: مشروع بحثي يهدف لتطوير محفز بيئي وفعال لتفكيك ملوثات المياه الخطيرة (PFAS) عبر تنشيط البيروكسي مونوسلفات (PMS). يعتمد على تحويل مخلفات نوى التمر إلى فحم حيوي (Biochar) مطعم بالحديد والمغنيسيوم (Fe/Mn). أظهرت نتائج الفحوصات (XRD و SEM) بنية مسامية وأطوارًا بلورية تضمن كفاءة عالية في تدمير روابط الملوثات وتحويلها لمركبات آمنة، مما يوفر حلاً مستدامًا واقتصاديًا لمعالجة مياه الصرف الصناعي.

projects.title: BovinePose AI
projects.desc: BovinePose AI is a mobile robot for contactless cattle health-risk screening. Using RGB and thermal cameras with Raspberry Pi edge processing, it analyzes posture, gait symmetry, and surface-temperature patterns, then sends an early-warning report to farmers and veterinarians. The prototype combines mobility, obstacle sensing, local AI processing, and rapid reporting. It supports routine herd monitoring but does not diagnose disease or replace veterinary examination.

projects.title: Liquid spill detector
projects.desc: The Liquid Spill Detector is a hydrogel-based sensor circuit that automatically detects liquid leaks on factory floors to prevent slip hazards and bacterial contamination. Undetected milk spills can create hygiene and health risks when left on surfaces for extended periods. Decomposing milk provides nutrients that can support bacterial and fungal growth, may facilitate the persistence of potential pathogens, and can attract flics, ants, and cockroaches, increasing the risk of contamination.

projects.title: SAIF Smart City AI Camera
projects.desc: Smart City AI Cameras transform standard video surveillance into proactive, real-time urban analytics platforms. Designed for municipal authorities, urban planners, traffic management agencies, and public safety organizations, these devices use edge computing and computer vision to improve city operations, traffic flow, and public security.

projects.title: Vibrotactile, Thermoregulated, 3D Printed Smart Cast for improved pain management and bone healing
projects.desc: An invention of a smart Orthopaedic cast system designed to promote and accelerate bone healing while reducing pain of broken limbs by embedding multiple linear resonant actuaters (LRAs) in a shell of a 3D printed cast to form a multi-channel vibrotactile array capable of delivering mechanical vibrations at frequencies and amplitude targeting beta nerve fibers and C-mechanoreceptors for antinoceptive pain relief and osteogenesis(bone healing), provide cool/hot compresses to reduce swelling.

projects.title: StudyBuddy EdTech
projects.desc: Study Buddy is a smart study assistant designed to help students study more effectively and independently. It uses an ESP32 and OLED display to provide Pomodoro timers, study reminders, motivational messages, and step-by-step guidance throughout a study session. Students can check in based on how they are feeling, allowing the robot to adjust their study and break durations. Its main purpose is to help students stay organized, focused, and consistent while studying.

projects.title: Harvesting Wind-Turbine Noise: A Tuned Helmholtz Resonator as a Renewable Energy Source
projects.desc: Wind turbines make clean electricity but also waste energy as noise. We designed a Helmholtz resonator, a cavity that amplifies sound at one frequency, and tuned it to a 48 Hz noise component reported for a small wind turbine. Our numerical model shows that a 3210 cm³ cavity amplifies the sound pressure about 143 times. This is a first step toward powering low-power sensors from turbine noise. Next, we will build a prototype with a magnet and coil to measure the electrical output.

projects.title: MIRSAD: Altitude-Aware Decision Support for Thermal Drone Search and Rescue
projects.desc: MIRSAD is a research-based decision-support prototype for thermal drone search and rescue. Analysis of 24,751 objects in 2,866 images showed how detection performance changes with altitude. At 130 m, person recall rose from 66.2% to 89.6% with multi-altitude training. An interactive dashboard presents measured performance and simulates model switching or altitude adjustment. Field validation is planned.

projects.title: حمد الرحال
projects.desc: حمد الرحّال رفيق تعليمي ذكي يعرّف الأطفال بالمملكة العربية السعودية بطريقة تفاعلية وممتعة. يوظف الذكاء الاصطناعي لتحويل استكشاف المدن والمعالم والتاريخ والتراث إلى رحلة تناسب عمر الطفل، تجمع بين القصص والأسئلة والتحديات والمكافآت. نطمح في نسخته المطورة إلى جعل الطفل مشاركًا في اكتشاف وطنه، لا مجرد متلقٍ للمعلومة، في تجربة تجمع بين التقنية والتعليم والهوية الوطنية.

projects.title: AI-Supported Suturing Mechanicism Using Magnetism and Fiber Bragg Grating Sensors
projects.desc:
concept for a mechanism that uses AI, electromagnetism and FBG sensors to preform a lockstitch through the dermis 
(as an alternative to the subcuticular continuous stitch).  It operates through a closed-loop system monitored by computer vision and sensor feedback. Meant to be implemented on a handheld device without requiring a large expensive setup and can used regularly and in emergency cases.

projects.title: نظام ذكي متكيف لدعم استعادة الانتباه لدى الطلاب أثناء المهام الصفية 2
projects.desc: يهدف مشروعي إلى تقليل تشتت الانتباه لدى الطلبة الذين يواجهون صعوبة بالانتباه، باستخدام نظام ذكي يجمع بين كاميرا وسوار للتنبيه. تتابع الكاميرا سلوك الطالب حسب نوع المهمة التي يؤديها، كالقراءة أو الاستماع، وعند استمرار تشتته يرسل السوار تنبيه خاص يساعده على العودة للمهمة. كما يستطيع الطالب تصحيح التنبيهات الخاطئة، فيتعلم النظام تدريجيا نمطه الخاص لكل مهمة، ويقيس سرعة عودته ومدة استمراره في التركيز، ويعرض مؤشرات عن تحسنه مع الوقت، بهدف تقليل التنبيهات غير الضرورية ودعم قدرته على تنظيم انتباهه بنفسه

projects.title: Mudood: Smart Education
projects.desc: Mudood is an AI-powered conversational educational platform that measures students’ understanding and provides personalized adaptive learning. It uses interactive dialogue and response analysis to identify learning needs and involve parents in guidance and follow-up. The proposed design can improve understanding personalize learning and strengthen the role of families in education. The platform can be expanded to support different curricula and educational stages

projects.title: KHUTA
projects.desc: KHUTA is a detachable module for white canes supporting daily mobility for blind and low-vision people without changing their technique. It provides early alerts for raised thresholds, curb edges, and open holes, notifying users if sensor readings become unreliable. Currently in the design and feasibility stage, the project is seeking development and trial partners for manufacturing.

projects.title: Sky-Aegis
projects.desc: Sky Aegis is a sovereign cyber physical defense platform engineered to protect critical infrastructure from electromagnetic and sensor spoofing attacks While conventional tools only secure software layers Sky Aegis uses Spectral AI to monitor physical signals detect wireless manipulation in real time and isolate spectral anomalies By neutralizing physical layer threats it guarantees operational resilience for defense and energy networks

projects.title: Iris/Ocular Controlled Advanced Wheelchair with AI safety features
projects.desc: IRIS is an AI-powered wheelchair that uses iris tracking for hands-free movement. IR sensors detect obstacles and dangerous drops, automatically slowing or stopping the chair. Its AI, Apex, adds smart safety through path awareness, red-light detection, and emergency-response simulation. Wireless control and a reclining mechanism improve comfort and independence. IRIS combines eye control, AI, and safety to give users greater freedom and confidence.

projects.title: ClassPulse ( نبض الصف )
projects.desc: ClassPulse (نبض الصف): نظام صفي ذكي يتيح للطلاب التعبير لحظيًا وبشكل مجهول عن حالة تعلمهم عبر واجهة لمسية بسيطة. يجمع النظام الاستجابات ويربطها بمراحل الدرس ليكشف نقاط التعثر فور حدوثها، ويعرض للمعلم مؤشرات وتوصيات تساعده على التدخل في الوقت المناسب، دون كاميرات أو تسجيل صوتي أو جمع بيانات شخصية، بما يعزز المشاركة ويحافظ على الخصوصية

projects.title: تحويل نوى التمر إلى وقود حيوي وطاقة مستدامة باستخلاص الزيت ومعالجته والاستفادة من المنتجات الثانوية.
projects.desc: هل سألت نفسك يومًا: أين تذهب مئات وآلاف الأطنان من نواة التمر؟ من هنا بدأت فكرتنا: تحويل هذا المخلف الزراعي إلى مصدر طاقة مستدام بدلًا من إهداره، من خلال جمع النوى وتجهيزها وطحنها واستخلاص الزيت منها ثم معالجته لإنتاج وقود حيوي يمكننا الاستفادة منه في السيارات وتوليد الكهرباء والتطبيقات الصناعية والطاقة الحرارية. ويطمح المشروع إلى توفير مورد طاقة متجدد، وتقليل الاعتماد على الوقود التقليدي، والمساهمة في خفض الانبعاثات وتلوث الهواء ودعم حماية الغلاف الجوي، مع تطوير حلول مستدامة.

projects.title: Masary AI builds a digital identity for students before they enter…
projects.desc: Masary AI builds a digital identity for students before they enter the workforce, bringing their skills, certificates, achievements, interests, and learning journey together. AI helps students discover their strengths and recommends relevant courses and opportunities. Educational institutes can create profiles and showcase their courses and programs. Masary AI also provides an interactive student community for sharing experiences and promoting a culture of learning and continuous development

projects.title: The Al-Ahsa Plastisphere: Isolation & characterization of local bacterial strains to degrade LDPE
projects.desc: The global accumulation of non-degradable plastic waste has become an escalating environmental emergency. Worldwide, annual plastic production has surged past 400 million tons, with Low-Density Polyethylene having roughly 35% of total consumer plastic waste. In Saudi Arabia alone, approximately 7 million tons of plastic are discarded annually. Which  is 2% of worlds plastic waste or  225.6% of Saudi landmass (1 ton/km^2) .Our project is designed to biodegrade the plastic by using bacteria.

projects.title: This project presents a smart perovskite photodetector designed to…
projects.desc: This project presents a smart perovskite photodetector designed to detect light effectively in both indoor and outdoor environments. Unlike conventional sensors that may require separate devices for different lighting conditions, this device uses bandgap engineering and interface passivation to achieve a broad and reliable response with a single device. The fabricated photodetector achieved an EQE of 71.13%, a responsivity of 0.4 A/W, and a detectivity of 1.3 × 10¹⁰ Jones. Its response increased

projects.title: FALCON-X SWARM: An Autonomous Multi-UAV System for Intelligent Search and Rescue
projects.desc: FALCON-X is a low-cost autonomous UAV developed for Search and Rescue in deserts, forests, and mountains. It combines RGB imaging, YOLOv12 AI detection, GPS localization, target verification, and survival-package delivery. Tests achieved 95%, 88%, and 84% detection accuracy across different environments, 39 min flight endurance, ≤1.2 m delivery error, and 85% communication stability at 2 km, supporting faster search and immediate survival assistance.

projects.title: Mawj prevents crowd crushes by warning the back of the crowd
projects.desc: Mawj prevents crowd crushes by warning the back of the crowd. When the front stops, a sensor at the exit detects it and within a second red lights on poles along the route turn on and the entrance closes, so people stop before those in front get crushed. It then restarts safely: green from front to back, then metered entry. Fully automatic, language-free, no mobile network needed, and it complements monitoring systems like Baseer. In simulation, dangerous crush exposure dropped to zero.

projects.title: الصوبة الذكية
projects.desc: روبوتات الزراعة هي آلات متقدمة مبرمجة لأداء مهام زراعية محددة بشكل آلي وفعال.  وأجهزة الاستشعار لتقديم حلول مبتكرة للمزارعين، مما يساعدهم في تحسين الإنتاجية وتقليل التكاليف فقمنا ببناء ملعب للروبوت على شكل بيت محمى داخله  مجموعه من الزراعات والثمرات يقوم فية الروبوت بحل بعض المشاكل التى ممكن أن تتواجد فى هذا النواع من الزراعة مثل اكتشاف مدى استوائية التربة وذلك من خلال حساس guro sensor وايضا اكتشاف القطع الذى ممكن أن يتواجد فى جدار الصوبة الزراعية من خلال حساس اللون

projects.title: Easy Talk
projects.desc:
Easy Talk is an innovative AI-powered application designed to support people who experience stuttering and speech difficulties. The application analyzes users’ speech and uses AI to identify pronunciation and fluency challenges.
Based on the analysis, Easy Talk provides personalized speech exercises and age-appropriate educational content, creating an individualized training experience for every user. The application also enables users to monitor their progress and practice at their own pace.

projects.title: A Smart Wearable Glove for Real-Time Sign Language Recognition and Translation into Spoken Words
projects.desc: A smart glove that translates sign language into spoken words is an innovative technological solution designed to empower people with speech impairments and facilitate their daily communication with society easily and independently The glove reads hand movements and gestures and instantly converts them into audible speech In the future we propose transforming the glove into a smart watch to make it easier and more comfortable to wear while reducing hand heat and sweating during

projects.title: Automated Sorting Smart Bin with an Incentive Parity System
projects.desc: A smart bin solution automating source-based waste sorting using AI and computer vision via an ESP32-CAM module. The system maximizes sorting efficiency and recyclable purity to minimize environmental pollution. It integrates a gamified incentive mechanism issuing real-time digital rewards via QR codes, boosting public engagement and supporting Saudi Vision 2030 environmental sustainability targets

projects.title: Smart firefighter Helmet for enhancing safety and early hazard detection
projects.desc: Firefighters face dangers and delayed communication. Smart-Shield is a low-cost helmet with ultrasonic, flame, gas, and motion sensors; an ESP32 sends live alerts via Wi-Fi to a command dashboard. Tests showed 99.2% obstacle detection in smoke, 70% faster RIT searches, and 5/5 success for flame, gas, and collapse alerts. Affordable parts and an all-in-one design make it cost-effective. It supports Vision 2030 and SDGs 3 and 8, targeting fire departments, Civil Defense, and high-risk industries.

projects.title: SADEEM: A SECURE AI EDUCATIONAL GALAXY
projects.desc: Problem: Children waste time on unsafe, unproductive apps, causing parental anxiety. Solution: Sadeem is a secure native Android app built with Java to gamify education. It features a PIN-secured Parental Control Panel to block unauthorized child access. Crucially, the platform integrates a localized, on-device AI tool on the "Discover My Talent" planet, safely analyzing gameplay patterns to identify children's talents without capturing biometric data.

projects.title: This project presents a Proactive Road Accident Warning System…
projects.desc: This project presents a Proactive Road Accident Warning System using AI, aerial imagery, YOLOv8, and V2X technology. It detects road hazards and sends visual and auditory warnings to approaching drivers 1.2 km before an incident. The TRL 4 prototype achieved 83% car and 66% truck detection accuracy, with an average processing latency of 377.3 ms, enabling proactive warnings and wider coverage without extensive ground infrastructure.

projects.title: Mariam Water filter
projects.desc: y project is an integrated, portable water purification and sterilization system that utilizes a carbon filter and UV-C technology, powered by solar energy. The project aims to provide a practical and sustainable water purification solution for locations lacking suitable infrastructure, as well as for trips and camping. It features ease of use, portability, and reliance on renewable energy, making it environmentally friendly and cost-effective to operate.

projects.title: Non-Invasive Salivary Glucose Biosensor for Continuous Health Monitoring in Microgravity
projects.desc: This project develops an innovative, non-invasive biosensor for accurate glucose monitoring through saliva, eliminating the need for blood samples and painful finger-pricking. Advanced sensing technology enables continuous, comfortable monitoring for people with diabetes and astronauts. The proposed solution reduces infection risks, improves user comfort, and provides a sustainable, practical approach to health monitoring in challenging environments.

projects.title: مصيدة المايكرو بلاستيك microplistics
projects.desc:
نظام ذكي متعدد المراحل يهدف إلى التقاط جزئيات  0.2 Microtrap
الميكروبلاستيك من المياه وقياس كفاءة إزالتها ، يجمع بين الترشيح المتدرج ،والألياف الدقيقة ، وطبقة مخصصة لالتقاط الجزئيات ، إضافة إلى حساسات لمراقبة تدفق المياه وحالة الفلتر ، صمم ليكون منخفض التكلفة سهل الصيانة وقابلا للتطوير ،للمساهمة في تقليل التلوث بالميكروبلاستيك وحماية البيئة المائية .

projects.title: RideGuard
projects.desc: Sometimes a child can be forgotten inside a school bus after the trip ends. RideGuard is a low-cost device that reminds the driver to check the whole bus. One minute after the engine is switched off, a buzzer and a red light start automatically. They stop only when the driver walks to the back of the bus and presses a button, so the driver checks the seats on the way.

projects.title: Project NAQAA (نقاء) tackles dust contamination that reduces…
projects.desc: Project NAQAA (نقاء) tackles dust contamination that reduces solar-panel output in Saudi Arabia. It upgrades EDS into a retrofit-ready, waterless self-cleaning system. A transparent electrode film can be applied to existing panels without changing manufacturing. Sensors and AI activate cleaning only when needed: dry-dust removal, predictive dew protection, and piezoelectric vibration to break hardened soiling and bird droppings. NAQAA combines EDS, AI and hydrophobic protection for desert farms.

projects.title: RoboGuide
projects.desc: Robo Guide is a smart service robot designed to improve visitors’ experiences by providing guidance, information, and recommendations. It can be programmed to serve guests in airports, hospitals, exhibitions, historical places, and other public spaces. The robot can also detect obstacles and stop safely, making it a practical and adaptable solution for different environments.

projects.title: Palm Leaf Waste-to-Hydrogen Conversion via Modified Graphene Oxide-Supported Ni-Co Electrocatalyst
projects.desc: Clean energy deployment is limited by costly noble-metal catalysts for green hydrogen production, while unused palm leaf waste poses environmental challenges. To solve both issues, palm waste was converted into graphene oxide (GO) loaded with Ni/Co nanocomposites as a sustainable electrocatalyst. Ni/Co (1:1)-GO exhibited superior performance for hydrogen evolution in acidic and alkaline media. A benchtop cell produced ≈1.5L H₂ over 24h with 90% stability, proving a scalable waste-to-value strate

projects.title: Rafiq app / تطبيق رافق ..... "Rafiq your child through their treatment journey
projects.desc: According to Nationwide Children’s, pediatric studies found 63,000 children under six were exposed annually to medication errors outside hospitals from 2002 to 2012, meaning one child every 8 minutes. This may happen when parents forget medication or mix up siblings’ medicines. MDPI and PubMed showed similar concerns. My idea is an app that reminds parents about medications, check-ins, and doctor questions, with a separate profile for each child for reminders, medicines, and notes

projects.title: Green Biofabrication of AG/TiO2 Via Mushroom Extract for Advanced Photocatalytic Water Remediation
projects.desc: Industrial water pollution threatens humanity's future and vital water resources. This game-changing innovation sparks an environmental revolution by synthesizing eco-friendly advanced Ag/TiO_2 nanomaterials using organic mushroom extract. The breakthrough solution leverages cutting-edge photocatalytic technology to rapidly and completely eradicate toxic pollutants. It is the ultimate market-ready, low-cost powerhouse for next-generation water purification, setting a bold new standard for global

projects.title: Smart AI Box for Food & Medicine Temperature Prediction During Transport
projects.desc: Smart Transport Guard keeps food and medicine safe on the move. Using low-cost sensors and a Random Forest AI model, it predicts temperature changes during transport with high accuracy (R² up to 0.92), so problems are caught before products spoil. Portable, affordable, and fits any transport box. Built for logistics companies, hospitals, and food suppliers who can't afford waste or risk. Smarter cold chain, safer products, healthier people.

projects.title: Sun Walk is a modern and welcoming website created to bring people…
projects.desc: Sun Walk is a modern and welcoming website created to bring people together through walking, outdoor activities, and healthy lifestyles. Our goal is to inspire people to enjoy nature, stay active, and discover the benefits of walking. Whether you are looking for walking ideas, useful tips, or a way to connect with others, Sun Walk makes every step more enjoyable. Join us, explore new paths, and take a brighter step toward a healthier lifestyle.

projects.title: صائد الضوضاء الذكي
projects.desc: صائد الضوضاء الذكي

projects.title: InvoiceAI هو جهاز ذكي لمعالجة وأرشفة الفواتير، يلتقط الفاتورة…
projects.desc:
InvoiceAI هو جهاز ذكي لمعالجة وأرشفة الفواتير، يلتقط الفاتورة ويستخدم OCR وBarcode وQR لاستخراج بياناتها وتنظيمها تلقائيًا في Excel، مع ربط البيانات بالفاتورة الأصلية لتسهيل البحث والمراجعة.
يهدف المشروع إلى تقليل الإدخال اليدوي والأخطاء، وتوفير الوقت، وتحويل الفواتير من مستندات ورقية إلى سجلات رقمية منظمة وقابلة للأرشفة والاسترجاع

projects.title: Smart Assessment with AR and AI: Learning Through Movement and Discovery
projects.desc: This project introduces a smart assessment tool that combines Augmented Reality (AR) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to connect learning concepts with the classroom environment. Students select a lesson, move around the classroom, and use the camera to discover real-world examples of the target concept. AI analyzes the elements, checks responses, and provides instant feedback, transforming students’ movement and energy into an active experience of exploration, discovery, and learning.

projects.title: This project aims to develop a coating for self-healing capsules…
projects.desc: This project aims to develop a coating for self-healing capsules used to protect oil pipelines from corrosion by studying the addition of EVA to paraffin. Development focuses on improving damage resistance while maintaining flexibility and stability. The developed coating will be compared with the basic paraffin coating by assessing damage resistance, deformation, and stability, aiming to provide a more suitable coating for self-healing protection systems while simplifying manufacturing process.

projects.title: An AI System for Automated Crown–Root Segmentation in Dental CBCT Using Synthetic Annotation
projects.desc: Dental CBCT provides 3D tooth anatomy, but manually separating crowns from roots is time-consuming and limits large-scale analysis. I created an anatomically guided synthetic-annotation pipeline and a dedicated AI model to automate crown-root segmentation. On manually labeled teeth, the model achieved a mean Dice score of 0.904, demonstrating its potential to support clinicians and dental researchers in treatment planning, crown-root analysis and dental imaging research.

projects.title: Aflatoxin B1 is a harmful toxin that can contaminate animal feed…
projects.desc: Aflatoxin B1 is a harmful toxin that can contaminate animal feed and threaten animal health and food safety. This project explores the use of natural products, including date pits and seeds, as sustainable adsorbents to reduce Aflatoxin B1 contamination in animal feed. The goal is to develop a safer, more natural, and environmentally friendly approach to improving feed safety while making use of locally available agricultural resources.

projects.title: Desert dust can cut solar panel output by over a third, yet…
projects.desc: Desert dust can cut solar panel output by over a third, yet cleaning is usually blind and water-intensive. SolarClean AI quantifies soiling from an overhead camera: homography-rectified images yield a Soiling Index (SI%) from texture-contrast loss, and when SI >= 8.5% an ESP32 drives a dry silicone wiper, then re-checks the panel. On a 100 W module, SI% tracked power loss (R² = 0.988), vision accuracy was 96.8% on 250 frames, and one pass restored 98.8% of clean output using zero water.

projects.title: مشروع "صميم
projects.desc: مشروع "صميم": جسر ذكي للترجمة الفورية بين لغة الإشارة والكلام المنطوق والمكتوب عبر الذكاء الاصطناعي لدمج ذوي الإعاقة السمعية. يعالج التطبيق صعوبات التواصل اليومي، متابعة التلفاز، نقص المترجمين، والعزلة المهنية. يقدم حلولاً ثنائية الاتجاه: تحويل الإشارة لكلام، وتحويل الكلام لشخصية افتراضية ثلاثية الأبعاد (أفاتار). أهدافه: التمكين الاجتماعي، السرعة، ونشر الوعي الثقافي. "صَمِيم".. إنارة للغة الإشارة، حيث ينطق الصمت وتتكلم الإشارة بلا حدود.

projects.title: Ma'abar: The Smart Automated Security Gate for Managing Hajj Buses
projects.desc: This project presents a hybrid system for managing Hajj bus gates, combining automated entry control via RF technology with real-time digital logging, alongside human-supervised exit checks for security. It prevents permit duplication and tailgating, and its low-cost design makes it scalable for transport companies and government entities, supporting smooth traffic flow and digital record-keeping in line with Vision 2030.

projects.title: PLASTI-LYSIS
projects.desc:
An autonomous dual robotic system (Earth Rover & Marine Submarine) for microplastic remediation.
Features dual-sensing logic to classify plastics and direct targeted enzymatic injection. Uses a closed-loop ultrafiltration membrane that recycles enzymes with zero loss while discharging purified water, powered by ESP32 microcontrollers and integrated with Blynk loT for real-time GPS tracking and live telemetry.

projects.title: AtmoShield
projects.desc: In hot arid climates, air pollution is worsened by solar radiation and temperature inversion. Most filtration systems run at full capacity, wasting energy, while smart systems often react only after pollutants enter indoor spaces. Our project addresses this using two Linear Regression ML models: one predicts PM2.5 and the other O3. A conditional system uses these predictions to adjust fan speed. A sensor-based override corrects filtration when predictions are inaccurate.

projects.title: orca lift
projects.desc: Orca Lift is the AI-powered gym coach built for the Middle East in Arabic and English. Instead of just telling you what to do, it explains why: the science behind every rep range, exercise, and progression, on demand, whenever you need it. Track your lifts with strength charts, PRs, and a consistency heatmap. Challenge friends to duels, build a crew, and grow stronger together(orca is on iOS too). No gimmicks, no guesswork just training you actually understand. access is free. Train with science

projects.title: طاولة روبوت ذكيه لفئة الصم والبكم ومحتويات الطاوله هي طاوله وكرسي…
projects.desc: طاولة روبوت ذكيه لفئة الصم والبكم ومحتويات الطاوله هي طاوله وكرسي مرتبطه ببعضها البعض و تحمل شخصين شخص من فئة الصم والبكم وشخص من الفئه العامه ومحتوياتها طاوله يكون جهاز لوحي ذكي في النص ويكون في الطاوله عامود يكون فيه كاميرا ثلاثية الأبعاد تلقط حركة اليد ويحولها إلى صوت ويكون فيه مكرفون  ويوجد نظام التنبيه الحسي ومحركات اهتزازيه و نظام تحويل الإشاره إلى نص وصوت ونظام تحويل الصوت إلى نص ونظام الإضاءة والأهتزاز الذكي ويوجد على الطاوله قلم للكتابه.

projects.title: وٍصال | Wesal
projects.desc: Wisal is an AI-powered communication application designed to make communication easier between deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals and people who do not know sign language. Using the camera, Wisal recognizes sign language gestures and converts them into text or speech. The other person can respond through text or speech, which is then converted into sign language. The application provides an accessible, bidirectional communication solution that promotes understanding and inclusion

projects.title: ECO ROOT GUARD
projects.desc: Eco Root Guard makes the hidden root zone visible. It combines root images with temperature, pH and TDS readings to help growers spot warning signs and inspect hydroponic crops. The project reports 2,000+ image and sensor records from a 14-day prototype run. With an estimated US$45 parts budget, it targets small and remote farms. Future development will evaluate offline access, solar autonomy, DO/ORP sensing and controlled aeration with rechecks.

projects.title: Astrafire
projects.desc: Astrafire helps rescuers find students during a school fire. Each student wears a small badge that sends a radio signal about once a second. A receiver in every classroom hears it and reports how loudly, and the system compares all the receivers to work out which room the badge is most likely in — and says so with a confidence, or reports the room as unknown when it cannot tell. The teacher's phone shows every room at a glance: a room turns red when someone there needs help, and the phone rings

projects.title: ViperGuard AI
projects.desc:
تجسيدا لرؤية مسابقه الأمن والابتكار العالمية يقدم مشروعنا
ViperGuarad Al
 نقلة نوعية في مجال الأمن البيئي والوقاية الفورية في الاراضي المفتوحة والمناطق النائية والزراعية 
الخطر لا ينتظر، ثوان معدودة قد تفصل بين خطأ بسيط وتهديد قاتل. ما سنقدمه ليست مجرد كاميرا مراقبه انها عين الذكاء الاصطناعي الفائقه السهلة الاستخدام التي تميز في أجزاء من الثانية بين الثعابين السامة وغير السامة
 دقة في الرصد بمعدل 93%
 سرعة في الإستجابة خلال 730 ms
 وحمايه ذكية ذات حساسية 92% للسامة و 94٪ لغير السامة

projects.title: Aliivibrio fischeri Biosensor for Evaluating Lead Nitrate Toxicity in Aquatic Environments
projects.desc: Water heavy metal pollution threatens ecosystems. This study evaluates Aliivibrio fischeri as a biosensor for lead nitrate toxicity. Exposed to serial dilutions, bacterial bioluminescence decreased with higher concentrations over time, confirming an inverse relationship. Aliivibrio fischeri offers an effective, practical tool for early aquatic toxicity detection.

projects.title: MechaPulse
projects.desc: MechaPulse is an AI-powered predictive maintenance platform that turns existing aircraft telemetry into component-health insights. It learns normal flight behavior without failure data, separates temporary disturbances from developing faults, scores each component's risk, and auto-updates the maintenance calendar. Impact: 30–50% less downtime, 20–50% less planning time, 10–20% more mission availability, and up to $200,000 saved per aircraft yearly.

projects.title: D&D Innovations
projects.desc: Poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) and a high-index polycarbonate-based polymer (HIP) were evaluated as thin films for automotive-lighting applications from 22.5°C to 70°C using spectroscopic ellipsometry. PMMA showed a 2.72% refractive-index decrease at 600 nm and a 0.68% thickness increase. HIP showed a temperature-induced refractive-index change below 1% and an approximately 1.6% thickness increase. Both materials maintained good visible transparency, supporting further thermal testing.

projects.title: The Edge Sensor Shield (ESS)
projects.desc: Edge Sensor Shield (ESS) is an ESP32-based hardware layer that detects and isolates False Data Injection Attacks (FDIA) on industrial sensors in real time. Placed inline between the sensor and control system, it validates signals physically at the edge—independent of cloud connectivity—triggering a hardware relay to isolate compromised sensors within milliseconds, protecting SCADA/ICS infrastructure from stealthy cyber-physical threats.

projects.title: This project develops a W/O/W double nanoemulsion combining cacao…
projects.desc: This project develops a W/O/W double nanoemulsion combining cacao polyphenols and inulin for colon-targeted prebiotic delivery. The system protects bioactives during gastrointestinal transit and supports beneficial gut bacteria. Experimental testing confirmed strong physicochemical stability and biocompatibility, while machine learning predicted increased targeting under colon-like conditions, offering a novel approach for early metabolic intervention.

projects.title: Freshwater scarcity demands faster development of high-performance…
projects.desc: Freshwater scarcity demands faster development of high-performance reverse osmosis (RO) membranes. This study presents a physics-informed machine learning framework using the Open Membrane Database to predict water permeability, water flux, and concentration polarization. Artificial neural networks achieved the strongest test performance (R²=0.965, 0.953, and 0.938), enabling data-driven screening of promising membrane designs while reducing reliance on trial-and-error fabrication.

projects.title: Compost Bot: From Beach Waste to Food Growth
projects.desc: Compost Bot turns the waste polluting Jeddah's beaches into free fertilizer that grows food. Three sensor-guided robots collect and sort coastal waste by colour and distance, grind the organic part into layered compost, and check its quality by measuring pH. In 3 weeks, food waste became natural compost; a lentil grown in it was about 25% taller with 60% more leaves than in soil alone. A low-cost solution for cleaner beaches, less methane and stronger food security, aligned with Vision 2030.

projects.title: Cardiovascular disease and shortage of donor hearts highlight the…
projects.desc: Cardiovascular disease and shortage of donor hearts highlight the need for new cardiac solutions. This project proposes a full-scale trilaminar 3D-bioprinted bioartificial heart integrating vascularization, electrical conductivity, synchronized stimulation, and mechanical support. Successful AuNP synthesis and characterization (527 nm UV–Vis peak) provide preliminary validation of the conductive component, while full fabrication and functional testing are planned as the next development stages.

projects.title: Vibration and Pneumatic System for Diesel Particulate Filter Ash Evacuation
projects.desc: Clogged diesel filters in heavy-duty vehicles increase backpressure, fuel consumption, and maintenance downtime because ash cannot be removed by thermal regeneration. Our system removes ash during operation using controlled vibration and directed airflow, collecting it in a removable capsule that can be emptied without exhaust disassembly. Preliminary modeling projects 40–60% lower backpressure, filter life beyond 300,000 km, and 3–4.5% fuel savings.

projects.title: Bayan (بيان)
projects.desc: Bayan (بيان) is an AI-driven digital health assistant designed to eliminate medication safety risks in multicultural environments. By strictly anchoring drug logic to official Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) datasets, Bayan prevents AI hallucinations while delivering real-time multi-drug interaction alerts, native LTR/RTL layout switching across 6 regional languages, and visual icon mapping tailored for low-literacy patient accessibility.

projects.title: فريق العقيق
projects.desc: Maktabat Platform is the all-in-one marketplace connecting libraries and customers in one smart,fast,and easy-to-use platform for stationery and printing services.It provides a modern solution for anyone seeking stationery or printing without traveling between shops or making individual calls.Customers can search for nearby libraries by proximity,rating,status,or city.Each library page displays available products,photos,exclusive coupons,working hours,exact locations,and live open-or-closed stat

projects.title: Smart Eye Blink Monitor
projects.desc: A wearable, integrated system designed to protect screen users from digital eye strain and dryness. It uses an Arduino board and infrared sensor to calculate the eye-blinking rate over one minute, with a variable resistor to customize the medical safety threshold (15–20 blinks per minute). When insufficient blinking is detected, an audible alarm encourages the user to blink and moisturize the eyes. The project offers an economical, practical solution that ensures privacy without camera access.

projects.title: صوت الحزم
projects.desc: منظومة دفاعية متكاملة تعتمد على شبكة مستشعرات للرصد الصوتي بالذكاء الاصطناعي لاكتشاف الدرونز وتحديد مواقعها لحظياً مع توجيه طائرات بدون طيار (درون اعتراضية) للتعامل مع الهدف وتحييده يهدف المشروع لتقديم حل وطني ذكي وموثوق لحماية الأجواء والمنشآت الحيوية بكفاءة عالية

projects.title: PalmTherm is a sustainable building tile designed to address two…
projects.desc:
PalmTherm is a sustainable building tile designed to address two challenges in hot climates: excessive heat transfer into buildings and the increasing amount of palm waste. The project uses locally available palm waste, such as palm fronds and fibers, combined with gypsum to create a lightweight and environmentally friendly thermal insulation tile.

The tile is designed to reduce heat transfer from the outside environment into buildings, which could help improve indoor thermal comfort and reduce

projects.title: Naqda bot "The first Naqda machine integrated with ai
projects.desc:
The Embroidery Machine (Naqda Bot) is the first system to automate the traditional Naqda craft, integrated with artificial intelligence

It helps preserve and protect intangible cultural heritage from disappearing

It also helps reduce the health risks faced by artisans and opens up new economic opportunities by increasing productivity and reducing the financial cost of traditional products

projects.title: Green Horizon . A sustainable Smart building for a brighter future
projects.desc:
Can a building envelope be designed to collect atmospheric moisture and use it to support vegetation while reducing surrounding temperature and water consumption?
Solar panels
Natural ventilation
Green walls and plants
Rainwater collection
Recycled materials
Heat-resistant design
Smart energy use

projects.title: Voiceless
projects.desc: Voiceless is a clinical identification and communication system for patients who cannot reliably identify themselves or communicate, such as unconscious patients, people with dementia, or those with language or speech barriers. It uses facial matching only to suggest identity, requires human confirmation, releases limited critical medical data, and provides communication support while ensuring no clinical action is based on a face match alone.

projects.title: نظام ذكي للإخلاء وقت الطوارئ يراقب لحظيًا حالة المخارج والممرات…
projects.desc: نظام ذكي للإخلاء وقت الطوارئ يراقب لحظيًا حالة المخارج والممرات والازدحام ومناطق الخطر، ويعيد حساب أكثر مسار آمن للإخلاء بدل الاعتماد على مسار ثابت. عند وقوع خطر كحريق أو دخان أو إغلاق مخرج، يعيد النظام توجيه الأشخاص تلقائيًا عبر لافتات ذكية ولوحة تحكم حية إلى البديل الأكثر أمانًا، مما يقلل التعرض للخطر ويمنع الازدحام عند المخارج

projects.title: AMAN_saif
projects.desc: AMAN is a native Android app protecting Alzheimer's patients who wander, a risk facing an estimated 130,000 Saudi families. Unlike trackers that alarm on every exit, AMAN learns the patient's daily routine and alerts family only on unusual movement, with escalating alerts and SMS fallback. A QR wristband lets a passer-by notify the family without seeing personal details, and the patient sees one button: Take me home, in a recorded family voice. Arabic-first, dignity-first.

projects.title: IMPROVING THE APPLICABILITY OF PROGRESSIVE CAVITY PUMP TECHNOLOGY ACROSS DIVERSE CONDITIONSom
projects.desc: Currently, there are many pumping systems that pump in specific well conditions, yet there isn't a single pumping solution that can handle all well conditions. Each well has unique conditions, such as temperature, gas content, and well depth. This causes most pumps to be abandoned in the well. The solution is to create a pump that adapts to varying well conditions while remaining more effective compared to existing pumping systems. Results show a 42% increase in production than standard pumps.

projects.title: FREQUENCY MIGRAINE TREATMENT DEVICE
projects.desc: يُعد الصداع المتكرر من أكثر المشكلات الصحية انتشارًا حول العالم، حيث يؤثر بشكل مباشر على جودة الحياة والإنتاجية والقدرة على التركيز. ومع تزايد ضغوط الحياة اليومية وساعات العمل الطويلة وفترات الدراسة المكثفة، أصبح البحث عن حلول فعالة وآمنة أمرًا ضروريًا. وانطلاقًا من هذه الحاجة، تم تطوير هذا الجهاز المبتكر ليقدم نهجًا جديدًا في التعامل مع الصداع المتكرر من خلال الاعتماد على التكنولوجيا الحديثة والذكاء الاصطناعي، مع التركيز على توفير تجربة علاجية آمنة وغير دوائية تساعد المستخدمين على تحسين حياتهم

projects.title: Namaa: A Smart Robot for Vertical Farm Care and Harvesting(نَمَاء)
projects.desc:
Namaa *is a smart robot designed for vertical farm care and harvesting. It navigates narrow aisles, reaches elevated growing levels, transports seedlings, and uses computer vision to identify crops ready for harvest. Namaa reduces workers’ time, effort, and exposure to climbing risks while improving farming efficiency and productivity in Saudi Arabia.
Instead of making people climb, we make the robot climb. Join us in building safer, smarter, and more efficient vertical farms with Namaa.

projects.title: AWRS (Aqua Well Robot Solution)
projects.desc: Traditional groundwater monitoring uses outdated tools, missing depth dependent chemistry and early structural damage. This risks sudden failure and water contamination. To solve this, we introduce AWRS: an integrated smart well inspection platform. Deployed in a single automated descent, AWRS combines multiple sensors for real time diagnostics. It features a novel AI powered EIS model to instantly classify minerals inside the well, transforming maintenance and safeguarding water safety.

projects.title: Q-Glu
projects.desc: Q-GLU is a groundbreaking, non-invasive medical device designed to measure blood glucose levels indirectly through exhaled breath analysis. By leveraging the biological link between blood glucose and breath acetone—a Volatile Organic Compound (VOC)—Q-GLU eliminates the need for painful finger-prick blood sampling. Powered by embedded microcontrollers, specialized gas sensors, and Artificial Intelligence (AI), Q-GLU delivers accurate, real-time glucose estimates while removing the burden of recur

projects.title: Cosmic Explorers
projects.desc: Meet Helio — our solar-powered explorer bot, built for the Moon's toughest terrain. One core, four rides: an Orbiting Platform for rest, a Walking Bot for scouting, a Trike for speed, and a Bug Bot for rough, loose ground. Inspired by Helios's zero-gravity engineering philosophy, Helio adapts to whatever the lunar surface demands — proving that smart, purpose-built mobility beats one-size-fits-all design. Cosmic Explorers: the future of adaptable space robotics, prototyped today.

projects.title: نظام إدارة وتصريف مياه الأمطار الذكي
projects.desc: ابتكار هندسي وتقني يهدف لحل مشكلة انسداد شبكات تصريف مياه الأمطار وتراكمها في الشوارع والأنفاق وأسطح المباني. يضم النظام جهازين: الأول للشوارع يعتمد على حساس يستشعر ارتفاع منسوب المياه ليتلقى متحكم الآردوينو الإشارة ويشغل شفرات حادة تقطع الأوراق والعوالق لتسهيل تدفق المياه للشبكة ومنع غرق المركبات. أما الجهاز الثاني فمخصص للأسطح لتصريف المياه المتراكمة وحماية المباني من الأضرار الانشائية. يعمل النظام بالطاقة الشمسية المستدامة، مع خطة تطوير مستقبلية لدمجه بالذكاء الاصطناعي وتطبيق إلكتروني.

projects.title: مفهوم دعامة لمراقبة توزيع الحمل بين طرفين لدى الخيول المصابة بكسور شديدة دراسة اولية باختبار الاوزان
projects.desc: اختبر هذا المشروع مبدأ قياس الحمل على أطراف الخيول المصابة بكسور شديدة، تمهيدًا لدعامة تراقب توزيع الحمل بين الطرف المصاب وطرف مرجعي، وتنذر عند تجاوز حد خطير. أُجريت تجربة أولية بميزان زنبركي وأثقال معايرة، وأظهرت دقة قياس عالية بنسبة اختلاف  لا تتجاوز 2٪؜ تدعم هذه النتائج الانتقال لمرحلة تطوير مستشعر إلكتروني ووحدة إنذار ضمن نظام متكامل، يساعد الطبيب البيطري على اتخاذ قرار سريري أدق خلال فترة التعافي

projects.title: Development of a Pelletized Palm Waste Adsorbent for Agricultural Wastewater Reuse
projects.desc: Farms generate tons of date palm waste, while agriculture faces severe water scarcity. Standard filters clog and break down fast. Our project solves both problems by turning palm waste into solid filtration pellets. They don't clog, allow smooth flow, and remove pollutants efficiently. Washable and reusable hundreds of times, these pellets deliver low-cost clean water—turning farm waste into real value

projects.title: VERA is a computer program that verifies molecular claims in…
projects.desc: VERA is a computer program that verifies molecular claims in exoplanet atmospheres. Different molecules can produce similar patterns, so a claim may look strong if another molecule was never tested. VERA removes claimed molecules, searches for competitors, compares models using Bayesian evidence, and checks their fit. Tests on 40,000 synthetic spectra showed the need for VERA. On JWST WASP-39 b data, VERA tested CO₂, H₂O and SO₂ claims, flagging the result when the models failed the fit check.

projects.title: Developing a Hybrid TAT-Exo-VLP System for Highly Efficient CRISPR Gene Editing
projects.desc:
كريسبر (CRISPR) هو تقنية لتعديل الجينات، تعمل مثل المقص الجيني؛ تحدد جزءًا معينًا من الـDNA ثم تقصه لإصلاحه أو استبداله، وتُستخدم في علاج بعض الأمراض الوراثية والأبحاث الطبية.(THE GENERALIDEA) تركز على تطوير وتقوية تقنية كريسبر (Cas9) للتعديل الجيني، لجعلها
أكثر دقة وأماناً وكفاءة في علاج مرض هنتنغتون العصبي.

projects.title: "Are traditional methods failing to protect our vast environments?…
projects.desc: "Are traditional methods failing to protect our vast environments? Meet SHAHEEN; a fully autonomous smart security system. It merges silent ground sensors and solar relay towers equipped with advanced radars to detect projectiles, fires, and poaching. Upon detecting a threat, its smart stations deploy AI-powered drones (YOLOv8) for instant response and live streaming to the control room. SHAHEEN... proven, sustainable environmental and security sovereignty!"

projects.title: VIGIL: Secure, Lightweight AI for Border Surveillance Drones
projects.desc: Border drones can be jammed, spoofed or captured, and AI can mistake animals for people. VIGIL is a software-only proof of concept for a safer design. A small AI on the drone finds people and vehicles day and night and sends encrypted alerts to a tower, where a second AI checks them and border personnel decide. In tests, fake and replayed commands were rejected, keys were wiped in 7.5 ms after contact loss, and false alarms fell 54%. On game-made images, it outscored a published AI 20x larger.

projects.title: NaviBot
projects.desc: This project presents an assistive navigation robot built with LEGO Spike Prime to help visually impaired individuals. It integrates ultrasonic distance sensors for obstacle detection and color sensors to track paths. By providing real-time environmental awareness, this accessible solution enhances safety and independence, demonstrating how robotics can build inclusive communities.

projects.title: This project transforms industrial byproducts into functional…
projects.desc: This project transforms industrial byproducts into functional components of cement-based batteries for future smart buildings. Three-layer cells were fabricated, cured, and tested after replacing conventional iron powder with silicon manganese or red mud. The control produced 56.2 mV, while modified cells reached 32.8 mV and 9.1 mV, demonstrating measurable electrical output from waste-derived materials and a pathway toward lower-cost, more sustainable building-integrated energy storage systems.

projects.title: CyberScan: NextGen Predictive Threat Intelligence & Thermodynamic Analysis Engine
projects.desc: "CyberScan NextGen is an advanced, zero-execution threat characterization and intelligence platform. It integrates Thermodynamic Entropy Topography, Control Flow Graph (CFG) disassembly, and a 4096-Dimensional Latent Vector Embedding Space to deliver real-time, explainable threat analysis. By combining structural anomaly detection with an asynchronous, multi-source OSINT framework, the system correlates threat indicators globally in under 1.5 seconds without needing to execute untrusted binaries

projects.title: تطبيق كلمة (Kalima)
projects.desc: تطبيق "كلمة" منصة تعليمية تفاعلية لحفظ المصطلحات التخصصية (كالطب والهندسة واللغات) وتجاوز مشكلة النسيان. يدمج التطبيق بين خوارزميات التكرار المتباعد (Spaced Repetition) وآليات التلعيب المشوقة مثل لعبة الأزواج المتطابقة، تحديات الوقت، ومؤشر الالتزام اليومي عبر شجرة افتراضية تنمو وتتطور مع تقدم المتعلم، مما يحول مراجعة المصطلحات إلى عادة يومية محفزة ومستدامة.

projects.title: SignVoice
projects.desc:
SignVoice is an AI-powered smart glove that bridges the gap between sign language users and the world! Using motion sensors and machine learning, it instantly translates hand gestures into clear spoken words and displays them as text on an integrated screen

Our mission is to make daily communication effortless, natural, and accessible for everyone, with an expandable design ready to learn new signs over time

projects.title: Agrisphere the future of agriculture
projects.desc: Agrisphere is a smart agricultural dome designed to help plants grow in extreme environments, from deserts to space. Using sensors, thermal technology, and our Garden Keeper AI, it creates the right conditions for plants to thrive while reducing the need for constant human control and montioring from the app Agrisphere could improve food security, sustainability, the enviroment, and local farming, while supporting Saudi Vision 2030 through innovation, technology, and sustainable development.

projects.title: الذاكرة الذكية Smart memory
projects.desc: Students understand a lesson, then forget it before the exam. The cause is not laziness — they do not know when to review. Smart Memory turns any lesson into flashcards, then uses spaced repetition to schedule each card for the day just before it is forgotten. Cards are generated automatically, linked to the curriculum, and fully in Arabic with right-to-left support. A teacher dashboard shows who has fallen behind and which concept the class is failing before the exam.

projects.title: For Eczema Assessment and Monitoring
projects.desc: Eczema AI is an intelligent skin-monitoring system designed to support at-home eczema monitoring. The device captures images of affected skin and uses AI-based analysis to identify visible changes assess severity compare current assessments with previous records and generate smart alerts. By integrating skin imaging AI analysis longitudinal tracking and data recording Eczema AI aims to make eczema monitoring more organized while supporting communication with healthcare professionals.

projects.title: تطوير جهاز لتنقية الهواء باستخدام الزيوليت و ESP32
projects.desc: يهدف المشروع إلى تطوير جهاز ذكي لتنقية الهواء والحد من تأثير التلوث الهوائي، من خلال توظيف مادة الزيوليت في فلاتر متخصصة لامتصاص بعض الملوثات والغازات الضارة. يعتمد الجهاز على سحب الهواء الملوث وتمريره عبر الفلاتر لتنقيته وتحسين جودته. كما يدمج شريحة ESP32 للتحكم بالجهاز ومراقبته وجمع البيانات البيئية، مما يجعل النظام أكثر ذكاءً وكفاءة. يقدم المشروع حلاً بيئياً حديثاً ومستداماً يساهم في تحسين جودة الهواء وتعزيز جودة الحياة

projects.title: Hybrid Phononic Shielding Reducing Mechanical Noise in Superconducting Quantum Computing Systems
projects.desc: Mechanical and acoustic disturbances can threaten the stability of sensitive superconducting qubits. This project proposes a hybrid physical defense that goes beyond single-stage isolation by combining active vibration suppression at a warmer cryogenic stage with passive isolation near the qubit. This layered architecture targets mechanical disturbances along their transmission path, providing a theoretical approach for protecting quantum systems .from vibration-induced disturbances

projects.title: Individuals with limited mobility often spend long periods indoors…
projects.desc: Individuals with limited mobility often spend long periods indoors, where poor air quality and lack of contact with nature can negatively affect their health and emotional well-being. This project aims to design an accessible indoor “Green Zone”—a mini garden made from plants with strong photosynthesis and air-purifying abilities—arranged in raised pots and shelves at wheelchair and bed height. The garden is intended to absorb carbon dioxide, release oxygen, and create a calmer, more therapeutic

projects.title: يقدم مشروع تقنية Sand Filter حل هندسي مبتكر للتحكم في إنتاج الرمال…
projects.desc: يقدم مشروع تقنية Sand Filter حل هندسي مبتكر للتحكم في إنتاج الرمال في آبار النفط والمياه، عبر فلتر مسامي قابل للتخصيص تضبط فتحاته وفق حجم الحبيبات وظروف التشغيل. يُصنّع بالطباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد، ويحقق احتجازا للرمال يتجاوز 95% مع تدفق مستقر وفقد ضغط منخفض. تسهم التقنية في تقليل تآكل المعدات والانسدادات والتوقفات، مع خفض متوقع للتكاليف بنسبة 30–40%، وإمكانية تكييف التصميم لكل بئر بما يعزز موثوقية التشغيل ويطيل العمر الإنتاجي.

projects.title: PalmGuard
projects.desc: PalmGuard is an IoT-based early detection system for the Red Palm Weevil, a hidden pest that can destroy palms before visible symptoms appear. An embedded Arduino unit combines acoustic, vibration, and temperature sensors to monitor palm activity 24/7. Signal processing and AI-assisted classification identify suspicious patterns, with real-time data displayed on a dashboard so farmers can monitor multiple palms and receive alerts. PalmGuard helps protect date palms, agriculture, and heritage.

projects.title: كرايو كاسكيد: تبريد هيدروجيني متتالي خماسي المراحل لأسلاك شبه خالية من الفقد للمنشآت الحيوية
projects.desc: CryoCascade is a five-stage cooling "staircase" that takes wiring from room temperature down to 20 K (−253 °C). Each gas condenses the next: propane, ethylene, methane, nitrogen, then liquid hydrogen bathing the wire. Calculations show copper's resistance drops ~95×, and an MgB₂ superconductor reaches zero. A promising path to near-loss-free power for data centres, command rooms and critical security facilities  sealed, leak-monitored and safe by design.

projects.title: Cardia+ is a free digital health web app that identifies cardiac…
projects.desc: Cardia+ is a free digital health web app that identifies cardiac risk and recommends which preventive screenings a user needs. Applying AHA-guided algorithms and clinical studies to a health profile, it estimates cardiac risk %, heart age, and likelihood of specific conditions, then matches screening tests to each risk factor. An interactive 3D heart with risk-area calibration shows affected regions. Deployed at scale: 11k+ users, 98% user-reported accuracy, featured by MedChurn Medical News.

projects.title: الذكاء الاصطناعي لتقدير مخاطر حرائق الغابات. FIRECAST AI
projects.desc: FIRECAST AI مشروع ذكي يستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي والتعلم الآلي لتقدير مخاطر نشاط حرائق الغابات في منطقة الرياض. يجمع المشروع بيانات الأقمار الصناعية والطقس والغطاء النباتي والمعلومات الجغرافية، ويحللها باستخدام نماذج تعلم آلي متعددة. ثم يحول النتائج إلى خرائط مخاطر تفاعلية تساعد على فهم العوامل البيئية المرتبطة بالحرائق. يجمع المشروع بين الذكاء الاصطناعي والاستشعار عن بُعد وعلوم البيانات لخدمة البيئة ودعم القرارات المبنية على البيانات.

projects.title: Distributed Smart Defense System for Countering Drones and Low-Altitude Aerial Threats
projects.desc: The problem lies in the cost gap of using major systems like Patriot against cheap drones, causing financial drain, alongside GPS vulnerability. The project offers a technical shield using computer vision and smart recognition via local sensors to track targets instantly via deep learning, ensuring cyber-autonomy and anti-jamming via visual and kinetic analysis to neutralize drones cost-effectively, fully aligned with Vision 2030.

projects.title: A-8 Smart Agricultural Drone Prototype: Multispectral & LiDAR Crop Intelligence
projects.desc:
A-8 System: Revolutionizing Precision Agriculture from Seed to Harvest
Transform your farm management with the A-8 agricultural drone prototype—an advanced, unified platform combining multispectral imaging and LiDAR sensing into a single payload. Powered by cutting-edge AI and RTK centimeter-level positioning, A-8 enables real-time crop health monitoring, variable-rate resource optimization, and early stress detection. Discover how we are shaping the future of sustainable and efficient farming

projects.title: Track guard
projects.desc: TerraSense is a low-cost scout robot built on the mBot2 platform to support Saudi Vision 2030’s off-road tourism. Moving ahead of vehicles, it measures track tilt and vibration to prevent passenger injury and equipment damage from sudden slopes. It displays colored light warnings, uploads real-time data to the cloud, and provides clear, data-driven safe-speed recommendations for drivers, proving that a simple robot can effectively transform terrain readings into actionable advice.

projects.title: NAJAT – Smart School Evacuation Simulator
projects.desc: NAJAT is a software-based school evacuation simulator that helps safety teams test and improve emergency plans before a real incident occurs. It simulates fires, blocked corridors and unavailable exits, calculates safer evacuation routes, detects congestion and vulnerable areas, and compares multiple scenarios to identify weaknesses and improve school readiness without requiring student phones or additional hardware.

projects.title: EcoFit Limb is an affordable smart below-knee prosthetic designed…
projects.desc: EcoFit Limb is an affordable smart below-knee prosthetic designed to improve amputees’ safety and comfort. It integrates pressure, temperature, and glucose sensors within the socket for continuous health monitoring and real-time feedback, helping detect possible complications early. Made from sustainable recycled rPETG, the prototype costs only $49–$66 compared with $3,000–$5,300 for traditional smart prosthetics, making it a practical and scalable healthcare solution.

projects.title: Green Hydrogen Production Using a GO/NiO/TiO2 Nanocomposite
projects.desc: This project develops a low-cost, highly active GO/NiO/TiO2 nanocomposite electrocatalyst for efficient green hydrogen production via water electrolysis. By combining the conductive GO platform, catalytic NiO active sites, and stabilizing TiO2, the catalyst significantly lowers HER overpotential (180 mV at 10 mA/cm²) and maintains high stability. It offers a scalable, non-precious alternative to expensive Pt catalysts for sustainable clean energy.

projects.title: STENS ICE: Intelligent Wearable for Seizure Response
projects.desc: STENS ICE is an innovative wearable system combining artificial intelligence and medical technology to detect early signs of seizure risk and enable a rapid, localized response. It analyzes physiological signals in real time, generates a risk level, and can activate localized external cooling while sending an instant alert through a smart mobile app. STENS ICE brings AI prediction, localized cooling, and intelligent monitoring into one integrated system—Predict. Cool. Alert.

projects.title: Smart Grip pairs a sensor pen (IMU, grip pressure) with bilingual…
projects.desc: Smart Grip pairs a sensor pen (IMU, grip pressure) with bilingual animated stories tailored to child interests (space/sea/dinosaurs). Its on-device $P point-cloud AI evaluates Arabic strokes locally, scoring accuracy and hand steadiness in real time with zero cloud latency. In a kindergarten pilot, 88.9% confirmed improved letter accuracy and engagement, while 100% of teachers and specialists recommended it for classrooms and neurodivergent learners (ADHD/autism/SLD)

projects.title: SMART HALO 2.0 — A Fluorescence Based Hygiene Risk Indicator for Stethoscopes
projects.desc: SMART HALO 2.0 is a proposed detachable optical sensing ring for stethoscopes. It uses near-UV/violet and blue excitation to capture a fluorescence-related surface response and provide a relative hygiene-risk indication after use. A haptic prompt supports timely manual disinfection, while future BLE connectivity may link the device to a physician app and hospital monitoring platform.

projects.title: Safe Steps
projects.desc:
Safe Steps
The Problem: The risks and daily mobility challenges faced by the visually impaired when detecting immediate obstacles.
The Solution & Innovation: Lightweight smart sensing glasses utilizing precision sensors to provide instant audio alerts before a collision occurs (achieving 93.5% accuracy and a response time of under 120ms).
Competitive Value: A practical, affordable, and wearable solution, featuring an architecture designed for future scalability through AI integration and GPS tra

projects.title: We created a smart, low-cost way to clean polluted wastewater using…
projects.desc: We created a smart, low-cost way to clean polluted wastewater using sunlight! By combining Zinc Oxide and Copper Oxide into a special nanoscale material (Cu-ZnO), we made a powerful catalyst that destroys stubborn dye like Methylene Blue under UV light and sunlight. It’s an eco-friendly, efficient solution to tackle textile industry pollution and protect our water resources

projects.title: Autonomous Immunity & Data Fragmentation System (NEXORA)
projects.desc: NEXORA is a hybrid cyber defense architecture redefining security for critical infrastructure and fintech. It combines encrypted data fragmentation to prevent theft and ransomware extortion with dynamic Zero-Trust isolation in under 15 milliseconds with zero human intervention. NEXORA guarantees 100% continuous uptime during live attacks, protecting enterprises from costly downtime while transforming digital defense into decisive autonomous immunity.

projects.title: Nano-Photocatalytic Seawater Purification Enhanced by Halophyte Plants
projects.desc: This project presents an innovative and sustainable seawater purification system that combines nanotechnology with halophyte plants. The system is designed to reduce organic pollutants and heavy metals while supporting lower energy consumption and minimizing environmental impact. By integrating advanced nanomaterials with the natural pollutant-absorption ability of halophytes, the project offers a promising approach for cleaner water and more sustainable seawater treatment.

projects.title: روبوت ذكي لإعادة التأهيل الحركي باستخدام الرؤية الحاسوبية
projects.desc: يعتمد المشروع على روبوت ذكي مزود بكاميرا عالية الدقيقة تقوم بتسجيل الحركات العلاجية التي يؤديها الطبيب أمامها. يتم تحليل هذه الحركات باستخدام خوارزميات رؤية حاسوبية متقدمة لاستخراج زوايا مفاصل الذراعين بدقة عالية. بعد تسجيل الحركات وتخزينها رقميا، يمكن للمريض تشغيل وضع إعادة التشغيل، حيث يقوم الروبوت بإعادة تنفيذ نفس الحركات بنفس الترتيب الزمني، مما يسمح للمريض بمحاكاة التمرين العلاجي بدقة حتى في غياب الطبيب. يتضمن النظام أيضا إجراءات أمان مثل تحديد الحدود القصوى لزوايا الحركة وتقليل السرعة.

projects.title: Smart Theranostic Cast: Self-Monitoring & Sterile Protection Liner
projects.desc: My project develops an advanced diagnostic and therapeutic system for medical cast liners, overcoming the limitations of conventional assessment through a three-layer design. The first layer consists of an alcohol-free biocompatible silicone layer designed to protect a fresh wound. The middle layer is a methylcellulose polymer matrix enhanced with nanosilver ions to enable safe bacterial neutralization through a carefully designed activation valve. Finally, the outer layer incorporates a cobalt

projects.title: A fixed pickup schedule means full bins overflow for hours before…
projects.desc: A fixed pickup schedule means full bins overflow for hours before the truck arrives — trash spills onto sidewalks, littering the street. Natheef fixes this: a solar-powered smart bin that senses when it's full and alerts the city before it overflows. It carries Saudi desert lavender scent to clear the bad trash smell and a Salmani-inspired design that fits Saudi's newest developments. Ad screens on every unit cover its own costs, so it funds itself. One small object, keeping streets litter-free.
