projects.title: Radiation-Sensitive PVA–Blue Dye/Thymol–Silver Nitrate Composite for Dose Detection and Mapping
projects.desc: Radiation detection is essential in medicine and environmental monitoring. This study developed PVA/TB films with different thymol blue concentrations to detect low-dose X-rays (0.5–2.0 mGy). Optical density decreased with increasing dose (R² = 0.86), particularly at 0.01 g TB. UV-Vis and FTIR confirmed optical and structural changes. The films show potential for radiation detection and UV protection, supporting Saudi Vision 2030 through local innovation.

projects.title: TAFAQAH is a digital platform created after noticing that some…
projects.desc: TAFAQAH is a digital platform created after noticing that some middle school students struggled to read Arabic fluently. The platform brings together reading resources, educational videos, and online training opportunities in one place. Students can access learning materials and register for remote reading sessions. The project aims to make reading support easier to access and help students practice Arabic reading with greater confidence.

projects.title: Ecopass Tajikistan
projects.desc: EcoPass Tajikistan is a digital sustainable tourism platform that connects travellers with local destinations and businesses through QR check-ins, EcoPoints and responsible tourism actions. It helps visitors discover verified local places, rewards sustainable behaviour, supports local businesses, and creates measurable engagement for more responsible tourism in Tajikistan.

projects.title: Rafiq is a multilingual app for visitors to Masjid al-Haram
projects.desc: Rafiq is a multilingual app for visitors to Masjid al-Haram. The safety module guides lost visitors to a police officer. Through the emergency module, visitors request medical help from a nearby paramedic. The mobility module to book wheelchairs with online payment. AI assigns service provider and shows both sides a route on 3D mosque map. Voice recognition, translation, and live chat ease communication between visitor and provider. Provider document the help provided before closing the case.

projects.title: ActiveTwin is a desktop simulator for testing robot code before…
projects.desc: ActiveTwin is a desktop simulator for testing robot code before trying it on a real car. Users can edit C++ programs, change floors and obstacles, and compare calculated movement in 3D. It models motor response, wheel slip and friction for an educational robot car. The working prototype is intended for students and robotics teams. Physical robot accuracy has not yet been validated.

projects.title: Low-Cost Nanofluid for Cooling Solar Panels and Improving Performance
projects.desc: High temperatures reduce solar panel efficiency, especially in hot regions such as Saudi Arabia. I developed a low-cost nanofluid from deionized water and silicon carbide nanoparticles to help cool solar panels and improve their efficiency. In testing, the fluid’s thermal conductivity improved by up to 17.5% at 50°C with a 1% silicon carbide concentration. My invention offers a promising way to reduce the impact of heat on solar panel performance.

projects.title: تحقّق منصة رقمية مبتكرة لمواجهة انتحال الهوية والاحتيال عبر…
projects.desc: تحقّق منصة رقمية مبتكرة لمواجهة انتحال الهوية والاحتيال عبر المكالمات، تتيح للمستفيد التحقق من أن التواصل صادر من جهة معتمدة عبر قناة مستقلة وآمنة أثناء المكالمة. تربط المنصة الجهات بالمستفيدين من خلال طلب تحقق فوري يعرض هوية الجهة وبيانات التواصل المعتمدة، مما يعزز الثقة ويساعد على حماية الأفراد من المكالمات الاحتيالية قبل مشاركة المعلومات أو اتخاذ أي إجراء.

projects.title: ThermaVeil:Transparent Al₂O₃/SiO₂Nanocomposite Coatings from Waste for Thermal Signature Reduction
projects.desc: Solar heat gain through glass increases cooling demand. ThermaVeil nanocomposite coatings combine waste-foil-derived Al₂O₃/SiO₂ in separate recycled acrylic and pristine PMMA matrices using a solvothermal-assisted method. Designed to preserve transparency, the coatings showed no obvious peeling after tape testing and a lower recorded temperature than bare glass in a preliminary infrared-lamp test. Potential uses include glazing in buildings and vehicles.

projects.title: PK-Workout is a smart wearable system designed to support people…
projects.desc: PK-Workout is a smart wearable system designed to support people with Parkinson's during exercise. Using movement sensors and machine learning, my AI smartwatch tracks movements, gives instant alerts when exercises are performed incorrectly, and records progress over time. PK-Workout makes daily exercise easier and more accessible, helping users exercise independently, stay active, and build confidence. A live dashboard also displays exercise performance, movement data, and progress in real time

projects.title: HandiPark is a proposed smart parking solution designed to protect…
projects.desc: HandiPark is a proposed smart parking solution designed to protect spaces reserved for people with disabilities and improve the experience of authorized users. It addresses unauthorized use and unjust violations associated with reliance on physical permit display. The solution combines smart sensors, computer vision, license plate recognition, and an authorization database for digital verification, helping reduce unauthorized parking and improve the management of accessible parking spaces.

projects.title: EcoGuard: Autonomous Mine Detection and Environmental Monitoring Robot
projects.desc:
EcoGuard: Autonomous Mine Detection and Environmental Monitoring Robot

EcoGuard is an autonomous robotic vehicle designed to improve safety in potentially hazardous environments while monitoring environmental conditions. The project combines metal detection, obstacle avoidance, and air-quality monitoring in one compact robotic system.

The robot moves autonomously through an area while continuously monitoring its surroundings. A metal detection sensor is used to identify nearby metallic object

projects.title: Designing a Passive Cooling System for Electric Vehicle Charging Station Canopies in Desert Climates
projects.desc:
With rising temperatures in desert climates and the growing use of electric vehicles, our project presents an innovative solution to reduce heat in electric vehicle charging parking canopies through a passive cooling system that relies on engineering design without additional energy consumption.

The design combines reflective surfaces and a double-roof structure to reduce heat transfer and improve thermal comfort around the charging area. The project aims to provide a practical and sustainable

projects.title: نظام ري ذكي مغلق يعمل بإعادة تدوير المياه بالتكثيف الكهرو حراري
projects.desc:
Water scarcity is one of the major challenges facing modern agriculture. Conventional irrigation depends on continuous external water supplies, while a significant portion of irrigation water can be lost through evaporation, plant transpiration, and excess watering. This project presents a sustainable solution that transforms these losses into a reusable water resource.

The **Closed-Loop Smart Irrigation System for Water Recycling Using Thermoelectric Condensation** is an

projects.title: Aerodynamic Streamlined Turbine Car
projects.desc: The Aerodynamic Streamlined Turbine Car turns the air flowing around a moving car into clean electricity, using streamlined channels that guide airflow into turbines without slowing the car, plus a wheel-powered backup, helping cut energy use and emissions, and our prototype proved it by lighting an LED with airflow alone.

projects.title: مقعد سيارة مزدوج للأطفال بوضعية متعاكسة وهيكل داعم لتوزيع الأحمال
projects.desc: A dual-deck child car seat features a base (100) secured by ISOFIX (101) and a support leg (102). It includes a rear-facing lower seat (200) and an upper forward-facing seat (300) elevated by vertical supports (301), which transfer loads to an internal steel frame (103). An air gap (402) and shield barrier (500) separate both seats, safely holding two children within a single seat's footprint.

projects.title: Development and Optimization of Sustainable Biofuel Cubes from Spent Coffee Grounds
projects.desc:
Our biofuel cubes transform used coffee grounds into a useful solid fuel, creating value from a common waste material generated daily by homes, cafés, and restaurants.
Target Market
The primary target market includes campers, hikers, outdoor enthusiasts, and environmentally conscious consumers who may use compact solid fuels for outdoor activities. Camping and outdoor-supply businesses could also represent potential distribution partners. Cafés and restaurants are important partners because they

projects.title: (Enhancing Cloud Security Using HomomorphicEncryption-ECUH)
projects.desc: This system delivers intelligent, proactive protection that stops threats before they reach your data. It analyzes behavior, detects anomalies instantly, and isolates suspicious activity inside a safe virtual environment. Every attack becomes insight that strengthens defenses. It learns, adapts, and protects continuously—giving you a smart shield that reacts before the danger begins.

projects.title: LumiMate is a smart chessboard that turns every game into a lesson
projects.desc: LumiMate is a smart chessboard that turns every game into a lesson. When a player lifts a piece, its legal squares light up; if a move would leave the king in check, the board glows red and explains why. Four help levels fade from full guidance to normal chess, and every game is recorded for replay. Built for beginners, families and schools, LumiMate keeps real pieces in hand while giving the instant feedback of a coach. Real pieces. Real-time guidance.

projects.title: Khotwat Aman: A School App for Bullying Prevention and Response
projects.desc: Khotwat Aman combines bystander training for students with a confidential school reporting workflow. A student scans a QR sticker at the incident location, so the place is recorded automatically. The social worker reviews the report and plans support and follow-up, while the principal sees a heat map of recurring times and places without student identities. Parents receive updates about their own child only. The demo uses fictional cases and stores no data.

projects.title: Design & Synthesis of Controllable Carbon@TiO2 Core-Shell Structures as Sulfur Carrier, Li-S Battery
projects.desc: Sulfur is cheap, easy to get, and the cathode behind Li-S batteries — theoretical capacity 1,675 mAh g⁻¹, far beyond any lithium-ion cell. Three things hold it back: poor conductivity, polysulfides leaking across the cell, and 80% volume swelling on cycling. We made carbon@TiO₂ core-shell microspheres for all three. Carbon handles current; TiO₂ traps polysulfides and absorbs the swelling. At 0.1 C, discharge capacity hit 1,548 mAh g⁻¹ with 77% retention and 96.3% efficiency. The design delivers.

projects.title: Irthona is a online website that helps tourists and people…
projects.desc: Irthona is a online website that helps tourists and people interested in saudi heritage to experience saudi Arabia treasures, manuscripts, etc and enjoy it rather than just reading it in a book and it also it has a real robot that is connected to the website which moves and then records the manuscripts or artifacts and sends them to the website giving it information to be posted and has a built AI features. it's a really useful took to improve museums and make them more known.

projects.title: Development of Fe-Chitosan Antimicrobial Coating for Sustainable Surface Protection
projects.desc: Microbial growth on frequently touched surfaces is a major challenge in public and high-temperature environments. This project develops an Fe-Chitosan antimicrobial coating as a sustainable surface protection solution. By combining biodegradable chitosan with iron-based nanoparticles, the coating aims to reduce microbial growth and improve surface hygiene. The research evaluates its performance compared with untreated surfaces, providing a potential eco-friendly alternative for future applicatio

projects.title: A Non-Contact Optical Biosensor for Early Detection of Blood Contamination During Dialysis
projects.desc: A non-contact optical system designed for early detection of potential bacterial contamination during hemodialysis. The system monitors optical changes inside the blood tubing without blood sampling or direct contact. It aims to support earlier medical intervention and safer dialysis monitoring. Future integration of AI could analyze optical patterns to distinguish contamination types and improve detection accuracy

projects.title: SEDRIX
projects.desc: SEDRIX is a smart, solar-powered tree designed to improve air quality in cities and congested areas. It draws in polluted air through concealed vents, then purifies it from PM2.5 and PM10 particles, harmful gases, and odors using dual filters and activated carbon. Powered by sensors that monitor air quality and temperature, it leverages artificial intelligence to analyze data, adjust fan speeds, enable predictive maintenance, and generate reports that help cities build a healthy, sustainable env

projects.title: Wastify
projects.desc: Wastify works when the waste is falling into the bin, the computer vision will track what item goes into which category and put them in their compartments. These compartments will have flaps on them, connected to the computer vison and microprocessor to open and close the flaps. As a result, the waste will be separated and sorted into their categories without needing to rely on humans. This way, they can go straight into the recycling center and prevent the waste from going to landfills.

projects.title: Smart Real-Time Monitoring and Automated Maintenance System for Solar Panel Efficiency
projects.desc:
شهدت السنوات الأخيرة تركيزا على الألواح الشمسية، لكن العوامل البيئية كتراكم الغبار يخفض كفاءتها إلى 50%، وعلى تنوع الحلول لكن لاتزال هناك الثغرة المتمثلة في عدم دقة تشخيص هذه العوامل.
ومن هذا المنطلق يقدم مشروعنا حلاً تنافسياً بنظام ذكي مدعم بالذكاء الاصطناعي والرؤية الحاسوبية، يعتمد على كاميرا مبرمجة لتحليل الصور وقراءة الطقس لتتجاوز دقة الحساسات التقليدية، مع تحديد المساحة المطلوبة لطلاء أو تنظيف اللوح بدقة.
يقدم الجهاز حلاً مبتكراً يسد ثغرة بارزة لرفع كفاءة الطاقة ودعم أهداف السعودية الخضراء.

projects.title: Weqaya Sense - Smart Bed-Sore Monitor
projects.desc: An AI and IoT-powered smart preventive sensing system designed to monitor bedridden patients. Integrated with embedded mattress sensors, the device evaluates real-time pressure and humidity levels and sends instant alerts to nursing staff to reposition the patient before bedsores form—minimizing injury risks and enhancing overall healthcare efficiency.

projects.title: Eco-Nano H₂Cell: Innovative Nanomaterial for Efficient Electrolysis and Sustainable Hydrogen Storage

At $4.40 per 5 g it is a low-cost alternative to platinum which costs about $200 per 5 g supporting sustainable

projects.title: AtharTime
projects.desc: AtharTime supports digital investigations when evidence sources conflict. It identifies event orders justified under a declared source-fault bound, then selects adaptive checks at minimum worst-case cost within an available menu. Independent certificates verify conclusions, optimality, or why the checks cannot resolve ambiguity. In 240 synthetic cases, it matched an exact reference; costs fell 29.10% versus cheapest-first and 0.54% versus the best fixed order on 123 resolvable cases.

projects.title: مَدار | MADAR
projects.desc: MADAR is an AI-powered school platform that solves the difficulty of sharing and borrowing storybooks among students. Under school administration supervision, AI classifies stories by genre, age group, and reading level, then recommends books based on students' interests. Data science analyzes reading and sharing patterns to identify popular stories and trends. MADAR connects each book with a new reader, extending its life, encouraging reading, and promoting sharing and reuse inside the school.

projects.title: Urea production via Haber–Bosch consumes ~2% of global energy and…
projects.desc: Urea production via Haber–Bosch consumes ~2% of global energy and emits 450M+ tonnes of CO₂ a year while transport accounts for ~50% of urea's price for poor farmers. We present a solar-powered alternative: PCN-222@MIL-125-NH₂, the first all-MOF heterojunction for photocatalytic urea synthesis. Using sunlight, it turns CO₂ and N₂ into urea at 7.63 μmol/g/h, so farms could make fertilizer on-site. Powered by the Kingdom's sun, it supports Vision 2030, the Saudi Green Initiative and food security.

projects.title: FinWise — Personal Finance & DecisionLab
projects.desc: FinWise is an interactive personal finance platform that helps users understand and manage their money through budgeting, savings goals, financial calculators, and DecisionLab. DecisionLab allows users to test resource-allocation decisions in a simulated environment and observe their long-term consequences. The project combines practical financial management with interactive decision-making to help users make more informed choices.

projects.title: R-744 Desert Chiller — Evaporative Pre-cooling for Transcritical CO₂ Refrigeration
projects.desc: Carbon dioxide (R-744) has a GWP of one, but above 30.98 °C it cannot condense, so Gulf summers force it transcritical and its efficiency collapses. This project does not bolt an evaporative pad onto an existing chiller — it sizes the chiller around the pad. Across 8,760 hours in three Saudi cities, compressor energy falls 46.5 % and Riyadh runs sub-critical 100 % of the year instead of 48.6 %, for 14.94 m³ of water per kW of cooling — 25 times cheaper in energy than desalinating it.

projects.title: CyberLeaf: Energy-Aware Eco-Cyber Defense for Sustainable Data Centers
projects.desc: CyberLeaf is an intelligent software system and advanced digital solution that acts as a flexible, adaptive protection layer installed directly over existing data center and cloud infrastructures, eliminating the need for additional hardware purchases or server replacements.Powered by advanced artificial intelligence algorithms, the system dynamical manages data traffic to optimize processing.

projects.title: AeroSign is a touchless biometric access system that verifies users…
projects.desc: AeroSign is a touchless biometric access system that verifies users through the unique motion of an in-air signature. A standard webcam tracks fingertip movement, extracts dynamic features such as speed, acceleration, and curvature, and uses machine learning to authenticate the signer. A verified match activates an Arduino-controlled lock. The prototype reported 97.83% accuracy across 460 held-out attempts and rejected 149 of 150 tested attack or impostor attempts.

projects.title: SENTINEL-X: Independent Policy Verification for Safe Autonomous Cyber Defense
projects.desc:
What if AI could defend systems without being given unlimited control?
SENTINEL-X makes this possible by placing an independent verification layer between AI decisions and real-world execution. Every action is assessed, risk-checked, and intelligently authorized as ALLOW, SANDBOX, HUMAN APPROVAL, or BLOCK. The result is a new approach to autonomous cyber defense that combines AI speed with security, control, and accountability.

projects.title: نظام إنذار ذكي للكشف المبكر عن الحرائق وإرسال التنبيهات عن بعد باستخدام انترنت الاشياء
projects.desc:
Project Idea:
A smart fire alarm system using IoT technology to detect fire early and instantly send an alert to a mobile phone, enabling a faster response and helping protect lives and property.

projects.title: منصة تكوين/Takween Platform
projects.desc: Takween platform هي منصة تجمع كل احتياجاتك من ناحية تصميم وتشطيب وبناء البيوت

projects.title: Mouan
projects.desc: The core idea of Mouan is to shift household food management from manual tracking to an automated, AI-driven ecosystem. By introducing an Arabic voice assistant and automatic ingredient deduction upon cooking, the project eliminates user friction. This innovative 'Family OS' concept specifically targets the 60% household food waste in the GCC by making inventory management seamless, voice-controlled, and culturally adapted.

projects.title: AirGuard-AI
projects.desc: AirGuard-AI: Intelligent Indoor Air Quality Monitoring and Prediction

projects.title: RIWEXA: A Functional Visitor-Aware Saudi Cultural Guide Robot
projects.desc: and interaction in cultural exhibitions. Many exhibitions still rely on static signs or fixed digital screens, which may be less accessible to some older adults, visitors with low vision, and young children who may struggle with small or lengthy text. These formats also cannot adapt to a visitor’s spoken question or maintain a follow-up dialogue. RIWEXA addresses this by automatically detecting nearby visitors, supporting AI-assisted open spoken dialogue, preserving follow-up context, and provid

projects.title: رَصْد | RASD
projects.desc:
**رَصْد | RASD** هو نظام ذكي للإنذار المبكر، يستخدم **الذكاء الاصطناعي والحساسات** لاكتشاف الأحداث غير الطبيعية وتحليلها بسرعة.

عند اكتشاف خطر محتمل، يقوم رَصْد **بتحديد المنطقة المتأثرة وإرسال تنبيه مباشر إليها** عبر اتصال محلي، دون الحاجة إلى الإنترنت أو تطبيق.

يمكن للتنبيه الوصول إلى أجهزة مختلفة مثل **الساعات، الشاشات، ووحدات الإنذار**، مما يجعل رَصْد نظامًا مرنًا يعمل في بيئات متعددة.

**الفكرة ببساطة: رَصْد يكتشف الخطر، يحلله، يحدد مكانه، ثم ينبه الأشخاص المناسبين في الوقت المناسب.**

projects.title: SPECTER: Autonomous Pre-Symptomatic Pathogen Prediction System for National Agricultural Security
projects.desc: Plant diseases are a critical threat to national food security, causing annual crop losses up to 40%. Current accessible methods often detect pathogens only once visible damage appears, when the infection has already spread beyond control. SPECTER is an agricultural robot that analyzes plant and environmental signals to identify pathogens before visible damage appears. Validation demonstrated 32.6 hours earlier detection with 93.4% accuracy, therefore, protecting yields and food security.

projects.title: الفكرة
projects.desc:
الفكرة
جهاز تحليل الدم الذكي هو جهاز يفحص الدم ويساعد في الكشف المبكر لأمراض الدم 
الآلية 
اولا عندما  يدخل الدم يمر بقناة مايكروفوليديه لتنظيم مرور الخلايا الى منطقة الكشف التي تعمل بإستخدام تقنية مبدأ كولتر  و تقنية العد البصري ثم ترسل البيانات إلى الذكاء الاصطناعي لحللها ويقارنها بالمعدل الطبيعي .
الإبتكار في الجهاز انه محمول ويحلل الدم في دقائق ويستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي لضمان دقة النتائج

projects.title: Yalla Offline: Do Real Tasks, Earn Real Rewards
projects.desc: Yalla Offline helps kids build healthy screen habits together with their family and friends. Kids earn points by doing fun tasks away from the screen: reading, drawing, family time, printed mazes, and geography, Arabic and Islamic studies challenges. AI or parents check each task with a photo. Staying within their daily screen goal earns bonus points. Kids compete with their parents and friends on a weekly podium, and parents choose real-life rewards.

projects.title: LensGuard
projects.desc:
Security cameras protect critical spaces, but attackers can replace live feeds with old recordings. Digital signatures prove data integrity, but not live presence.

LensGuard provides physical proof of live footage using a trusted optical beacon in the camera’s view. The beacon displays an unpredictable sequence of light patterns every few seconds. LensGuard verifies this captured sequence against the expected challenge in real time.

projects.title: “Hand for Good” is a community-based application that aims to…
projects.desc:
“Hand for Good” is a community-based application that aims to connect people in need with volunteers who are able to provide assistance. Through a simple and organized platform, the app displays requests for help and allows volunteers to choose the type of assistance that best suits them.

The application helps make it easier to reach people in need, make effective use of volunteers’ time and efforts, and promote a culture of cooperation and social solidarity within the community. In the future,

projects.title: صدى | SADA
projects.desc: صدى | SADA نظام ذكي لإدارة دورة نشر المحتوى الرقمي آليًا باستخدام منظومة من وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي المتخصصين، مع ضبط ديناميكي لمستوى الاستقلالية وفقًا لدرجة حساسية المحتوى. يرصد النظام المعلومات من المصادر الموثوقة، ويتحقق من دقتها، وينشئ محتوى متعدد اللغات، ويختار المنصة والتوقيت الأنسب للنشر، ثم يحلل النتائج ويحسّن الأداء، مع إخضاع المحتوى الحساس للمراجعة البشرية؛ بما يسرّع النشر، ويعزز دقته واستمراريته، ويقلل العبء التشغيلي على فرق التواصل والإعلام.

projects.title: KASHIF: Naming the Drug Family of New Designer Drugs From One Mass Spectrum
projects.desc: Smuggled drugs seized at Saudi ports and borders must be identified in a lab, but new designer drugs appear faster than reference libraries are updated. KASHIF is an AI screening aid: from one mass spectrum it names the drug family, such as opioid or stimulant, says "not sure" when unsure, and shows the peaks behind its answer. On 366 drugs that appeared after its training, it was right 82% of the time vs 68% for library search. Next: research with a KAUST lab on real instrument data.

projects.title: E.D.G.E. Guard (Energy Defense & Ground Element Guard)
projects.desc: In Sept 2026, Saudi's East-West pipeline faced severe drone attacks. Remote and vulnerable to ground strikes, it lacks nearby power. To protect it, we engineered a self-sustaining, off-grid security system with advanced Edge AI. When an attack or breach is detected, the system instantly broadcasts SOS alerts and precise GPS coordinates. This ensures authorities receive immediate warnings to dispatch specialized tactical help, securing vital energy assets

projects.title: يقدّم مشروع كرسي سيف تصورًا لكرسي متحرك كهربائي ذكي ومتكامل يهدف…
projects.desc:
يقدّم مشروع كرسي سيف تصورًا لكرسي متحرك كهربائي ذكي ومتكامل يهدف إلى تحسين تجربة التنقل ورفع مستوى الراحة والاستقلالية لدى الأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة. جاءت فكرة المشروع من الحاجة إلى وسيلة تنقل تجمع بين سهولة الاستخدام، والراحة، والخصائص الذكية في تصميم واحد، بدل الاعتماد على وسائل منفصلة لكل احتياج. ويركز المشروع على جعل الكرسي أكثر قدرة على الاستجابة للمستخدم، وأكثر ملاءمة للاستخدام اليومي في مختلف الظروف.
يعتمد التصور على نظام تحكم ذكي يتيح للمستخدم التعامل مع الكرسي بطريقة سهلة ومباشرة من خلال شاشة

projects.title: راصد
projects.desc: نظام رصد البحري الذكي يدمج 4 مستشعرات مستقلة وعوامات ذاتية الطاقة لحل مشكلة الرادار التقليدي أحادي المصدر. يعالج البيانات بالذكاء الاصطناعي على الحافة ليوجه تلقائياً أقرب فريق استجابة. يضمن استمرارية الرصد حتى عند تعطل أي مصدر بفضل التكامل، مما يحمي باب المندب من الزوارق المسيرة والألغام البحرية، مع إمكانية التوسع لحماية الحدود والمنشآت الحيوية. ويتضمن بوابة تدريبية تفاعلية تضم أربعة سيناريوهات أزمات لتدريب الفرق قبل التشغيل الحي الفعلي لضمان أعلى مستويات الجاهزية الميدانية التامة بكفاءة عالية.

projects.title: Smart Assistive Wheelchair
projects.desc: The Smart Assistive Wheelchair is an innovative mobility solution designed to help people with physical disabilities move more safely and independently. It combines smart sensors, automatic assistance, and a user-friendly control system to detect obstacles and support safer movement. The project aims to improve mobility, reduce accidents, and provide users with greater confidence and independence in their daily lives.

projects.title: . Smart Platform for Matching Qualified Specialists with All-Field Emergencies on Aircraft Using AI
projects.desc: مُعين | MUEEN هو نظام سعودي ذكي للاستجابة للطوارئ على متن الطائرة لجميع المجالات المتوفره ، يربط طاقم الطائرة بالمختصين المؤهلين الموجودين على الرحلة للمساعدة في حالة الطوارئ بسرعة وخصوصية. يستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي لتصنيف الحالة ومطابقة التخصص المناسب، ثم يرسل تنبيهًا خاصًا للمختص ليقبل الحالة أو يرفضها. يعمل بالإنترنت عبر الأقمار الصناعية ، مع حماية البيانات، مع بقاء القرار والاستجابة بيد طاقم الطائرة.

projects.title: نبض النخلة (Palm Pulse
projects.desc:
Palm Pulse (Nabd Al-Nakhlah) is an innovative project designed to help protect palm trees from the Red Palm Weevil, a serious pest that can damage the tree from the inside before visible symptoms appear.

The project uses sound and vibration sensors connected to an Arduino system to detect unusual activity inside the palm trunk. When suspicious activity is detected, the system provides an alert, helping farmers identify possible infestations at an early stage.

Palm Pulse aims to provide a simpl

projects.title: Novel Electrochemical Strip Biosensor for Rapid Detection of Aflatoxin B1 in Food
projects.desc: This research develops a rapid electrochemical biosensor in a test-strip format to detect Aflatoxin B1 (AFB1) in foods such as grains and nuts. Using an antibody or aptamer, the sensor recognizes AFB1 and converts this interaction into an electrical signal measured by a portable device within minutes. The system offers a fast, low-cost, and accurate alternative to conventional methods such as HPLC and ELISA, enabling on-site food safety screening.

projects.title: Fiber-Optic Biosensors for Biodetection of pH Changes in Acidic TME of Solid Lung Tumors
projects.desc: Lung cancer is still one of the top cancer diseases killers. The metabolic switch of the Warburg effect leads to a low extracellular pH (6.0–6.8) in the TME, which contributes to tumor invasion, immune escape, and therapy resistance. Therefore, real time monitoring of the pH value can help to diagnose and evaluate the disease. The aim of this study is to develop a new optical fiber based system for real-time minimally invasive pH measurement in living lung tumors.

projects.title: An Integrated Smart Bioreactor System for Circular Biohydrogen Generation and In-Situ pH Regulation
projects.desc: This project proposes a smart bioreactor for biohydrogen generation using date-seed biomass and camel-bone-derived hydroxyapatite. The system combines waste valorization with real-time monitoring and automated pH regulation using sensors and a microcontroller. It aims to provide a controlled and scalable platform for exploring biohydrogen generation from local waste resources.

projects.title: Smart Slope-Response Auto-Braking System (SSAB) for Wheelchairs and Strollers
projects.desc: نظام سلامة لعربات الأطفال وكبار السن ( عربة غير الكترونية ) مكون من حساس رصد الميلان سواء للأمام أو للخلف ومحركان سيرفر ( يعملوا عمل المكابح ) ولمبات LED خضراء وحمراء لتبين حالة تفعيل المكابح وزر لتحرير المكابح ( عند الحاجة للتحرك في المنحدر - يجب أن يكون الضغط مطول - ). طريقة العمل: عندما يرصد الحساس ميلان ( للأمام أو الخلف ) في العربة يتم تفعيل المكابح فوريا من قبل بدأ التسارع في المنحدر ويتم تفعيل اللبمة الحمراء دلالة على تفعيل المكابح ويتم ضغط الزر عندما يريد الشخص المشي بالعربة على المنحدر.

projects.title: AI-Powered Portable Smartphone Microscope for Sickle Cell Screeningil.com
projects.desc: ابتكار طبي يعتمد على مجهر محمول بالهاتف الذكي والذكاء الاصطناعي لفحص مرض فقر الدم المنجلي سريعاً. يتميز بتصميم خفيف وتكلفة منخفضة مناسب للعيادات المتنقلة والمناطق النائية. يحقق دقة تشخيصية تصل إلى 98% عبر اختبار أعمى على شرائح الدم، مفحوصاً بدقة عالية ومعدل أخطاء ضئيل جداً. يخدم المستشفيات ومراكز الرعاية الأولية لدعم الفحص الأولي السريع وتحسين كفاءة الرعاية الصحية.

projects.title: SIMAM
projects.desc: "Critical OT infrastructure is dangerously exposed to cyberattacks due to severe power and memory constraints. SIMAM solves this with a vendor-independent, TinyML-powered Intrusion Detection System for resource-starved microcontrollers. By pioneering a Classifier-first INT8 architecture, we slashed energy consumption by 78% while maintaining a 92.8% threat recall. SIMAM eliminates cloud dependency, redefining the global standard for autonomous, low-power edge cyber defense

projects.title: PoolGuard is an AI-powered swimming pool safety system designed to…
projects.desc: PoolGuard is an AI-powered swimming pool safety system designed to prevent child drowning. It combines a smart camera with a compact, wall-mounted water sensor to detect children near pools and identify potential falls. The system sends an early warning when a small child is alone near the pool and an urgent alert if a fall is detected. Both sensors work independently to provide an additional layer of protection, with real-time notifications sent to parents' phones.

projects.title: StructGRIN-SCZ
projects.desc: StructGRIN-SCZ introduces a 3D framework for analyzing schizophrenia-associated GRIN2A missense variants. Variants were mapped onto the NMDA receptor structure (PDB: 7EO5) and compared with rare gnomAD controls. Local packing, solvent accessibility, and structural features were integrated into a Structural Vulnerability Index (SVI). The findings reveal distinct 3D vulnerabilities and, supported by electrophysiological evidence, provide a computational approach for prioritizing variants.

projects.title: SovereignQ
projects.desc: SovereignQ and the Saudi Silicon Quantum Processor form a quantum-native sovereign computing program. Built research components span federated intelligence, adversarial assurance and digital twins. We are developing the deep-donor silicon processor and computer architecture beneath them, with multilevel control models and an inspectable digital prototype. Our mission: a higher-temperature silicon QPU pathway and a Saudi-designed demonstrator by 2030, serving future finance, energy and industry.

projects.title: Extreme summer heat strains urban grids and drives up energy bills
projects.desc: Extreme summer heat strains urban grids and drives up energy bills. To tackle this, we developed RadCool—a passive daytime radiative cooling paint that reflects solar heat and radiates thermal energy directly into deep space without electricity. Using eco-friendly Barium Sulfate, it drops surface temperatures naturally. Aligned with the Montreal Protocol to phase out harmful refrigerants, RadCool provides a sustainable, ozone-safe shield that cuts AC reliance and fights urban warming.

projects.title: From Soil Pollution to Smart Solutions
projects.desc:
From Soil Pollution to Smart Solutions

Soil pollution is an environmental challenge that affects soil quality, plant growth, and sustainable agriculture. This project combines green nanotechnology with IoT-based monitoring to provide a sustainable approach to soil pollution.

Neem seed extract is used as a natural resource for the green synthesis of silver nanoparticles. These nanoparticles can help address harmful microorganisms and pollutants in contaminated soil. IoT technology is then used

projects.title: Energy Haِrvesting from Vibrations in Entertainment Environments
projects.desc: تحويل ذبذبات الصوت الى طاقة كهربائية بأستخدام مواد وادوات مساعدة مثل الحساسات الصوتية او الاقراص الكهروضغطي , نهدف الى المشروع الى تجربة امكانية للاستفادة من الاصوات المحيطية وتحويلها الى طاقة كهربائية بسيطة, وسنعمل على تصميم نموذج تجريبي يوضح طريقة التحول من دراسه هذه العوامل اللتي تؤثر على كمية الطاقة الناتجة "هدف المشروع استكشاف طريقة مبتكرة لنستفيد من الطاقة الصوتية,ونتعرف على تطبيقاتها المحتملة بالمستقبل"

projects.title: A Lighter Backpack, A Smarter Study
projects.desc: Students often carry heavy school bags filled with books, worksheets, and papers, which can make studying less convenient and increase paper use and printing costs. Our project presents an initial concept for a smart educational tablet that brings essential study materials and tools together in one device. It is designed to provide digital textbooks, worksheets, note-taking, homework, and smart organization while allowing access to materials without an internet connection.

projects.title: Gas injection pressure maintenance restores natural energy in oil…
projects.desc: Gas injection pressure maintenance restores natural energy in oil fields. Reinjecting gas pushes trapped crude oil toward production wells. High pressure thins thick oil so it flows smoothly through rock. Lighter gas stays above oil to push it down using gravity. This process maximizes total field recovery and unlocks stranded reserves

projects.title: جهاز كشف الوريد( سحب الدم)
projects.desc:
، الفكرة جت من تجربة شخصية مؤلمة عند سحب الدم للصعوبة الوصول الى الوريد
فكرت في حل لهذا الموضوع المؤلم وخطر في ذهني قلم صغير سهل الاستخدام يكشف الأوردة الصغيرة للجميع الأعمار بحيث يحدد المكان بدقة وينتج عنه مؤثر صوتي هادئ

projects.title: The Immersive Musem
projects.desc:
The Immersive Saudi Heritage Museum makes learning about Saudi landmarks interactive. Visitors select a landmark using an RFID card or Bluetooth app, then watch a small robotic vehicle travel to it on a museum layout. At each stop, they can see information and hear an audio explanation about the landmark’s history and importance.
The project is designed for schools, museums, and cultural events seeking an engaging way to introduce Saudi heritage to children and families.

projects.title: SafeScan AI: Cyber Threat Analysis & Prevention
projects.desc: SafeScan is a concept for an AI-powered website that helps people spot online scams before they fall for them. Users could paste suspicious emails, messages, links, or other online content, and SafeScan would check for warning signs such as fake prizes, urgent requests, suspicious links, or requests for personal information. It would then explain what looks suspicious and why, using simple language that is easy to understand. The goal is to help kids, older adults, and users stay safer online.

projects.title: The project aims to develop an air-purifying roadside barrier…
projects.desc: The project aims to develop an air-purifying roadside barrier without relying on mechanical exhaust fans. It uses vehicle-induced airflow and the Venturi effect to direct polluted air into the barrier, where particulate matter is filtered and nitrogen oxides (NOx) are treated using TiO₂ photocatalysis with water mist and suitable lighting. The prototype will be evaluated by measuring airflow and pollutant concentrations before and after treatment.

projects.title: Cadaver Drone
projects.desc:
The Cadaver Drone is a drone designed to detect human remains using their unique odor. Research on cadaver dogs has identified 14 volatile compounds associated specifically with human remains.

The drone combines smell detection, aerial movement, recognition, location tracking, and reporting in one system. This could allow it to search areas that are dangerous or difficult for people and search dogs to reach, including rubble or underground locations.

projects.title: DesertShip is an autonomous precision-planting robot designed for…
projects.desc: DesertShip is an autonomous precision-planting robot designed for arid environments. It measures soil moisture, temperature, humidity, and light, then calculates a micro-site suitability score before drilling a 35 mm furrow, placing one seed, and applying targeted root-zone irrigation. A solar panel supports battery charging and extends operation in remote locations. The ESP32-based prototype supports water-efficient, data-guided restoration of arid land.

projects.title: CyberSOC — The Attack Replay
projects.desc: CyberSOC is an autonomous multi-agent cybersecurity system designed to predict and simulate cyberattacks. Driven by five collaborative AI agents, it goes beyond detection to reconstruct attack timelines across the Past and Present, forecast potential propagation paths into the Future, and simulate response outcomes through an interactive “What-If” engine before execution.

projects.title: Laser Guard-The Invisible Shiled of Protection
projects.desc: Laser Guard is a low-cost smart security system using a laser beam and LDR sensor as an invisible trip-wire. When the beam is interrupted, an alarm is triggered instantly. The prototype uses a laser, LDR, resistor, LED, buzzer, and transistor. It can be expanded with IoT for real-time phone alerts and used in homes, shops, warehouses, ATMs, and restricted areas.

projects.title: ابتكار نظام تأقلم : الدرع النانو الذكي لحماية البنى التحتيه وتعزيز الأمن الوطني السيبراني
projects.desc: يُقدم مشروع "تأقلم" (AdaptiShield) حلاً أمنياً سيبرانياً-فيزيائياً غير مسبوق لحماية البنى التحتية الحيوية. يدمج النظام بين المواد النانوية الذكية ذاتية الترميم والتصلب اللحظي، والحساسات الكمومية، وخوارزميات الذكاء الاصطناعي التنبؤية. يعمل الدرع على تعديل خصائصه الفيزيائية والكهرومغناطيسية تلقائياً خلال أقل من 50 ميلي ثانية من رصد التهديد لامتصاص الصدمات وتضليل أنظمة التوجيه. يسهم الابتكار في الانتقال من الحماية السلبيه إلى الاقليميه الديناميكية الذاتيه لتأمين المنشآت الوطنيه الحساسه

projects.title: WAHA:Integrated Smart System for Converting Surplus Solar Energy into Green Ammonia for Agriculture
projects.desc: WAHA is a fully automated, low-cost system that captures wasted solar energy and converts it into green hydrogen, then green ammonia for natural fertilizer. Tested over 72 hours, it achieved 65.3% efficiency, 95.7% surplus capture, and 100% safety success all for just $112, making it 72–98% cheaper than commercial systems. For farmers, WAHA delivers 35% higher crop yields,and 80% lower fertilizer costs,  transforming wasted energy into a solution for global food security.

projects.title: Smart Sustainable Neck Support
projects.desc: Smart Sustainable Neck Support is an innovative medical device designed to improve cervical support while enhancing user comfort, accessibility, and safety. Unlike conventional neck braces, it integrates a visual skin temperature indicator, NFC technology for instant digital guidance, voice instructions, and Braille markings to support visually impaired users. Made from natural, breathable, and sustainable materials, it aims to reduce heat and moisture buildup while providing effective cervical

projects.title: Smart Thermoelectric Clip-On Module for Flare Stack Waste Heat Recovery
projects.desc: Gas flaring wastes heat, while safety sensors depend on batteries. This project presents a clip-on thermoelectric module that converts waste heat into electricity for wireless sensors using stable ceramics and a heat sink. It eliminates battery changes and enables self-powered monitoring in hazardous areas.

projects.title: An integrated health platform for continuous monitorin منصة متكاملة للمتابعة المستمرة
projects.desc: Healthcare faces the challenge of fragmented patient data, the need for continuous monitoring, and limited access to integrated information for clinical decision-making. SUCP is a proposed Saudi health platform that brings vital measurements, laboratory results, imaging, and reports into one unified record, with emergency alerts and support for earlier detection of chronic diseases. It benefits people across the Kingdom and healthcare professionals while protecting privacy and preserving family

projects.title: WRISTQ
projects.desc: WRISTQ is a smart wearable emergency device designed to help users request assistance quickly and discreetly when speaking or using a phone is difficult. Using motion sensors and an ESP32-S3, it detects predefined gestures and triggers an emergency alert. Future versions could include GPS, AI-based gesture recognition, and smartphone or emergency-service integration.

projects.title: NakhlaGuard: Early Red Palm Weevil Detection
projects.desc: **NakhlaGuard** is a low-cost sensor system that detects Red Palm Weevil infestation early by listening to larval feeding sounds inside the trunk. A Random Forest model classifies each palm into four stages, and Gemini AI generates a 4-week treatment plan, with live alerts for farmers in Arabic and English. On simulated data it reached 93% accuracy, and the next step is field validation with partner farms. It supports Vision 2030 goals for food security and non-oil exports.

projects.title: Aquasentiel
projects.desc: What if we could detect danger before a child reaches the water? AQUASENTIEL is an AI-powered safety system that uses computer vision to monitor pool areas, distinguish children from adults, and detect when a child enters a danger zone without an adult nearby. When a risk is detected, it sends an immediate alert and automatically activates a safety barrier, shifting pool safety from simply detecting danger to responding before it escalates.

projects.title: Adaptive Traffic Light Management System with Emergency Vehicle Priority
projects.desc: The project is a smart traffic light system that detects vehicles in real-time and adjusts signals accordingly. The main feature is the priority for emergency vehicles. If the system sees an ambulance coming to an intersection, it can immediately give priority to the direction of the ambulance and stop conflicting traffic, clearing a path. This may help reduce emergency response delays while allowing for an efficient traffic flow.

projects.title: Wisal
projects.desc: Wisal connects older adults with volunteers for step-by-step digital assistance through calls and screen sharing. Its accessible Arabic interface helps users navigate technology with confidence and independence. The concept includes saved instructions, volunteer ratings and impact tracking, identity verification, and AI-assisted detection of suspicious behavior to support safer interactions.

projects.title: Edge-Intersection Guard (نظام حارس التقاطعات الحافي)
projects.desc: نظام ذكاء اصطناعي متقدم للرؤية الحاسوبية مخصص للعمل على أجهزة الحافة (Edge Devices) لمراقبة تقاطعات الطرق ورصد الحركات الشاذة أو الخطرة لحظياً. يعتمد النظام على معمارية تكيّف ديناميكية فريدة بلغة C++23 تتبدل أوتوماتيكياً بين التدفق البصري الكثيف (DIS) والخفيف (LK) بناءً على الحمل الحسابي، مما يحقق استجابة فائقة السرعة تصل إلى 2ms ومعدل إطارات يتجاوز 300 FPS دون الحاجة لمعالجات رسومية مكلفة، ليضمن رفع مستوى السلامة المرورية والإنذار المبكر.

projects.title: NABD: An AI-Powered Drone System for Detecting First Aid Needs in Dense Crowds at Hajj and Stadiums
projects.desc: NABD (Navigational Aerial Bio-Aid Drone) is an AI drone system that finds people who collapse in dense crowds such as Hajj and stadiums. YOLOv8-Pose detects the "crowd ring" bystanders form around a victim, so hidden patients are found. The drone then finds the best route for medics, using an A* algorithm to guide them on foot through the least crowded path, while an ESP32 first-aid pod coaches bystanders in their own language. Medicine unlocks only with a remote doctor's approval.

projects.title: The “Heat Peak” project transforms heat absorbed by building…
projects.desc: The “Heat Peak” project transforms heat absorbed by building facades into a usable source of electrical energy. It proposes a multilayer facade that absorbs, stores, and directs heat using Phase Change Material (PCM) toward a Thermoelectric Generator (TEG). The innovation focuses on managing heat flow and maintaining a temperature difference across the TEG for longer, extending electricity generation after heat exposure decreases and improving energy efficiency in buildings.

projects.title: درون صامتة تعمل بالطاقة الشمسية وAi وللمراقبة والتحري الجنائي المتقدم.
projects.desc:
درون أمني صامت يعمل بالطاقة الشمسية و Ai للرصد والجوانب الجنائية المتقدمة في المناطق النائية والحدودية. 
حيث انه يدمج تقنيات للكشف عن المواد الممنوعة والتتبع بالأشعة تحت الحمراء، التحليل الحيوي مثل بصمة العين ووطأة القدم 
كما يوجد فيها ميزة التعرف الآلي على بصمة هيكل المركبات ومطابقتها مع بلاغات السرقة ورصد ترددات اللاسلكية وتحديد موقع مصدرها.

projects.title: KQ Plus 1000 is a realistic betavoltaic research model designed for…
projects.desc: KQ Plus 1000 is a realistic betavoltaic research model designed for low-power sensors. It converts radioisotope beta decay into continuous electricity using stacked silicon nanolayers. Continuous micro-power energy is stored in a supercapacitor and released as duty-cycled pulses for long-range wireless transmission. The system complies with thermodynamics using: Output power equals input power times total efficiency. With 2.38% overall efficiency, it delivers 238nW from a 10uW baseline

projects.title: Visible-Light Water Treatment Using Graphene–TiO₂ Nanocomposites and Immobilized Microbial Consortia
projects.desc: A reusable water-treatment prototype combining visible-light graphene–TiO₂ photocatalysis with immobilized microbial consortia to tackle persistent pollutants. Tested on real contaminated water, with controlled lab trials achieving 93% atrazine and 91% BPA degradation in 24 hours; treatment efficiency stayed above 85% after 10 reuse cycles. Designed for agricultural and small industrial wastewater, with an estimated treatment cost of $0.19/m³ and a pathway to modular deployment.

projects.title: The Smart Plant: An Automatic Water-Saving Irrigation System
projects.desc: The Smart Plant is an automatic irrigation system that monitors soil moisture using a smart sensor. When the soil becomes dry, the system automatically turns on the water pump and stops when the soil reaches the appropriate moisture level. This system helps reduce unnecessary watering and conserve water. It has a simple design and is easy to use. The model was built using LEGO pieces to combine technology, sustainability, and plant care.

projects.title: نخلة وطن
projects.desc: بناء أكثر من نوع للروبوت  spike prime   لاداء بعض المهام داخل مزرعة نخيل وذلك لحل بعض المشاكل  سواء كانت تلك المشاكل خاصة بجمع التمور وفرز التمور وأيضاً جمع سيقان النخل تصميم روبوت من نوع spike prime  يقوم بجمع انواع التمور المختلفة ويقوم وضعها فى مكان تجميع التمور تمهيداً لفرزها   تم تصميم روبوت من نوع spike prime  يقوم بفرز انواع التمور المختلفة على حسب لون التمر وذلك من خلال إضافة حساس اللون لتصميم الروبوت تصميم روبوت من نفس النوع لجعل السيقان تتحرك الياً بطريقه سلسة ومهمة لتكون بيئة متكاملة

projects.title: NeuroFlex
projects.desc: Half of all prosthetic users abandon their devices — because current limbs restore movement but not feeling, drain battery within hours, and never adapt. NeuroFlex integrates smart materials, self-charging energy, neural control, and sensory skin into one device that moves by thought, feels by touch, and powers itself by motion. When a patient is offered their limb back, they deserve a limb — not a machine.

projects.title: المعلم الذكي_اسال وفكر
projects.desc: مشروعي هو تطبيق تعليمي للأطفال، يركز على تنمية التفكير بدلاً من إعطاء الإجابات بشكل مباشر. المشكلة أن الأطفال عند السؤال يحصلون غالباً على الجواب جاهز وفوري، وهذا يقلل اعتمادهم على التفكير الذاتي والاستنتاج. لذلك، فكرة تطبيقي هي تحويل السؤال إلى سلسلة أسئلة بسيطة وتدريجية تشجع الطفل على الملاحظة والتجربة والتحليل، عشان يوصل للحل بنفسه ويكتسب ثقة. وإذا لم يعرف، التطبيق يعطيه تلميحات مناسبة للعمر ويشجعه على المحاولة من جديد، مما ينمي الفضول ومهارات التفكير وحل المشكلات بطريقة ممتعة وشكرا لكم......

projects.title: Production of clean hydrogen using plastic waste via photocatalytic reforming
projects.desc: Most hydrogen is still made from fossil fuels, while PET waste resists recycling. Photoreforming addresses both: under light, Pt/TiO₂ oxidises plastic-derived compounds and reduces water to hydrogen. A 0.2 wt.% Pt/TiO₂ catalyst yielded hydrogen from ethylene glycol and about twelve times less from PET; none formed without light, catalyst or feedstock. Substrate accessibility is the bottleneck, so alkaline pre-hydrolysis of PET and quantum-yield measurement follow.

projects.title: Smart Anti-Drowsiness Cap(alertX)
projects.desc: Our project, the Smart Anti-Drowsiness Cap, aims to detect signs of drowsiness through head movements and tilt. Using an ESP32 and an MPU6050 motion sensor, the cap monitors the user’s head position in real time. If the head remains tilted beyond a certain threshold, a buzzer and LED activate to alert the user. The goal is to provide a simple, low-cost, portable, and practical solution to reduce risks caused by fatigue and loss of attention.

projects.title: Saudi Ziziphus Leaf Powder for Sustainable Drilling Fluids
projects.desc: Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 promotes sustainability and local resource utilization. This study develops an eco-friendly drilling-fluid additive from native Sidr leaf powder to replace synthetic PAC-LV. XRD, XRF, SEM, TGA, and FTIR confirmed its cellulose-rich structure, mineral content, and thermal stability. At 10 g, it achieved stable rheology, suitable pH, and effective fluid-loss control comparable to PAC-LV, supporting greener, localized drilling technology.

projects.title: Hemasense
projects.desc: HemaSense is a smart wearable health device designed for the early screening of inherited blood disorders, including sickle cell disease, thalassemia, and G6PD deficiency. The device uses tiny microneedles to collect a very small blood sample and analyze it. The results are then sent wirelessly to a smart mobile application. The application combines and analyzes the data using an intelligent algorithm and presents the screening result clearly, indicating whether follow-up or further medical test

projects.title: Temperature-Driven Microstructure Control in Sustainable Powder Metallurgy
projects.desc: A 10% lighter car gets 6 to 8% better fuel economy, and aluminum weighs a third as much as steel. We mapped how sintering temperature shapes parts made from pure aluminum powder by high-frequency induction heating. From 400 to 600°C, density rose from 81.5% to 99.5%, but was 91% complete by 500°C while strength kept rising. The result is an energy-optimized sintering recipe: 500°C when density matters, 600°C for load-bearing parts, backed by a predictive density model.

projects.title: تقييم أثر التلوث الصناعي على نمو النباتات وتطوير النظام إضاءة تكيفي ذكي(Eco-sheld)
projects.desc: مشروع يحل مشكلة التلوث الضوئي المستمر في المناطق الصناعية وأثره السلبي على الغطاء النباتي. أثبتت تجاربنا المخبرية الموثقة أن التعرض للضوء 24 ساعة يسبب إجهاد ضوئي يخل بتوازن النبات ويؤخر الإنبات مقارنة بالدورة الطبيعية. نقدم نظام Eco-Shield الذكي والتكيفي للتحكم بشدة الإضاءة وتوجيهها حسب الحاجة التشغيلية، مما يحمي البيئة النباتية المجاورة ويوفر حتى 40% من استهلاك الطاقة دون المساس بمعايير الأمان والسلامة الصناعية.

projects.title: Khameer baker
projects.desc: Traditional Saudi khameer bread is slow and physically demanding to make, putting the recipe at risk of being lost between generations. Our automated dough maker, built on a Raspberry Pi 5, uses temperature, ultrasonic, and gas sensors to follow the dough's progress instead of a fixed timer. Live readings appear on an LCD, and the system tells the user when the dough is ready. It makes khameer accessible to older and younger people alike, helping preserve this tradition.

projects.title: BASMA - SAIF
projects.desc:
في عالم تتطور فيه التقنية بسرعة، لم تعد حماية الأجهزة والأنظمة الرقمية تعتمد فقط على كلمات المرور أو الحواجز التقليدية. فالجهاز قد يبدو أصلياً من الخارج، وقد تحمل مكوناته بيانات صحيحة، لكن السؤال الأهم هو: هل يتصرف بالطريقة التي يُفترض أن يتصرف بها؟

من هنا جاءت BASMA – بصمة، وهي منظومة تقنية تهدف إلى بناء مفهوم أكثر ذكاءً للتحقق من أصالة الأجهزة وسلوكها الرقمي. تعتمد الفكرة على مبدأ بسيط ومهم: لكل جهاز سلوك مميز، وهذا السلوك يمكن أن يشكل بصمته الرقمية.

projects.title: راصد Rasid
projects.desc: "راصد" RASID — نظام ذكاء اصطناعي يرصد كثافة الحشود آنياً في أي مكان: مساجد، مواقع سياحية، مراكز تسوق، ومطاعم. يكشف الأشخاص بنموذج YOLO عبر كاميرا على Raspberry Pi، يُحلّل الازدحام، ويتنبأ به خلال 30–60 دقيقة، ثم يُوصي كل زائر بأفضل وقت للزيارة أو يقترح بديلاً قريباً. يخدم ملايين الزوار في المملكة دعماً لرؤية 2030 وتعزيزاً للأمن العام.

projects.title: Madar: On-Site AI Guardian for Smart-City IoT Devices
projects.desc: Madar is an on-site AI guardian for smart-city IoT devices. A Raspberry Pi 5 plugged into the router learns the normal behavior of each camera and sensor, then detects faults and intrusions within seconds and explains why. Devices join Madar's protected Wi-Fi, so a compromised one can be isolated. Private by design: no cloud, and no traffic content is read. In simulation it caught 78.6% of faulty readings with 0.23% false alarms, flagging a fault in 3 seconds.

projects.title: Cyber Threats Detector - Raqib
projects.desc: Online scams are getting harder to spot—even a whole family was recently tricked by a fake renewal site. That’s why we built Raqib. Raqib checks links and websites instantly. Instead of confusing tech warnings, it tells you in plain words if a site is safe—before you share your personal or payment info.

projects.title: Creating a Hybrid Green Porous Adsorbent with Modified MOF-303@Nano-Biochar for Water Vapor Capture
projects.desc:
Problem Excessive humidity in both indoor and outdoor settings present serious problems for infrastructure health and comfort.
The goal is to accomplish high-capacity fast and reusable moisture adsorption in realistic environmental settings.
Techniques MOF-303 and functionalized nano-biochar were combined to create the hybrid material which is a highly porous network with lots of active sites. Its structural morphological and surface properties were studied using FTIR XRD SEM TEM and BET analyze

projects.title: TerraScan
projects.desc: Water pollution is usually found after the damage is done. TerraScan NanoNet is a network of low-cost, solar-powered floating buoys designed to watch a water body continuously. Each buoy checks pH, dissolved solids, turbidity and temperature, spots unusual readings itself, and sends GPS-tagged alerts by long-range radio to a live map, showing where pollution starts and spreads so authorities can act in time. Est. cost: $16–41 per buoy. Design-stage concept.

projects.title: PresenceIQ
projects.desc: Homes waste energy cooling and lighting empty rooms, and schedule-based smart homes can't keep up with real life. PresenceIQ is an AI-powered web app that links IoT sensors and smart meters to learn room occupancy and predict usage, then automatically controls AC, lighting, water heating, and EV charging using forecasts and electricity pricing. In Saudi Arabia, where AC uses 60–70% of household power, it could cut HVAC use by 15–25% and save 1,200–2,500 SAR per year.

projects.title: Space Mirror- A device combines AI and IR sensor , it spread the…
projects.desc: -Space Mirror- A device combines AI and IR sensor , it spread the awareness of space science and environment  problems in interactive way for different segment of society : kids , adults , elders, non-verbal . controls via touch and eye blinks and buttons , and it has buzzer for sounds effects

projects.title: جهاز مراقبة صحة الجلد الذكي SSHM
projects.desc:
جهاز SSHM هو جهاز ذكي مصمم لمراقبة حالة القدم  لدى كبار السن او مرضى السكر داخل الحذاء من خلال ارسال تنبيهات لمستخدميه . 
ظهرت فكرة جهازنا عندما وجدنا مشاكل في القدم لدى كبار السن او مرضى السكري. 
 أستعملنا التكنولوجيا لحل هذه المشكلة عبر ارسال بيانات مستمرة للمستخدمي جهازنا للوقاية من مشاكل القدم. 
و بمجرد أن يُظهِر الجهاز حالة خطر، سيحصل المستخدم على بيانات مفصلة لحالة القدم على الهاتف الذكي.

projects.title: نظام اتصالات ضوئية لاسلكية ذكي ومترابط شبكياً عبر بنية الإنارة الحضرية
projects.desc: تتضمن المبادرة نظاماً مبتكراً للاتصالات الرقمية اللاسلكية يعتمد على استغلال البنية التحتية القائمة لأعمدة إنارة الشوارع الحضرية كمنصات نقل بيانات تقنية (Li-Fi) عبر مصابيح الـ LED يتم ربط هذه الأعمدة في شبكة مترابطة (Mesh Network) تدار بذكاء اصطناعي يقوم بتحليل وتوجيه مسارات البيانات دينامياً واكتشاف الأعطال وتفادي الحجب لحظياً يوفر النظام بديلاً آمناً وعالي السرعة للترددات الراديوية مع خفض استهلاك الطاقة وتكاليف التأسيس معززاً كفاءة تقنيات المدن الذكية ومحققا استدامة الاتصالات الرقمية

projects.title: EchoShield: A Smart Security System for Protecting Oil Facilities from Hybrid Cyber-Physical Threats
projects.desc: EchoShield is an integrated smart security system protecting oil facilities from hybrid cyber-physical threats. It combines vibration sensors, sound detection, fingerprint authentication, network monitoring, AI analysis, and a centralized dashboard. The system provides early warning, gradual alerts, real-time decision support, and builds security awareness among personnel. Cost-effective, easy to integrate, and designed for harsh environments.

projects.title: DualVerify
projects.desc: DualVerify combines RFID and computer vision to secure school entrances against stolen or shared badges. A probabilistic algorithm links card reads with visual tracking using a 3-tier decision model (Green, Yellow, Red). Operating offline without storing video, it protects student privacy while ensuring real-time headcount auditing. Simulations proved 100% anomaly detection and reduced security risk to 5.9%.

projects.title: Ain Al-Haris: A Smart Platform for Reporting, Tracking and Managing Hazards and Incidents
projects.desc: Ain Al-Haris is a smart platform for monitoring risks and accidents. Users can submit reports with locations, photos, or videos, then track each report from submission to resolution. The platform displays dangerous areas, accidents, and reports on an interactive map, making it easier to identify risks and respond quickly. Its goal is to improve safety through organized and efficient reporting.

projects.title: the eye drop assist device
projects.desc: This project focuses on designing 3D-printed device to help individuals with Parkinson’s disease apply eye drops more easily. Parkinson’s disease cause hard tremors and reduced motor control,Making precise tasks difficult. The device was designed and printed to stabilize the hand and guide the eye bottle into position.Testing showed that the device Improved , reduced spills, and made the process easier.

projects.title: Sport-pop
projects.desc: Sport-pop هو تطبيق رياضي يساعد المستخدمين على اكتشاف الأماكن الرياضية القريبة والمناسبة لهم، ومعرفة مستوى الازدحام والمرافق الموجودة. ويساعدهم بعد على إيجاد أشخاص عندهم نفس الاهتمامات والمستوى الرياضي، ومتابعة خطواتهم وسعراتهم ونشاطهم اليومي. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، فيه روبوت يساعد الأشخاص اللي يواجهون مشاكل أو صعوبة في ممارسة بعض الرياضات، ويعطيهم إرشادات تساعدهم على تحسين مهاراتهم والتطور فيها. هدفنا من التطبيق هو نخلي ممارسة الرياضة أسهل وأكثر متعة وتفاعل، ونشجع الأفراد والعائلات والأصدقاء على يكون

projects.title: This research presents an integrated system that reacts recycled…
projects.desc: This research presents an integrated system that reacts recycled aluminum with sodium hydroxide to produce hydrogen and heat. The heat is used to desalinate seawater, while the resulting steam generates electricity. The system produces three products—pure fuel,freshwater, and electricity—with sodium aluminate as the only byproduct, achieving up to 92% hydrogen production efficiency.

projects.title: Developing a program that analyzes electronic links and detects…
projects.desc: Developing a program that analyzes electronic links and detects signs that may indicate they are suspicious or fraudulent, helping users avoid dangerous links before opening them.

projects.title: ATeek Ecosystem
projects.desc: نظام بيئي متكامل يعتمد على الذكاء الاصطناعي والمقابلة البصرية (Computer Vision) لمراقبة الأماكن العامة ورصد المخالفات البيئية لحظياً. يتعرف النظام على واقعة رمي النفايات بدقة، ويطابق هوية المخالف بقاعدة البيانات لإصدار التنبيه فوراً، ثم يرسل إشارات لاسلكية لروبوت ميداني ذكي مزود بذراع ميكانيكية ليتجه لموقع النفايات ويجمعها تلقائياً بدون تدخل بشري.

projects.title: AI-Powered Decision Support System for Proactive Hospital Network Readiness
projects.desc: What if hospitals could anticipate overcrowding before it happens? This AI-powered decision support system predicts emergency capacity surges two hours ahead and assesses operational readiness using a Hospital Readiness Index (HRI). It transforms predictions into early alerts and recommends suitable hospitals for non-critical patients based on readiness and proximity. Tested on historical data, the system supports safer emergency care and proactive hospital coordination under human oversight.

projects.title: كوليسِنس — ColiSense
projects.desc: A smart wearable device designed to help people with Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS) relieve pain and monitor their symptoms. The device is placed on the abdomen and contains sensors that detect physical changes associated with symptoms. It connects to a mobile application and uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) to analyze the collected data, identify patterns and factors that may be associated with increased symptoms, and provide personalized support. The goal is to help patients manage their condition in daily life so that IBS does not become a barrier to their activities and quality of life.

projects.title: This project develops eco-friendly Dye-Sensitized Solar Cells…
projects.desc: This project develops eco-friendly Dye-Sensitized Solar Cells (DSSCs) using natural pigments from pomegranate, red onion, red grape, and mango peels. A TiO₂/GCN nanocomposite was used to improve light absorption and charge transport. Pomegranate peel dye achieved the best performance, with 0.63 V open-circuit voltage, 5.90 mA/cm² current density, and 1.67% efficiency. The results highlight the potential of food waste for sustainable, low-cost solar energy.

projects.title: Muain closes the information gap before it costs valuable care time
projects.desc: Muain closes the information gap before it costs valuable care time. Built for the Saudi healthcare ecosystem, it listens to patients through adaptive questions, guides them to the right clinic, and delivers a concise clinical summary to the physician before the visit. Care continues beyond the consultation through follow-up and an authorized Family Caregiver. Muain turns fragmented information into connected care—so doctors start with the story, not from zero, and every minute counts.

projects.title: National Platform for Forecasting and Response to National Observatories
projects.desc: The National Platform for Forecasting and Response to National Observatories is a unified government system for monitoring and analyzing environmental, climate, traffic, service, health, and public safety risks. Using AI, integrated and real-time data, it forecasts risks, supports decision-making, accelerates response, and strengthens coordination among government entities, improving service efficiency and quality of life while supporting Saudi Vision 2030 and advanced digital transformation now

projects.title: P.U.L.S.E: AI‑Driven Structural and Environmental Risk Monitoring for Smart City Infrastructure
projects.desc: P.U.L.S.E is an AI‑driven system designed to evaluate structural and environmental conditions through real‑time sensor data. By integrating inputs from 2 MPU6050, 4 GUVAS12SD, and 6 DHT22 sensors, it compares readings, detects instability, computes health scores, and generates retrofit recommendations displayed through our app. Developed for smart city infrastructure, the system enhances early risk identification and supports more informed, data‑based decisions on structural safety.

projects.title: Smart Cooling Fabric Using Thermal Radiation Control for Hot Climate Comfort
projects.desc: This research proposes a smart cooling fabric concept based on controlling thermal radiation and heat transfer to improve human comfort in hot climates. The proposed fabric aims to enhance the release of body heat through infrared radiation while reducing solar heat absorption. By applying principles of thermal emission, infrared radiation, and material properties, this physics-based solution could support the development of lightweight cooling textiles suitable for outdoor environments and high

projects.title: SunSync — Self-Aligning Solar Tracker with Environmental Sensing
projects.desc: SunSync is an original smart renewable-energy prototype integrating dual-axis solar tracking, rain detection, and energy storage. Four LDRs guide two servo motors to continuously reposition the solar panel toward the strongest light. Four piezoelectric sensors mounted on a transparent canopy detect raindrop vibrations. Solar-generated electricity is stored in a capacitor and monitored in real time using an Arduino Nano.

projects.title: Roboexplorer: The Intelligence Camera Dolly
projects.desc: RoboExplorer is an intelligent exploration robot designed to help people safely investigate dangerous or hard-to-reach environments.Using a camera and sensors, it can move through risky areas and provide visual and environmental information remotely. The project aims to reduce human exposure to danger, improve exploration efficiency, and support faster decision-making. Future development may include artificial intelligence, advanced sensors,greater autonomy,cloud-based control,and voice commands

projects.title: MHD Space Irrigation Pump
projects.desc: The MHD Space Irrigation Pump would bring a new level to plant watering in space by using magnetohydrodynamics. This would allow for a simpler, clog-free, and maintenance-free system for getting water to thirsty plants on long space missions. The pump is solid-state, requires no moving parts, operates silently, allows food production in space, and prevents the loss of a food source for a space colony. This device opens up great opportunities for space exploration.

projects.title: AnemiScan | كاشف الانيميا
projects.desc: AnemiScan is an innovative,non-invasive solution for the early detection of anemia using a smartphone camera. It works by analyzing images of the conjunctiva extracting RGB color values and calculating a redness index correlated with hemoglobin levels. AnemiScan enables rapid low-cost and user-friendly preliminary screening without the need for blood draws thereby enhancing access to early detection and supporting preventive healthcare.

projects.title: IoT Smart Flooring with a PVDF-Graphene Membrane for Energy harvesting and Visitor Analytics
projects.desc: StepToDiscover is an IoT-enabled smart flooring system that uses an innovative, flexible, lead-free PVDF/Graphene piezoelectric membrane to harvest energy from footsteps. The system supports pathway lighting and an irrigation-pump demonstration, monitors visitor occupancy, automatically controls the entrance gate, updates data in Firebase, sends Telegram alerts at full capacity, and rewards visitors with sustainability points. It promotes safer and more sustainable tourist sites.

projects.title: AEROSTREAM
projects.desc: AEROSTREAM tests closed-loop toroidal propellers to eliminate blade-tip vortices, reducing drone noise and thrust loss. Tested in a custom mini wind tunnel with a straw-honeycomb laminar inlet, incense smoke trace, and Bernoulli flow nozzle, 60 mm Standard, Bi-Toroidal, and Tri-Toroidal models were driven by a 1000KV motor. The Tri-Toroidal design achieved 2.25N static thrust (+23.6% over standard 1.82N) while cutting noise by 5.3 dB (68.9 vs 74.2 dB), offering a quiet, high-thrust UAV solutions

projects.title: Smart Underwater System for Coral Planting, Reef Monitoring & Environmental Data Management
projects.desc: CORRAS is an autonomous coral reef restoration system pairing an underwater vehicle with a solar-powered surface ship. It scans reef sites, plants coral fragments with precision, and monitors water conditions continuously. Stress and bleaching are caught early, before visible damage occurs, while every fragment is tracked by exact location for verified survival data. Designed for scale and low environmental impact, CORRAS supports Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Red Sea Sustainability.

projects.title: Ergo-Sense is a smart, portable chair-based posture monitoring…
projects.desc: Ergo-Sense is a smart, portable chair-based posture monitoring system designed to promote healthier sitting habits and reduce the risks associated with prolonged poor posture. Using strategically placed sensors, real-time alerts, and Bluetooth connectivity, the system provides immediate feedback to users and supports data-driven posture improvement. Its affordable, non-wearable design makes it suitable for offices, schools, and other work environments, with strong potential for future commercial

projects.title: SAUDAH: AI-Powered Employment Concealment Detection System
projects.desc: SAUDAH is an intelligent monitoring system designed to detect employment concealment and enhance workforce localization reliability. It combines attendance, geographic location, and employment data to build behavioral fingerprints for employees and establishments. AI analyzes unusual patterns and links recurring indicators into a cumulative suspicion score, while presenting the evidence behind each alert. This helps regulatory authorities prioritize cases and conduct more targeted inspections.

projects.title: Passive Thermal Regulation in Biomimetic Facades
projects.desc: This project investigates how biomimetic facade geometry affects internal temperature. Inspired by cactus surface geometry, three models—a flat control, ridged facade, and wavy facade—were exposed to direct sunlight for one hour. Final temperatures were 46.3°C, 45.5°C, and 44.6°C respectively. The wavy model was 1.7°C cooler than the flat control. Further trials are needed to isolate the effect of geometry.

projects.title: AimVision
projects.desc: AimVision is a smart wearable device that helps shooters improve their aiming accuracy. It combines a camera and a processing unit linked to a small screen in the shooter's field of vision. The camera captures the shooting field, and the system calculates the distance to the target and checks whether the weapon's sight is aligned with it. A green light shows proper alignment; a red light flags a deviation. It helps beginners and shooters without trainers, at low cost.

projects.title: This study reports the green synthesis of ZnO/NiO nanocomposite…
projects.desc: This study reports the green synthesis of ZnO/NiO nanocomposite using Salsola baryosma extract. XRD shows a 19.32 nm crystal size, while FT-IR confirms Zn˗O and Ni˗O peaks at 435-645 cm-1. BET analysis indicates a 6.5 m2/g surface area. Used as a glassy-carbon electrode for formaldehyde electrooxidation, it yields an anodic peak current of 14.641 mA/cm2 and stable current density at 9.2085 mA/cm2. EIS reveals enhanced charge transfer, highlighting the plant's role in sustainable nanomaterials.

projects.title: SANAD | YASFO
projects.desc: SANAD | YASFO is a proposed personalized assistive system for older adults who may struggle with digital technology. It combines voice-and-screen interaction, a personalized profile, and selected sensors to understand needs, provide daily support and safety alerts, and connect users with authorized contacts when needed. Rather than replacing family support, it strengthens communication and helps technology adapt to the older adult

projects.title: AI-Driven Autonomous Aerial System for Real-Time Environmental Violation Detection
projects.desc: An AI-driven aerial monitoring system that detects environmental violations — illegal construction, deforestation, pollution — using UAV imagery and a validated segmentation model (UNetFormer: 92.34% accuracy, 86.80% F1). A seven-agent AI framework is in development to analyze violations by category and generate structured reports for authorities, moving environmental protection from reactive to proactive.

projects.title: Misk808
projects.desc: An integrated CO₂ capture system designed to reduce the high energy demand of conventional capture methods. It recovers energy from industrial exhaust through a turbine to power much of the system, requiring only limited additional energy. The exhaust is then cooled to optimize capture conditions before entering an advanced filtration stage. Automated monitoring, control, and fail-safe mechanisms enhance reliability, while its modular design supports future industrial scaling.

projects.title: Fire Flow
projects.desc: Fire-hose faults can develop between scheduled inspections and may go unnoticed until the next check. Fire Flow proposes a non-invasive system that automatically tests hose functionality using pressure, flow, vibration, and valve-state data. The system uses AI to identify abnormal patterns, compares results with previous tests, and sends alerts when a potential fault is detected. The goal is to make fire-hose maintenance more proactive while reducing manual testing demands and preserving normal

projects.title: This research investigates converting date-palm waste into…
projects.desc: This research investigates converting date-palm waste into sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) intermediates using catalytic reactions and simulated solar-assisted heating. Extracted cellulose was converted into HMF, then upgraded to DMF through hydrogenation. HPLC, FTIR, and NMR confirmed product formation. HMF yields reached 20–50% at 180°C after 7 hours, while DMF production was effective at 160°C after 15 hours. The proposed pathway advances waste valorization and renewable fuel development.

projects.title: ذراع روبوتية موجهة بالصوت والرؤية.Voice & Vision 6-DOF Robotic Arm
projects.desc: ذراع روبوتية سداسية المحاور (6-DOF) تجمع بين الرؤية الحاسوبية المستقلة والتعرف الصوتي لتنفيذ عمليات الالتقاط والفرز المؤتمتة بدقة عالية. يعتمد النظام على معالجة الصور عبر Raspberry Pi وتوجيه المحركات باستخدام Arduino Mega لتتبع الأجسام المحددة وتنفيذ الأوامر الصوتية فورياً دون الحاجة للاتصال بالإنترنت، مما يوفر حلاً منخفض التكلفة وفعالاً لأتمتة المهام الميكانيكية بالصناعة والبيئات الذكية.

projects.title: QR Guardian
projects.desc: QR Guardian is a smart security system designed to protect users from malicious QR codes. It analyzes the link before opening it by checking the domain, HTTPS, reputation, and signs of phishing. The system then provides a clear risk rating: Safe, Suspicious, or Dangerous. The project aims to reduce phishing attacks and protect login credentials and personal information, with future potential for AI-powered detection.

projects.title: نبتكر حل مستدام للطاقة النظيفة لعمليات الفصل المائي بتطوير محفزات…
projects.desc: نبتكر حل مستدام للطاقة النظيفة لعمليات الفصل المائي بتطوير محفزات هجينة ثنائية الفلزات (FeCo/N-C و MnNi/N-C) لأنظمة PEM و AEM وتركز منهجيتنا على دراسة المحفزات محاكاة بطريقة DFT وعلى التحكم الدقيق عبر طرق التحضير لضبط النسب الذرية والتصميم الهندسي لتكوين المواقع النشطة ورفع الكفاءة إلى 92% مع تقليل الجهد الزائد 35% يعالج هذا التصميم مشاكل المقاومة الإيونية والتاكل والتفكك الكيميائي ليكون معزز لتفاعل HER ليقدم اثرا مستدام يدعم منشات طاقة الهيدروجين الصناعيه

projects.title: Smart color-Changing strip early detection of heat and humidity exposure in sensitive products
projects.desc: The Smart Indicator Strip is an adhesive label that monitors conditions in storage and transit. It has four zones: high temperature with thermochromic ink, low temperature with cold-sensitive dye, humidity with a cobalt-free indicator, and UV rays exposure with a light-sensitive dye. Each zone changes color when its limit is reached, helping detect unsuitable conditions without devices. It can be used for food, medicines, transport, and products.

projects.title: SmartPalm AI: Early Detection of Red Palm Weevil Using Acoustic AI Sensors
projects.desc: SmartPalm AI resolves the critical issue of late Red Palm Weevil detection, which causes billions in agricultural losses. Our solution uses autonomous, embedded acoustic sensors combined with highly accurate, lightweight Edge Machine Learning to identify early-stage larval activity 30–45 days before any visible tree damage occurs. We achieve >90\% acoustic detection accuracy while reducing chemical pesticide use by over 70\% through targeted, automated early intervention

projects.title: Self-Assembled Cellulose–MnO₂ Nanocomposites for Multifunctional Applications
projects.desc: The rapid advancement of multifunctional nanomaterials demands sustainable, bio-based hybrid systems. Cellulose, with its abundance, biodegradability, and robust hydrogen bonding via surface hydroxyl groups, serves as an ideal renewable template for inorganic nanostructure support.
