Manganese dioxide (MnO₂), a redox-active transition metal oxide, exhibits remarkable catalytic activity, environmental responsiveness, and ROS modulation capabilities across diverse polymorphs

projects.title: نبات | NBAT
projects.desc: موقع نبات هو موقع يساهم في تقليل التصحر في المملكة العربية السعودية عن طريق مساعده الشخص على اختيار النبات المناسب من ناحية استهلاك الماء وخواصها وبيئتها وطريقة زراعتها في اي منطقة بالمملكة ويمكنك الاختيار بسهولة تامة عن طريق الواجهة المبسطة والاحترافية ويمكنك ايضا تحديد نوع النبات عن طريق ثلاث طرق 1- AI CAMERA (عن طريق تصوير النبته وثم يساعدك الذكاء الاصطناعي على تحديدها) 2-البحث من المناطق (اختيار منطقتك واختيار النبات الذي تبحث عنه) 3-البحث من قائمة البحث عن اسم النبات    الموقع:nbat.odoo.com

projects.title: Marsad: A Privacy-Preserving Digital License Plate for Smart City Transportation
projects.desc: The MARSAD system is one of the latest innovations in License Plate Recognition as it relies on digital identification using IoT and NFC. This system makes it possible for license plates to be verified digitally and assists in detecting any sort of tampering. Some of the applications of MARSAD include Smart Parking, Speed Monitoring, and various other transportation-related applications. NFC allows people to contact the vehicle owner without sharing any of their private information.

projects.title: Fighting Global Warming with AI: Filling the Gaps in Satellite CO₂ Maps over MENA
projects.desc: Global warming is accelerating, and the Middle East and North Africa, warming at nearly twice the global rate, is among the most vulnerable regions. Yet the CO₂ driving it is barely measured: satellites observe under 4% of the MENA region's surface each month. Our lightweight deep-learning model fills these gaps like a photo editor restoring an image, guided by weather data. The completed maps can help track emissions and test climate pledges, turning a blind spot into something we can see.

projects.title: صقر الميدان طائرة مسيّرة رباعية المراوح تساند فرق البحث والإنقاذ في…
projects.desc: صقر الميدان طائرة مسيّرة رباعية المراوح تساند فرق البحث والإنقاذ في المناطق الصحراوية والجبلية التي يصعب مسحها براً. تحمل كاميرا بصرية وأخرى حرارية على جيمبال ثنائي المحاور يثبّت الصورة، وتبث مشهدًا جويًا حيًا إلى محطة تحكم أرضية مع ربط كل لقطة بإحداثيات GPS، فيحصل الفريق على بيانات موقع جاهزة بدل التقدير اليدوي. تُدار بنظام طيران آلي يُختبر في المحاكاة أولاً، وتبقى تحت إشراف بشري مع قناة تحكم يدوي احتياطية، فهي أداة مساندة لا تغني عن القرار البشري.

projects.title: The BiSense bandage is a 3D-printed device with a transparent…
projects.desc: The BiSense bandage is a 3D-printed device with a transparent window that uses colorimetric strips to monitor pH and bleeding, allowing patients and doctors to track wound healing, prevent infection, and intervene early. This cost-effective, non-invasive device provides real-time feedback, reduces dressing changes, and supports clinical and home care by monitoring healing, preventing complications, detecting infections, and assessing progress.

projects.title: TFP/EtBr COF@GO Membrane: Ultra-High Flux, Low-Pressure Pharmaceutical & Dye Wastewater Removal
projects.desc: Textile dyes & pharmaceutical residues co-contaminate wastewater, yet conventional treatments remove them poorly. We developed a TFP/EtBr covalent organic framework nanosheet-graphene oxide hybrid membrane cast on PES. The COF@GO membranes achieved ~99% rejection of dyes and >75% of drugs, with pure water flux up to ~1100 LMH at 1 bar. Higher COF loading improved small-drug rejection, and performance stayed stable over 10 filtration cycles. Reagent cost is about $9.48 per 12.57 cm² active layer.

projects.title: Magnetic Anti-nuclear Disabling And Containment (MADAC)
projects.desc: The (MADAC) system intercepts and disables nuclear warheads, eliminating radioactive contamination without detonation or human intervention. On approach, it emits a low-frequency magnetic field penetrating heavy shielding to inductively disable fuzes remotely. A modular vault then captures the inert warhead protecting the plutonium core and seals pyrotechnically with 100% containment. Steering thrusters divert the capsule to land as safe scrap, reducing costs by 80%.

projects.title: Sustainable Waste Al-Air Battery Performance Enhancement and Real-Time SOH Optical Diagnostics
projects.desc: Aluminum-air batteries promise ~8,100 Wh/kg, yet anode self-corrosion in alkali wastes metal, and industrial inhibitors add heavy metals. Carbon-dot inhibitors are greener, but none is petroleum-derived or exploits its fluorescence. Petroleum coke, an abundant Saudi refinery residue, was converted hydrothermally with urea and thiourea into ~10 nm carbon quantum dots fluorescing blue at 425 nm. Mentorship will test them as dual corrosion inhibitors and in-situ optical state-of-health probes.

projects.title: Proactive Cyber Shield الدرع السيبراني الاستباقي
projects.desc:
Our project, Proactive Cyber Shield, is a smart cybersecurity solution designed to help protect digital systems from suspicious and potentially harmful requests. We created this project because cyber threats are becoming more common and can affect individuals, organizations, and digital services. Our goal is to provide a simple, practical, and proactive way to detect suspicious activity before it can cause serious damage.

The main idea behind Proactive Cyber Shield is to analyze incoming reques

projects.title: Stones of the Homeland: A Talking Stone Map
projects.desc: Stones of the Homeland turns marble and granite waste from the CPC factory into an interactive mosaic map of Saudi Arabia. Six stone panels each speak a national value: generosity, giving, ambition, vision, solidarity and authenticity. Touch a panel and its borders light up as it tells its story. Tested: 6/6 panels respond in 0.5 s with zero false triggers, and 90% of visitors said it helped them understand our values. 16 kg of waste reused for about 280 SAR.

projects.title: تطوير منهج حاسوبي قائم على الذكاء الاصطناعي
projects.desc:
:

يهدف المشروع إلى تطوير منهج حاسوبي قائم على الذكاء الاصطناعي لتحليل البيانات الجزيئية المرتبطة بالتليف الرئوي مجهول السبب، وتحديد وترتيب المرشحات العلاجية المحتملة وفق علاقتها بالأهداف والمسارات الحيوية المرتبطة بالمرض. ويتميز المشروع بدمج تحليل البيانات الجزيئية مع تقنيات التعلم الآلي وقابلية تفسير النتائج، بما يساعد على تضييق نطاق البحث عن المرشحات الواعدة وتوجيه الدراسات المستقبلية نحوها. ويسعى المشروع إلى دعم المراحل المبكرة من اكتشاف العلاجات، مع إمكانية التحقق من المرشحات الناتجة مخبريً

projects.title: SMS Shield
projects.desc: More than half of people in Saudi Arabia have received a scam attempt. Fake messages trick them into clicking links or sharing bank codes. SMS Shield is a simple checker made for Arabic messages. You paste a message, and it shows red, yellow or green, explains why (for example: it has a link and asks for your code), and tells you what to do, like forwarding it to 330330. It helps families, older parents and kids with their first phone stay safe.

projects.title: Smart Emergency Guardian (SEG): Context-Aware Verification & Risk Assessment for Home Emergencies
projects.desc: Smart Emergency Guardian (SEG) is an AI-IoT system designed to protect elderly people living alone by intelligently verifying potential emergencies before responding. Using multimodal data and contextual analysis, SEG distinguishes genuine emergencies from false alarms, assesses risk, and triggers an appropriate automated response. By combining intelligent verification with proactive intervention, SEG aims to reduce false alarms, accelerate emergency response, and enhance safety.

projects.title: Smart Ambulance System for AI-Based Call Analysis and Emergency Response
projects.desc: The project consists of smart emergency response systems that use artificial intelligence to analyze emergency reports—whether text or voice—to make decisions with high accuracy and speed. This system also determines the level of danger, the location, the necessary requirements, and the fastest and most appropriate way to monitor the situation until help arrives. The ultimate goal is to reduce response time , improve efficiency and resource management, and save lives.

projects.title: Multi-Sensor Early Fire Detection and Prediction System via LoRa Mesh
projects.desc: This project presents a sustainable multi-sensor system for early fire detection and false alarm reduction. Driven by an ESP32-S3 using Edge AI and ARIMA, it integrates UV flame, smoke, PM2.5, temp, and GPS sensors to evaluate real-time risks. Alerts are transmitted long-range via a Gateway-Free LoRa Mesh network with zero cellular reliance. Achieving 98.5% reliability and <0.5s latency, solar power ensures continuous off-grid operation in remote areas.

projects.title: RLAD: Reinforcement Learning for Alumina Digestion
projects.desc: Alumina plants rely on fixed PID controllers that can't adapt when ore quality changes, wasting energy and yield. RLAD trains two Reinforcement Learning agents (Q-Learning and a from-scratch DQN) to control temperature and pressure together in a simulated Bayer digestion vessel. Tested across baseline, drifting and shock scenarios, DQN cut temperature error from ~34 °C to under 6 °C and doubled Fixed PID's reward, prototype is within a web app with a built-in economic calculator.

projects.title: WA’I: An AI-Driven Smart Resource Management System for Aramco Stadium
projects.desc: As Saudi Arabia prepares to host the FIFA World Cup 2034, stadiums will face growing demands for water, electricity, and essential services. Starting with Aramco Stadium, WA’I uses IoT sensors, AI prediction, smart robotics, and a visitor app to monitor resources, predict demand, reduce waste, and optimize consumption while maintaining an exceptional visitor experience. WA’I connects sustainability, smart resource management, and better service for every visitor

projects.title: NAJAT | SMART RESCUE BELT FOR CHILDREN
projects.desc: NAJAT -  is a smart wearable rescue belt designed to add an extra layer of protection for children in swimming environments. It monitors motion, water immersion, and heart rate through connected sensors, analyses warning patterns using an ESP32-based system, and sends real-time safety alerts to a guardian’s mobile app. In an emergency, the child can trigger SOS or flotation manually, while the guardian can activate electronic flotation remotely, helping provide buoyancy until assistance arrives.

projects.title: SCOUT-SPARTON
projects.desc:
Self-hosted server dashboards like Coolify let small teams run their own apps without relying on big cloud platforms. The problem: these dashboards hold the keys to the whole server, and most of the security flaws found in them so far can be triggered by someone who only has a low-level account, not an administrator. We looked at 147 publicly disclosed security flaws across five of these dashboards and found that nearly 80% of them start exactly that way.

So we built a small, focused shield. It sits in front of the dashboard and watches for the exact kind of malicious input these flaws rely on, blocking it before it reaches the software, without waiting for the vendor's official patch. We are now testing in a lab how many real flaws it actually stops, how often it wrongly blocks normal use, and how much it slows things down. We publish the results either way, including where it fails.

projects.title: مجد " راوي المجد
projects.desc:
راوي المجد – حين يروي الروبوت حكاية وطن

تخيل أن تدخل إلى عالمٍ يجتمع فيه التاريخ مع التكنولوجيا، وأن تقف أمام روبوت لا يكتفي بالحركة والتنقل، بل يأخذك في رحلة تفاعلية عبر صفحات المجد في تاريخ المملكة العربية السعودية. من هنا جاءت فكرة «راوي المجد»؛ مشروع روبوتي تعليمي يسعى إلى تقديم التاريخ الوطني بأسلوب مبتكر يجمع بين المعرفة والتقنية والتفاعل.

يأخذك «راوي المجد» في رحلة زمنية تبدأ من مرحلة التأسيس على يد الملك عبدالعزيز بن عبدالرحمن آل سعود، وتمر بمحطات مهمة في مسيرة المملكة، وصولًا إلى عهد

projects.title: This study aims to develop rapid ATR-FTIR screening coupled with…
projects.desc: This study aims to develop rapid ATR-FTIR screening coupled with chemometrics to detect DEG and EG contamination in pharmaceutical excipients at or near the applicable 0.10% limit. Performance will be evaluated against GC-FID, including sensitivity, specificity, and external batch validation. The method aims to identify suspicious batches for confirmatory analysis without replacing compendial testing or independently approving materials.

projects.title: Problem Statement
projects.desc:
Problem Statement: AI Data Exposure and Uncontrolled Execution Risks in Manufacturing

As manufacturing companies integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and automated AI agents into their operations, two critical vulnerabilities emerge:

1. Proprietary Data Leakage via Continuous Learning:

Employees using public or cloud-hosted AI tools often input sensitive operational data, trade secrets, machinery telemetry, and proprietary code. When standard cloud models log these interactions to retrain f

projects.title: مدينة سياحية مصغرة تجمع أشهر المعالم العالمية في مكان واحد، وتحول…
projects.desc:
مدينة سياحية مصغرة تجمع أشهر المعالم العالمية في مكان واحد، وتحول كل معلم إلى نقطة ذكية قادرة على التعرف على وجود الزوار تقديم معلومات تفاعلية باللغات المختلفة والإجابة عن أسئلتهم بواسطة الذكاء الاصطناعي مع منظومة متكاملة لاكتشاف الأخطار والاستجابة للحوادث.
miniature tourist city that brings together the world’s most famous landmarks in one place, transforming each landmark into a smart point capable of detecting the presence of visitors, providing interactive information in different languages,

projects.title: ABYSS
projects.desc: ABYSS is an autonomous deep-sea research submarine using Edge AI, smart navigation, Virtual Anchor, 8 Micro-Jets with AHP, sonar, cameras and sensors. It builds a real-time 3D Digital Twin and archives discoveries. Robotic arms, high-pressure microbial, genomic and protein modules enable in-situ research. It explores vents, manages energy/noise, self-cleans sensors, protects wildlife, and uses limited attractants to observe rare species without capture.

projects.title: Digital Traces Detection System for Missing Files and Data
projects.desc: An intelligent system that helps detect residual digital traces associated with missing files and data by analyzing multiple digital sources and extracting relevant indicators. The system organizes and correlates these traces chronologically to provide a clearer view of events. It aims to support digital forensic investigators by simplifying the analysis of fragmented evidence and identifying information that may help trace missing digital evidence.

projects.title: A Smart System for Monitoring Crohn's Disease and Early Warning
projects.desc: A smart monitoring system designed for Crohn disease that collects body temperature heart rate blood oxgen saturation and ambient temperature and humidity. it stores time stamped readings and alerts for abnormal changes. A future wearable version will add activity tracking skin temperature and sweat sensing with data analysis bassed on each patient personal baseline to study early deterioration

projects.title: PARALLAX is an AI system that works with sensor data that may be…
projects.desc: PARALLAX is an AI system that works with sensor data that may be noisy, incomplete, or conflicting. Instead of simply combining all the readings, it looks at why they may disagree and considers different possible explanations. It then uses the physical relationships of the system to estimate what is most likely happening. If the system is still uncertain, it can look for another observation that could help.

projects.title: Sustainable Agricultural and Food System
projects.desc: An integrated robotic system that combines agriculture with full automation: Moving nano-panels made up of tiny cells that can be moved to control light and heat and also generate solar energy. Sensing and pruning plants automatically. Smart harvesting using a conveyor belt to sort the produce as it is harvested. A complete system for recycling rainwater that also extracts energy. The system increases agricultural production by 30% to 50%. It reduces agricultural losses to 2% to 3%. The projecte

projects.title: Chlorella vulgaris Extract for Biocontrol of Mosquito Larvae in Stagnant Freshwater Bodies
projects.desc: This study tests Chlorella vulgaris algae extract as a natural alternative to chemical pesticides for controlling mosquito larvae in freshwater bodies. As chemical spraying loses effectiveness due to resistance and causes toxic accumulation, the extract destroys larvae internally and filters organic matter to reduce water's attractiveness for egg-laying. Results show pest control while protecting ecosystems from toxins, supporting sustainability and public health under Vision 2030.

projects.title: Cooperative Multi-Drone System for Locating Missing Persons in the Desert via Wireless Signal Fusion
projects.desc: The Ingad Search and Rescue Team documented 142 people going missing in the Kingdom's deserts within a single year; 28 of them died and 14 were never found. Many of these areas have no mobile coverage, so a missing person cannot call for help. Our project proposes three drones working together that pick up the wireless signals automatically sent by the missing person's phone or watch, even without a network connection. Each drone records the signal strength and its own location at the moment of

projects.title: منصّة Quantum Learning Lab
projects.desc: منصّة Quantum Learning Lab: موقع تعليمي تفاعلي يعلّم مبادئ الحوسبة الكمية لطلاب الثانوية بالعربية، عبر محاكي Quirk داخل المتصفح دون أي تثبيت. يضم 6 مفاهيم، 8 بوابات كمّية، 6 تجارب عملية، أنشطة ومشاريع، واختبارًا من 20 سؤالًا، مع قسم للمعلم ومساعد ذكي. يحوّل الرياضيات المعقّدة إلى تجارب بصرية ممتعة، ويحلّ ندرة المحتوى العربي في هذا المجال، بفرصة توسّع للمدارس والدورات التدريبية.

projects.title: مستكشف السلامة العنكبوتي (Hexapod Safety Explorer
projects.desc:
**مستكشف السلامة العنكبوتي (Hexapod Safety Explorer)** هو روبوت إنقاذ ذكي سداسي الأرجل، مُصمم للاستكشاف الميداني في البيئات الضيقة والكوارث والمناطق المنهارة التي يصعب على الإنسان والمركبات التقليدية الوصول إليها.

يعتمد الروبوت على أرجل مفصلية مرنة تمنحه توازناً وحركة فائقة في التضاريس الوعرة، ومُزود بكاميرا ذكاء اصطناعي (Computer Vision) للتعرف الفوري على المخاطر والأشخاص والمسارات الآمنة. كما يضم مستشعرات بيئية لنقل قراءات الحرارة والغازات والبث المباشر للتحكم، مما يقلل المخاطر البشرية ويرفع

projects.title: ROOTERA
projects.desc: ROOTERA هو جهاز زراعي ذكي يساعد على ترشيد استهلاك المياه وتحسين رعاية النباتات. يعتمد على حساس لقياس رطوبة التربة وتحليل البيانات لتحديد احتياج النبات للماء، ثم يعرض توصية واضحة عبر التطبيق: لا حاجة للري، الري قريبًا، أو الري الآن. يساهم ROOTERA في تقليل الري غير الضروري، والمحافظة على المياه، ودعم الزراعة المستدامة من خلال ري النبات في الوقت المناسب.

projects.title: صقر السماء Sky Falcon
projects.desc: صقر السماء نظام دفاعي منخفض التكلفة يحمي المنشآت الحساسة من الطائرات المسيّرة، ويميّزها عن الطيور تلقائيًا باستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي، فيقلّل الإنذارات الكاذبة. يعمل بأربع طبقات: الأولى تكشف الإشارة اللاسلكية، والثانية كاميرا مع رادار دوبلر يحللان الجسم ويكشفانه، والثالثة ميكروفون، والرابعة والأخيرة حساس ألتراسونيك. ويُبنى من قطع متوفرة بدل الأنظمة التجارية الغالية.

projects.title: NeuroControl: Edge-AI Multimodal Wearable for Real-Time Attention and ADHD-Like Pattern Detection
projects.desc: ADHD often goes undetected early, and objective EEG assessment is costly and lab-bound. NeuroControl is a low-cost edge-AI wearable integrating EEG, PPG and vision on a Raspberry Pi 5 to monitor attention and detect ADHD-like EEG patterns in real time. The ADHD model achieved 90.43% accuracy (AUC 0.971), and heart-rate estimation closely matched clinical ICU monitors (R = 0.934). At $364, it offers accessible screening support for schools and clinics, not a replacement for diagnosis.

projects.title: RadWitness
projects.desc: RadWitness is a low-cost tracked robot that goes into radiation areas instead of people: facility inspections, emergencies, and searches for lost sources in scrap and containers. A 360-degree LiDAR lets it drive itself, even in the dark, and its Geiger counter was calibrated at KACST. Every reading is saved with time and position, then digitally sealed, so inspectors can check it offline and any later change is caught and located. In tests, every value change was caught with no false alarms.

projects.title: Third Eye
projects.desc: 3rd Eye – A Voice Guide for the Visually Impaired is an AI-powered assistive technology designed to help visually impaired individuals navigate their surroundings with greater independence, confidence, and safety. By combining computer vision with intelligent voice guidance, the system interprets the user's environment and delivers real-time, easy-to-understand audio information about surrounding objects, obstacles, and potential hazards.

projects.title: Integrated System for Early Parkinson’s Detection Using Spiral Drawing and Voice Analysis
projects.desc: Motor and vocal changes often appear years before a Parkinson's diagnosis is confirmed. This project builds an affordable screening tool that flags early signs before the disease progresses, for people lacking easy access to a neurologist. Two machine learning models work together: one studies a hand-drawn spiral for tremor signs, the other a short voice recording. Results merge into one score via a simple interface, encouraging early checkups rather than replacing a doctor's diagnosis.

projects.title: Many speech-to-sign systems translate words but do not show emotion
projects.desc: Many speech-to-sign systems translate words but do not show emotion. This project developed an AI system that transcribes speech, detects emotion, analyzes voice pitch, and displays sign-language visuals with emotion-based colors. It supports American and Saudi Sign Language and presents meaning and emotional tone together. Example outputs showed red backgrounds for anger and yellow backgrounds for happiness, demonstrating the system’s visual communication approach.

projects.title: مراسي - قارب الصيد الراجل المقاوم لصدمات الأمواج
projects.desc: قارب صيد راجل مقاوم للأمواج بتصميم انسيابي يلتف تلقائياً نحو الموجة ويكسرها، مع حجرات داخلية منظمة وغطاء محكم يمنع دخول الماء ويحافظ على الأدوات، ونظام مراقبة حرارية ذكي (Arduino + DS18B20) ينبه صوتياً وبصرياً عند تجاوز 28°م لحماية جودة المحصول. حل هندسي واقتصادي (80 ريال تصنيعاً، 150-200 ريال بيعاً) يوفر بيئة صيد أكثر أماناً وكفاءة للصياد الراجل.

projects.title: Date-Palm Carbon/TiO₂ Nanocomposite for Organic Pollutant Removal from Water
projects.desc: Eco-Nano Water is a sustainable water-treatment solution that transforms date palm waste into a Date-Palm Carbon/TiO₂ nanocomposite. By combining adsorption with photocatalytic degradation, the material is designed to capture and break down organic pollutants in water. The approach offers a low-cost and sustainable alternative to conventional treatment materials while promoting agricultural-waste recycling and environmental protection

projects.title: خطوة امنة 👟
projects.desc: مشروعي عبارة عن حذاء ذكي يساعد المكفوفين على اكتشاف العوائق أثناء المشي يحتوي الحذاء على لوحة Arduino وحساس للمسافة وسماعة صغيرة يقوم الحساس باكتشاف الأجسام الموجودة أمام المستخدم وقياس المسافة بينها وبينه إذا اقترب جسم لمسافة ٢٠ سم أو أقل تصدر السماعة صوتًا لتنبيه المستخدم بوجود عائق أمامه وعند ابتعاد العائق يتوقف الصوت يهدف المشروع إلى مساعدة المكفوفين على معرفة وجود العوائق أثناء المشي بطريقة بسيطة تعتمد على الحساسات والبرمجة

projects.title: Smart Solar Energy Mangement System Using Artificial Intelligence
projects.desc: An AI and IoT-powered smart energy system designed for real-time monitoring and management of solar panels using ESP32 controllers and INA219 sensors. It features an interactive AI assistant to answer user queries, deliver accurate energy and battery analytics, and report faults. The project aims to enhance renewable energy efficiency, minimize waste, and provide seamless control with instant alerts and automated maintenance for smart city applications.

projects.title: School Mode تطبيق ذكي يحوّل جهاز الطالب الشخصي مؤقتًا إلى بيئة…
projects.desc: School Mode تطبيق ذكي يحوّل جهاز الطالب الشخصي مؤقتًا إلى بيئة تعليمية منظمة أثناء الحصة أو داخل نطاق المدرسة، مع تقليل المشتتات وإتاحة الأدوات التعليمية المناسبة. ويعود الجهاز لاستخدامه الطبيعي خارج المدرسة. كما يمكن تطويره مستقبلًا بواجهة للمعلم، وتقنية الموقع الجغرافي، ودعم أنظمة تشغيل متعددة مثل Android وiPadOS وWindows.

projects.title: Adaptive Attack-Sequence Defense (AASD)
projects.desc: Adaptive Attack-Sequence Defense (AASD) is a cybersecurity system that analyzes network event sequences and session behavior to detect anomalies, calculate dynamic risk, and trigger adaptive responses such as verification, access restriction, or device isolation.

projects.title: مَسَار+ (Masar Plus) | المواءمة والتأهيل المهني الذكي
projects.desc: مَسار+ منصة ذكية تساعد الباحث عن عمل على فهم موقعه المهني بشكل واضح. تبدأ بتحليل مهاراته ومقارنتها بمتطلبات الوظيفة التي يرغب فيها، ثم توضح له درجة المطابقة والمهارات التي يحتاج إلى تطويرها، وتقترح له تدريبًا مناسبًا لها، ثم تعيد تقييمه بعد التطوير. ايضا يقدم مَسار+  «خريطتي المهنية» لعرض الوظائف الأقرب له، و«رادار مهارات المستقبل» لمساعدته على معرفة المهارات والوظائف التي يتزايد الطلب عليها والاستعداد لها مبكرًا.

projects.title: منصة واثق
projects.desc: «منصة واثق»: بيئة تعليمية ذكية للاستعداد للاختبارات الوطنية ودعم نواتج التعلم؛ توظف تقنيات التعلم التكيفي والمسارات الذكية لقياس الأداء عبر اختبار تشخيصي، وخرائط حرارية ترصد نقاط القوة والضعف بدقة، مع جدول ذكي مخصص يتكيف مع وتيرة كل طالب لسد الفجوات التعليمية. تضم المنصة 199 مدرسة مسجلة أجرى طلبتها أكثر من 2100 محاولة تفاعلية، مع لوحات تحكم متقدمة للمعلم والإدارة وتقارير رقمية فورية قابلة للتصدير والطباعة؛ لتحفيز التنافس وصناعة تفوق مستدام.

projects.title: NOBIN/نوبين
projects.desc: **NOBIN Smart Neckband** is an innovative assistive device that detects throat vibrations during speech and converts them into text using artificial intelligence. Through a mobile application, the text can be transformed into natural-sounding speech. Lightweight, comfortable, and equipped with Bluetooth 5.3 and up to 12 hours of battery life, NOBIN supports clearer, more independent communication for people with hearing or speech disabilities.

projects.title: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles that fly in weather face big physical and…
projects.desc: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles that fly in weather face big physical and operational problems because of a tough heat‑control issue. The problem mixes outside heat from the air and the sun with the energy produced inside when the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles run at high power. This creates an engineering problem: using aerogel to fully insulate the battery keeps the battery safe from outside heat but aerogel also blocks the hot energy that comes from inside making the battery get hotter work less well and

projects.title: PainGuard
projects.desc: PainGuard is a smart support tool that helps caregivers notice potential pain in people with Alzheimer's, who may struggle to express it in words. It uses computer vision to detect facial and behavioral indicators and alerts the caregiver, with local processing and no video storage to protect patient and family privacy, designed for the Saudi context. An initial prototype that supports caregiver observation and does not diagnose. Detect potential pain. Protect

projects.title: صقر (SAQR) — منظومة الدفاع السيبراني-الفيزيائي والاستجابة الجوية الذاتية
projects.desc: صَقْر منظومة دفاعية تجعل كاميرات المنشآت الحيوية «تكسب الثقة» بدل أن تُفترض. يحسب لكل كاميرا درجة ثقة لحظية من أربع قنوات: سلامة الشبكة، سلامة البث والتوقيع، التوافق مع الكاميرات المجاورة، والبيئة اللاسلكية. فإذا زُوِّر البث أو اختُرقت العقدة عزلها آليًا واستبعد أدلتها وأطلق درونًا مستقلًا كشاهد موثوق يغطي النقطة العمياء خلال ~30 ثانية. نُفِّذ كخدمة مؤمَّنة (قياسات موقّعة، صلاحيات، سجل تدقيق مسلسل) ويعمل على كاميرا حقيقية؛ وفي توأم رقمي بـ2,400 تجربة: كشف 100٪، صفر إنذار كاذب، وسلامة أدلة 98٪.

projects.title: SADA Acoustic Intelligence for Proactive Structural Risk Detection and Forensic Audio Integrity
projects.desc:
SADA: Transforming Silent Acoustic Signals into Proactive Security Intelligence.
SADA bridges critical security gaps where optical cameras fail due to crowd occlusion. It delivers a dual-engine platform that captures micro-acoustic strain in crowd barriers for real-time failure alerts, while utilizing Mel-Spectrogram analysis to uncover spectral anomalies in digital audio for forensic inspection. SADA upgrades security infrastructure from reactive responses to predictive situational awareness.

projects.title: EduProjector AI: Smart Display Module for Real-Time Learning Gap Detection
projects.desc: The Smart Display Add-On Module empowers teachers to identify learning gaps with a single button push. Integrating a hardware trigger with Gemini AI, it analyzes student responses to simplify evaluation questions, detect concepts requiring re-explanation, and instantly alert teachers to ungrasped topic areas. Ensuring 100% audio prisvacy through immediate recording deletion, it delivers 96% accuracy for ~$28—offering a highly competitive, real-time feedback system for modern classrooms.

projects.title: Miqyas
projects.desc: Miqyas: An AI-powered system that helps entrepreneurs and business owners discover investment opportunities and develop their projects by analyzing market needs, problems, and competitors. It identifies market gaps and opportunities, then suggests scalable ideas and solutions based on data.

projects.title: Designing an innovative pair of smart glasses equipped with small…
projects.desc: Designing an innovative pair of smart glasses equipped with small vibration motors controlled by an Arduino microcontroller. The glasses provide gentle vibrations around the eye area to help relax the surrounding muscles and promote eye comfort.

projects.title: Daleel: A Smart RFID Cane for Indoor Navigation For The Visually Impaired
projects.desc: Daleel is a smart white cane that guides blind and visually impaired people inside large buildings such as hospitals. Low-cost RFID stickers are placed along the tactile floor path, and a reader in the cane tip scans them as the user walks. A speaker in the handle then announces where the user is and where to go next. It needs no phone, internet or GPS, making indoor navigation independent, accurate and affordable, and supporting Saudi Vision 2030's goal of an inclusive society.

projects.title: An automatic plant watering system uses a micro
projects.desc: An automatic plant watering system uses a micro:bit connected to a soil moisture sensor to monitor how dry the soil is. When the reading drops below a set threshold, the micro:bit triggers a relay that switches on a small water pump to irrigate the plant, then stops once the soil is moist again. The LED display can show moisture status and keep plants watered without manual effort.

projects.title: Study Flow is a web-based platform designed to help students…
projects.desc: Study Flow is a web-based platform designed to help students organize and manage their daily academic tasks efficiently. The system provides a simple dashboard for creating tasks, setting priorities, scheduling deadlines, and tracking progress. It aims to improve students’ time management, reduce missed assignments, and support better study habits through an accessible and user-friendly digital solution.

projects.title: Culture Pioneers رُواد الثقافة
projects.desc: Architectural heritage is an essential part of Saudi Arabia’s culture and identity. Over time, heritage buildings may develop cracks and damage that are difficult to detect early, while manual inspection can be difficult and risky. To address this, the Ruwwad Al-Thaqafa (Culture Pioneers) team created the “Najd Robot.” Using cameras and sensors, it monitors walls, detects changes and damage, and identifies their locations. A precise mechanical arm assists in restoration, helping protect heritage

projects.title: Lumena AI — An Adaptive AI Companion for Holistic Dyslexia Support
projects.desc: Lumena AI is an adaptive companion for holistic dyslexia support. 1 in 10 students face reading barriers plus anxiety and low self-esteem. Lumena integrates NLP text simplification, OCR, TTS, and MediaPipe focus tracking with an emotional support chatbot. This live web prototype (React, TypeScript) features a dyslexia-friendly interface, Parent Insight Hub, and gamification. By addressing academic and emotional needs together, it empowers learners, improves comprehension, and builds confidence.

projects.title: فطنة
projects.desc: رسالة واحدة قد تكلّفك حسابك. «سلامة» تكشف التصيّد الاحتيالي قبل أن تنقر. الصق أي رسالة SMS أو بريد إلكتروني، وتعرف في ثوانٍ إن كانت آمنة أو مشبوهة، مع نسبة خطورة وسبب واضح: رابط مختصر، استعجال، أو طلب بيانات حساسة. دُرّبت على أساليب الاحتيال المنتشرة في المملكة، فتحميك في اللحظة التي تقرأ فيها الرسالة. الصق. اعرف. ثق بقرارك.

projects.title: Smart Robotic System for Fish Aggregation Detection Using Sub-Surface Thermal Sensing
projects.desc: Unlock efficient and sustainable fishing with our Smart Underwater Thermal Sensing System! Designed for small to medium vessels, this innovative robotic solution monitors sub-surface temperatures in real time to locate fish aggregation zones accurately. By converting complex thermal data into instant visual and audio alerts, it eliminates random searching, cuts operational fuel costs by up to 40%, and reduces carbon emissions.

projects.title: نظام استشعار ذكي لرصد الاقتراب
projects.desc:
نظام استشعار ذكي لرصد الاقتراب
مشروع يوظف حساس المسافة لرصد مستوى الاقتراب بشكل لحظي مع ربط القراءات ببرنامج Excel لتحليل البيانات وعرضها إحصائيًا بصورة واضحة يساهم النظام في المتابعة المستمرة اكتشاف حالات الاقتراب وإصدار مؤشرات تساعد على اتخاذ القرار بسرعة ودقة

projects.title: NEXUS AUREVEIL — Evidence Audit for Early-Warning Reliability
projects.desc: NEXUS AUREVEIL is a transparent evidence-audit framework that tests whether emerging synthetic-opioid early-warning signals are genuinely reliable. It separates detection, confirmation, publication and regulatory dates, checks whether reports are independent, preserves uncertainty, and falsifies weak assumptions using dated primary sources. The result is not another alert dashboard: it is a reproducible method for showing when an early-warning system can—and cannot—be trusted.

projects.title: Aoun: An Offline Voice Guardian for Safe, Independent Seniors
projects.desc: عون مساعد صوتي ذكي لكبار السن يعمل بالكامل داخل الجوال دون إنترنت ويفهم اللهجة السعودية. يتحكم بالجوال بالصوت، ويذكّر بالدواء ومواعيد المستشفى، ويحمي من الاحتيال: إذا وصل رمز تحقق أثناء مكالمة من رقم مجهول نبّه المسن فورًا وأبلغ أبناءه. وفي الطوارئ يرصد السقوط، ويجهّز الاتصال بالإسعاف أو الشرطة أو الدفاع المدني، ويرسل موقع المسن لأبنائه، مع بطاقة طبية على شاشة القفل للمسعف.

projects.title: Rhythm of a Nation
projects.desc: Rhythm of a Nation is an interactive educational exhibit that brings Saudi musical heritage to life. Visitors use hand gestures to explore five cultural regions on an illuminated map and hear associated traditional instruments. Combining computer vision, Python software, and ESP32-controlled lighting, the prototype connects movement, sound, and geography to encourage cultural discovery in schools, museums, and exhibitions.

projects.title: Smart cities (Low-Cost, Retrofittable loT Modulefor Dynamic Smart Waste Collection)
projects.desc: ATHAR is an affordable smart trash can that automatically identifies and sorts waste into cans, paper, and plastic. Designed for schools, businesses, cities, and public spaces, it makes recycling easier and more accessible. ATHAR will be promoted through social media, environmental campaigns, schools, businesses, and partnerships with cities and environmental organizations. Its message is: “Recycling, Accessible to Everyone.”

projects.title: كاشف | Kashif
projects.desc: Kashif is a bilingual (Arabic/English) tool that checks suspicious SMS messages for scam signals: urgency, fake links, requests for codes or passwords, and explains every signal in plain language. It runs fully on the device, with no server and no message storage. Tested on an independent set of 32 messages, it reached 90.6% accuracy and 100% precision. Kashif helps students, parents and elders make one careful habit: check before you click.

projects.title: Smart Black Stone Guard
projects.desc: An autonomous AI patrol robot (LEGO SPIKE Prime & Arduino) designed for crowd safety at the Holy Kaaba. Uses MediaPipe Pose (33 skeletal landmarks) to detect fallen pilgrims in <95ms across 4 postures, triggering local visual/audio alarms and real-time cloud dispatch to field officers (tawaf.alk.sa) with a smart 4s Auto-Resolve protocol to eliminate false alarms.

projects.title: Engineering Exosome-Coated Metal-Organic Frameworks for Targeted Cancer Immunotherapy
projects.desc: Solid tumors evade immunotherapy immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) and poor drug penetration. This study engineers exosome-coated metal-organic frameworks combining ZIF-8 MOF high payload  with exosome biocompatibility (CD47-mediated immune evasion, homologous αvβ3/CD44 targeting). Exo-MOFs enable controlled release at acidic TME pH (6.5-6.8), photothermal ablation  and immune reprogramming via Nrf2/HO-1 activation, NF-κB inhibition, M2→M1 macrophage

projects.title: Designing Protection from the Molecule Up: PMAAm-b-PVIm
projects.desc: Corrosion silently weakens steel used in oil and gas, desalination, water treatment, and other industries. This project introduces a new polymer designed to protect steel by controlling its molecular structure. PMAAm-b-PVIm achieved 93.5% corrosion inhibition versus 82.5% for PVIm under identical conditions, demonstrating a promising new approach to efficient and smarter metal protection.

projects.title: When symptoms appear, people need clarity—not more searching or…
projects.desc: When symptoms appear, people need clarity—not more searching or anxiety. SymptoSense is a smart health platform that combines AI, data science, and trusted medical sources to help users understand possible causes, risk level, and the next step. It also offers follow-up questions, mental health support, medication information, and simplified lab results. Our goal is simple: to make the first step in healthcare clearer, safer, and more informed.

projects.title: WORDOS
projects.desc: WordOS is an AI-powered vocabulary learning system that transforms new English words from passive recognition into usable knowledge. Each word follows a structured, spaced learning lifecycle across reading, listening, speaking, writing, and spelling. AI generates personalized content and evaluates real-world use, while WordOS tracks mastery, schedules each stage, and moves mastered words into Active Vocabulary for continued natural exposure, supporting retention and practical language use.

projects.title: Noesis AI
projects.desc: An AI-powered platform that supports psychologists by combining standardized psychological assessments with facial emotion recognition. It analyzes patients’ emotional responses to assist in evaluating mental health conditions, while reducing time, human error, and improving consistency. The platform also securely manages patient records and supports progress monitoring. Future improvements include voice emotion recognition and real-time monitoring.

projects.title: هوم بـــــوند | Home Bond
projects.desc: Home Bond is the pioneering platform re-engineering the retail and real estate sectors by bridging the gap between ready-made furniture and local custom manufacturing through integrated industrial innovation. We merge design with actual operations via our proprietary factory and major partnerships with developers, delivering an exceptional solution that serves individuals and the residential sector. We meet massive market needs and empower the creative economy with a sustainable, highly scalable

projects.title: Aptamer-Based Biosensing System for Real-Time Heart Attack Detection in Vehicle Steering
projects.desc: Heart attacks while driving can cause loss of vehicle control and serious accidents. This project introduces a smart system that integrates health monitoring into the steering wheel, using hand sweat as a biomarker for early detection of cardiac risk. The system continuously analyzes sweat changes, provides early warnings, and supports emergency response when needed. This innovation enhances driver safety and prevention while reducing risks from delayed detection of cardiac events in real time.

projects.title: AK Smart Network Operations Platform
projects.desc: AK Smart Network Operations Platform is a working enterprise-focused platform designed to unify network visibility, evidence-based diagnostics, security indicators, and service priorities in one workspace. The idea is to help IT teams investigate connectivity and performance issues using traceable evidence, while keeping operational decisions and actions under human control.

projects.title: Ever found a 'new' spot to run or ride only to discover it's unlit…
projects.desc: Ever found a 'new' spot to run or ride only to discover it's unlit, unpaved, or missing everything you needed? Generic reviews don't tell you that, but fellow runners, cyclists, skaters, and walkers do. Masar is a community built by people who move, rating tracks on exactly what matters to your sport, lighting, surface, shade, and amenities. Join challenges, share your favorite spots, and find new ones wherever you are.

projects.title: Aero Aqua Solar: Atmospheric Water Generation and Irrigation System
projects.desc: Aero Aqua Solar is a proposed solar-powered system that captures moisture from humid air and converts it into water for plant irrigation. Using a calcium chloride-based hygroscopic material, the system captures atmospheric moisture, releases it through solar-powered regeneration, condenses the water vapor, and stores the collected water for irrigation. The concept aims to support vegetation and promote sustainable water use in humid environments.

projects.title: Smart Wearable System for Rehabilitation Movement Guidance
projects.desc:
Abstract
Kineo is a smart wearable rehabilitation system designed to support patients during home-based exercises. It combines motion sensing, real-time movement guidance, a mobile application, and physiotherapist monitoring. The system measures range of motion, repetitions, movement quality, and exercise duration, providing immediate feedback while enabling remote performance tracking. The prototype demonstrates a connected approach to personalized, measurable, and data-informed rehabilitation.

projects.title: Shaheen Platform
projects.desc: Detection tools that score suspicious activity can flood teams with alerts, letting real intrusions hide. Shaheen plants decoy files that no legitimate user has a reason to open and watches them through the Linux kernel's audit system. Context filters keep approved automation, such as backups, silent; a person or an unlisted program touching a decoy raises an alert. In a full test cycle, 700 legitimate operations raised no alert, while every control-probe action did. Runs fully on-premises.

projects.title: Suhail | سهيل
projects.desc: Suhail is an iOS desert safety application designed for travelers in remote areas of Saudi Arabia, where 796 missing-person cases were recorded. It preserves the traveler’s last available location and essential trip details. If the expected return time is exceeded and no signal has been received from the traveler’s phone for a specified period, Suhail automatically alerts trusted contacts with the available information, helping families and relevant authorities respond faster and support rescue.

projects.title: عَيْن المَوْرِد-Vendor Eye
projects.desc:
Vendor Eye: AI Driven Contractor Security Governance

What if organizations could see contractor security risks before they become incidents? Vendor Eye turns fragmented contractor oversight into proactive, intelligent security governance. By continuously analyzing access, activities, compliance, and risk signals, Vendor Eye detects emerging threats early and delivers actionable insights helping organizations prevent breaches, protect critical assets, reduce costly disruptions, and build a safer

projects.title: OstomySense: Reusable Capacitive Pouch-Fill Monitoring
projects.desc: قد يرافق مريض الفغرة قلقٌ من امتلاء الكيس أو تسربه، إلى جانب الحاجة إلى تفقده المتكرر. يقدّم OstomySense تصورًا لمتابعة أوضح وأسهل؛ إذ يستشعر مستوى الامتلاء من خارج الكيس، ويعرض تقديرًا على تطبيق الجوال مع تنبيه يختاره المستخدم. وصُممت وحدة المستشعر لإعادة الاستخدام عند تغيير الكيس، مع استبدال الوسادة اللاصقة فقط، دون ملامسة محتوياته أو ثقبه.

projects.title: FAJWA
projects.desc: FAJWA is a smart security platform that connects guards, patrols, cameras, and checkpoints in one system. It analyzes security coverage across facility zones and simulates the impact of moving or changing a security resource before implementation. FAJWA detects security gaps by identifying areas below the required coverage level, compares alternative resource allocations, and supports security supervisors in selecting an appropriate solution while maintaining the required coverage.

projects.title: Design and Development of a Hydraulic-Powered Robotic Arm
projects.desc: The Hydraulic-Powered Robotic Arm is a working model that demonstrates how hydraulic pressure can create controlled mechanical movement. Using syringes, tubes, and fluid, pressure is transferred to move the arm’s joints and grip objects. Based on Pascal’s Law, the project showcases applications of hydraulics in robotics, construction, manufacturing, and automation while promoting practical STEM learning and innovation.

projects.title: Mission-Aware Real-Time Security & Resilience for UAVs (MARTS-UAV)
projects.desc: A cybersecurity system designed to protect UAV operations from cyberattacks. A Security Gateway analyzes commands before execution by verifying integrity, checking mission consistency, and using AI-based intrusion detection to identify suspicious behavior. Unsafe commands can be blocked before reaching the UAV. Permissioned Blockchain securely records security events and policies, while cyber resilience supports detection, response, recovery to a safe state, and safe mission continuity.

projects.title: منصه ونظام سكن للدعم الصحه النفسيه SAKAN
projects.desc: SAKAN is an AI-driven school mental health platform. It uses discreet IoT hardware and secure apps to let students confidentially log emotions, shifting care from reactive to proactive and preventing silent crises

projects.title: Lamie: Integrated Game-Based Assessment System Identifying & Developing Multiple Intelligences(6-9)
projects.desc: Lamie is an integrated discovery and development system grounded in Gardner’s Theory of Multiple Intelligences. Through game-based activities, children’s actions, choices, and performance become behavioral evidence across eight intelligence domains. The platform transforms this evidence into intelligence insights and personalized development plans. The fully developed system currently demonstrates Spatial Intelligence for children aged 6-9, with a foundation for all eight domains.

projects.title: NASH’A Multichannel Optical Platform for Preliminary Microplastic Screening in Water
projects.desc: NASH’A Multichannel Optical Platform for Preliminary Microplastic Screening in Water هو حل تقني ذكي للكشف السريع عن الجسيمات البلاستيكية الدقيقة في المياه وتحليلها باستخدام التصوير البصري والأشعة فوق البنفسجية والذكاء الاصطناعي يهدف المشروع إلى معالجة تحديات الطرق التقليدية التي تتطلب وقتًا وتكاليف مرتفعة وأجهزة متخصصة يوفر نشأة منصة سهلة الاستخدام وقابلة للتطوير تخدم المختبرات والجامعات والجهات البيئية ومرافق معالجة المياه وتساهم في تحسين مراقبة جودة المياه ودعم الاستدامة وحماية البيئة.

projects.title: سِراج | Siraj
projects.desc: Siraj warns drivers of camels on unfenced roads before headlights can reveal them. At 120 km/h, an unwarned driver needs about 140 m to stop, but low beams illuminate an animal at only around 74 m. Siraj’s solar-powered roadside unit detects camels using a night-vision camera. Once a camel is detected, digital signs up to 2 km ahead display a safe advisory speed—active only while the camel is present—while the unit logs every crossing for the Roads General Authority. In simulations, for drivers

projects.title: AquaAware
projects.desc:
AquaAware is an intelligent early-warning system designed to enhance swimming pool safety by using artificial intelligence to analyze real-time behavioral and environmental data. The system identifies abnormal patterns, assesses risk levels, and determines the location of potential incidents in real time.
When critical risk indicators are detected, it immediately alerts the responsible person, enabling faster intervention and potentially preventing incidents from escalating.

projects.title: جهاز ذكي لتنظيم الجرعات الدوائية و تتبع الالتزام السلوكي
projects.desc: Smart Device for Medication Dispensing and Behavioral Adherence Tracking is a groundbreaking, nursing-led physical medical solution engineered to revolutionize home medication management. By seamlessly fusing an automated single-dose physical locking mechanism with long-term behavioral compliance analytics, this device prevents lethal accidental overdosage, eliminates home medication errors, and actively closes the gap between clinical prescriptions and real-world patient routines.

projects.title: القفاز الذكي | Smart Glove
projects.desc: القفاز الذكي هو ابتكار تقني يهدف إلى مساعدة الأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة في التواصل من خلال تحويل إشارات وحركات اليد إلى كلمات مسموعة أو نصوص مفهومة. يجمع القفاز بين المستشعرات والتقنيات الذكية لقراءة حركة الأصابع وترجمتها بشكل فوري، مما يسهم في تسهيل التواصل ودمج ذوي الإعاقة في المجتمع. يتميز المشروع بإمكانية تطويره ليكون عمليًا، خفيفًا، وسهل الاستخدام، مع إمكانية توسيع وظائفه مستقبلًا لدعم لغات وإشارات مختلفة.

projects.title: يقظة | Yaqadha
projects.desc: Yaqadha is an AI driven digital governance platform aligned with Saudi Vision 2030. It transforms institutional compliance from reactive audits to real time proactive oversight. Through smart risk scoring, a unified dashboard, and automated alerts, Yaqadha empowers leaders to ensure transparency and combat corruption.

projects.title: LLM-Based Enhancement of Mobile Forensic Investigations in Saudi Arabia
projects.desc: This project presents an AI-assisted mobile forensic analysis system that uses a fine-tuned Qwen2.5-14B model to analyze chats, direct messages, and emails. Designed for the Saudi investigative context, it helps identify suspicious content, possible crime types, and supporting evidence in a structured format. The system operates fully offline and locally, helping protect sensitive forensic data and maintain privacy and security.

projects.title: AgriBird
projects.desc: AgriBird is an autonomous, rail-mounted robot for hydroponic greenhouses. Moving above crops on a rail, it captures plant images and uses edge AI to identify signs of disease. It then aligns with the affected area and delivers a targeted micro-dose through its nozzle, recording each detection and treatment. By finding problems early and treating only where necessary, AgriBird aims to protect harvests, cut chemical waste, reduce manual inspection, and make greenhouse care more sustainable.

projects.title: منصة برهان التحقيقية
projects.desc: «برهان» منصة ذكاء اصطناعي صُممت للوصول بالقضية من الأدلة إلى الحل. تسخّر تنسيق الوكلاء الذكيين (Agentic Orchestration)، بحيث يتولى كل وكيل مهمة وتتحد قدراتهم حول هدف التحقيق. تبدأ بما يمكن إثباته حتميًا، وتخضع الاستدلالات لتحقق رياضي يمنع الهلوسة ويرفع موثوقية النتائج. تفحص الفرضيات والسيناريوهات وتكشف التناقضات والاستحالات. وإن لم تكفِ المعلومات للحسم، تولّد أسئلة تحقيق حاسمة، وتستوعب الأدلة الجديدة وحدس المحقق، ثم تعيد الاستدلال تلقائيا حتى تصل إلى حل قابل للإثبات أو تحدد ما يلزم لحسم القضية.

projects.title: Astera XR: VR Device & Software to Treat Amblyopia Diagnose Myopia, Astigmatism, Color Blindness
projects.desc:
Astera XR combines VR, eye tracking, and Al for visual assessment and personalized amblyopia therapy.
It captures eye responses in real time, analyzes visual patterns, adapts VR exercises based on patient progress, and enables continuous monitoring. The system aims to make vision care more accurate, measurable, and engaging, especially for children.

projects.title: AqarCheck turns any rental ad into a clear verification report
projects.desc: AqarCheck turns any rental ad into a clear verification report. From one screenshot or link, it extracts the property details, confirms whether the rent is annual or monthly, estimates the expected price range, and flags conflicts in the Arabic description. Instead of labeling listings as fraudulent, it explains what looks unusual and why, helping renters in Saudi Arabia decide with confidence before contacting the advertiser.

projects.title: Zwitterionic Chitosan Silica Hybrid Nanocomposites for Anti Fouling and Selective Adsorption
projects.desc:
The rapid accumulation of biological foulants and the presence of recalcitrant heavy metal ions
in aqueous environments pose significant challenges to membrane technology and water
purification systems. This proposal introduces a novel class of Zwitterionic Chitosan–Silica
Hybrid Nanocomposites designed to provide a dual-functional solution: superior anti-fouling
resistance and high-capacity selective .adsorption

projects.title: ATHAR: AI-Powered Digital Evidence Platform
projects.desc: Digital investigators drown in evidence: 200 files can take weeks to review, links are missed, authenticity is hard to prove and past cases are forgotten. ATHAR classifies evidence automatically, links it on a visual map, screens images for manipulation, documents every step with a time-stamped hash chain, and alerts on similar prior cases. One automated pass replaces file-by-file review, giving investigators and lawyers court-ready evidence. Working prototype live online !

projects.title: لبيه حس / labbeih Sense
projects.desc: Labbeih Sense is a unified assistive ecosystem for the deaf, mute, and blind, bridging sensory and speech barriers. It integrates a smart app with innovative devices: "Darbak" neck frame for ambient vision and audio, "Bayan" chip for laryngeal vibration translation, and "Wahaj" wristband for tactile pulses. The system features protective cases and UV-C sterilization charging pods to ensure a sustainable, accessible daily experience for impaired users

projects.title: NABD: Saudi Economic Pulse & Common-Stress Monitoring System
projects.desc: NABD is a high-frequency economic monitoring platform that converts official data into interpretable signals of unusual local activity. It compares observed activity with expected patterns, helps distinguish shared movements from local deviations in POS activity, and tracks persistence, uncertainty, and data freshness in one decision-support interface. The current prototype has been tested on 3,230 city-week observations across 10 cities. True prospective validation has not yet started; no prosp

projects.title: AI Based Smart Rainwater Drainage System
projects.desc: An AI-based smart drainage monitoring system that combines low-cost environmental sensors with data analysis to detect abnormal drainage behavior and potential blockages. By collecting rainfall and water-level data, the system transforms conventional drainage inlets into data-generating monitoring points, supporting earlier detection, smarter maintenance, and improved flood-risk management.

projects.title: GridGuardian AI
projects.desc: A smart national platform designed to protect Saudi Arabia’s power grids and renewable energy farms from sabotage and operational failures. It combines autonomous drones, Edge AI, and an encrypted Digital Twin, enabling reliable operation in remote areas and under GPS disruption or jamming. The system reduces incident response time to seconds and can lower operating costs by over 40%, supporting energy sustainability and Saudi Vision 2030.

projects.title: AdaptiMind
projects.desc: AdaptiMind هو نظام ذكاء اصطناعي يضيف طبقة من الذكاء التكيفي إلى الروبوتات والطائرات المسيّرة، تمكّن الآلة من تقدير قدراتها الحالية وحدودها، وتقييم حالة البيئة من حولها، ثم تقدير مصدر عدم اليقين واختيار الإجراء الأنسب للتعلم أو الاستمرار في تنفيذ المهمة. يهدف النظام إلى جعل الآلات أكثر قدرة على التكيف مع تغير الظروف والمساعدة على تقليل القرارات الخاطئة أثناء المهام الذاتية، دون الحاجة إلى إعادة برمجتها لكل حالة جديدة.

projects.title: محاكي مالي ذكي هو حل رقمي تفاعلي يهدف إلى تعزيز الوعي المالي…
projects.desc: محاكي مالي ذكي هو حل رقمي تفاعلي يهدف إلى تعزيز الوعي المالي والتأميني، من خلال محاكاة القرارات والسيناريوهات المالية بطريقة مبسطة وسهلة. يساعد المستخدم على فهم الخيارات والتكاليف والمخاطر والنتائج المحتملة قبل اتخاذ القرار، مع توظيف تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي وتحليل البيانات لتقديم تجربة أكثر ذكاءً وتخصيصًا.

projects.title: AI-HUNTER | Real-Time Intrusion Detection System Based on Edge Device
projects.desc: AI-HUNTER is a lightweight AI-powered intrusion detection system for real-time network security at the edge. It combines Raspberry Pi 5 and XGBoost with live packet capture, flow analysis, a FastAPI backend, and an interactive dashboard. The working prototype classifies traffic across 15 categories, providing threat monitoring and alerts on resource-constrained hardware for potential use in IoT environments, small businesses, and remote sites.

projects.title: AWN - Smart Rescue & Protection System
projects.desc: AWN is a single solution Smart Safety ecosystem that serves industrial and construction workers and high-risk environment customers, covering the widest occupational health scope. AWN, with its smart helmet and connected wristband, functions as a real-time digital shield monitoring your vital signs, heat stress, and detecting abrupt falls. The system also connects to an interactive dashboard, allowing site supervisors to have real-time oversight of worker safety, and displaying the location of a

projects.title: RAFEEQ
projects.desc: نظام ذكي يعتمد على إنترنت الأشياء (IoT) لمراقبة أمان الحافلات المدرسية ومنع نسيان الأطفال داخلها يجمع التقنيات بين (NFC) لتسجيل الحضور و(GPS) للتتبع اللحظي وتطبيق لإشعار أولياء الامور والمدارس  يكمن الابتكار في "حاجز الفحص الإجباري" حيث يلتزم السائق بالسير لآخر الحافلة ومسح نقطة (NFC) لإيقاف المحرك وإنهاء الرحلة مما يضمن خلو الحافلة تماماً ويعمل بالحرارة العالية وبدون إنترنت

projects.title: Salfah (سالفة)
projects.desc: Salfah" is an innovative sovereign AI platform that bridges critical gaps in linguistic data and community empowerment. The system provides a secure, private environment for emotional vocalization while securely capturing authentic local dialects to enrich national AI datasets. By blending psychological stability with economic empowerment for women at home, Salfah drives digital sovereignty and aligns with Vision 2030.

projects.title: Sustainable Green Ammonia Production from Southern Saudi Red Sea Water
projects.desc: Ammonia is essential to many industries, but conventional production requires high temperatures and pressures and generates CO₂ emissions. This study presents, for the first time, a cleaner approach to ammonia production using seawater from the Asir coast of the Red Sea, with nitrogen addition at 50°C. FTIR, pH, and UV–Vis analyses confirmed increasing ammonia concentration. The approach could support cleaner production, add value to local marine resources, and contribute to Saudi Vision 2030.

projects.title: HemoAid
projects.desc:
HemoAid: Rapid Blood Typing at the Point of Care

In emergency transfusion, every minute matters. Accurate ABO and Rh blood typing is essential for safe transfusion, yet conventional laboratory-based testing can require specialized equipment, trained personnel, and multiple preparation steps—creating delays when time is critical.

HemoAid is a portable, automated point-of-care blood typing device designed to deliver ABO and Rh results within minutes using just one drop of whole blood

projects.title: هو تطبيق تقني ذكي مبتكر يهدف إلى حل مشكلة أزلية يعاني منها كل بيت…
projects.desc:
هو تطبيق تقني ذكي مبتكر يهدف إلى حل مشكلة أزلية يعاني منها كل بيت ومطعم في المملكة، وهي: (هدر الطعام، حيرة الطبخ اليومية، وضياع ميزانية المقاضي).
 آلية العمل: يتيح التطبيق للمستخدم مسح تواريخ صلاحية الأغذية والمقاضي لتلقي تنبيهات مبكرة قبل فسادها، مع ميزة ذكية فريدة تقترح وصفات طبخ فورية بناءً على المكونات الموجودة فعلياً في الثلاجة والمشرفة على الانتهاء.

projects.title: Atmospheric Moisture Recovery for Coastal Hydroponic Greenhouses
projects.desc: Atmospheric Moisture Recovery for Coastal Hydroponic Greenhouses integrates semi-closed air recirculation with dew-point dehumidification to recover atmospheric moisture for hydroponic reuse. The system recovers approximately 28 L/day of condensate using 3.9 kWh/day, achieving 7.2 L/kWh. Compared with 100% outdoor-air operation, it reduces the outdoor-air component of ventilation latent load by more than 85%, supporting climate control and freshwater reduction in hot, humid coastal regions.

projects.title: HoloKidsAI المنظومة التعليمية الذكية
projects.desc:
HoloKids AI نظام تعليمي ذكي للطفولة المبكرة يجمع بين الأفاتار الهولوغرافي ثلاثي الأبعاد والذكاء الاصطناعي لتنمية خيال الأطفال

projects.title: AURIS is a smart problem-solving communication
projects.desc:
AURIS is a smart problem-solving communication
system to assist the hard-of-hearing community. A smart
device that ataches to any type of glasses, mobile app
and speech recognition technology that translates spoken
language to real-time text appearing on the device. The
entire system also supports environmental sound
detection and voice differentiation in order to provide
users with enhanced situational awareness and improve
their understanding of their surroundings.

projects.title: Mini Rack: AI-Driven Adaptive Cryptography System
projects.desc: Mini Rack is an AI-driven adaptive cryptography system designed for resource-constrained IoT devices. It combines a portable ESP32-S3 unit with a Raspberry Pi base station and uses a lightweight AI model to dynamically select a suitable encryption algorithm based on device conditions such as payload size, battery level, memory availability, and priority, aiming to balance security, performance, and resource efficiency.

projects.title: Tasawwur – AI Visual Study Tutor
projects.desc: Tasawwur (تصوّر) is a study app for visual learners. It explains concepts with drawn, labeled visuals, not walls of text, so students see how an idea works before memorizing it. Built Arabic-first for Saudi school and university students, it turns their PDFs, even scanned slides, into illustrated guides that cite exact pages, lets them study out loud in their own dialect, checks handwritten math step by step, and builds spaced-repetition cards.

projects.title: ديرة | Deerah
projects.desc: ديرة | Deerah منصة ذكية مدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي تساعد المحافظات السعودية على اكتشاف فرص التنمية والاستثمار بناءً على مواردها وإمكاناتها واحتياجاتها الفعلية. تحلل المنصة البيانات ثم تحدد نقاط القوة والفجوات وتحوّلها إلى مشاريع وفرص تنموية قابلة للتنفيذ. تهدف دعم اتخاذ القرار، خلق فرص وظيفية، وتعزيز الاستفادة من الإمكانات غير المستغلة بما يسهم في نمو أكثر توازنًا واستدامة.

projects.title: Developing a Lower-Carbon Bio-Concrete Block Using Coffee Husks as Partial Aggregate Replacement
projects.desc: Cement causes ~8% of global CO₂ emissions, while landfilled coffee waste emits methane, ~28 times more potent than CO₂. We developed a Bio-Concrete Block (Bio-CB) replacing mineral aggregates with chemically passivated coffee husks (5–15% by volume), and fabricated a working prototype. At 15%, lab tests showed thermal conductivity of 0.28 vs. 1.40 W/m·K, density of 900 vs. 2,400 kg/m³, and compressive strength of [X] MPa. Bio-CB cuts HVAC energy, conserves sand and supports net-zero goals.

projects.title: HISANAH
projects.desc: HISANAH is a smart digital platform designed to enhance the safety of individuals—particularly young children—regarding food. It achieves this by providing a health profile for allergies, utilizing AI to analyze products, ingredients, and menus, and identifying suitable options from innovative products, alongside offering emergency and awareness tools. The platform also features a digital analysis tool for ingredients and an accredited program for relevant institutions and entities, helping user

projects.title: دليل | DALEEL – منصة ذكية لإدارة وتتبع الأدلة الجنائية
projects.desc: DALEEL is a smart digital platform designed to support forensic evidence management. It enables authorized users to document, track, and verify evidence throughout its journey, from collection to the responsible authority. Each piece of evidence receives a digital identity and a chronological record, helping improve traceability, organization, and data integrity. The platform also explores AI-powered visual analysis as an assistive tool for forensic examination.

projects.title: HemoScan One: Portable Electromagnetic Scanner for Suspected Internal Bleeding Localization
projects.desc: HemoScan One is a portable, non-invasive electromagnetic scanner designed to support the early detection and localization of suspected internal bleeding after trauma. The device combines differential electromagnetic sensing, freehand spatial tracking, motion and lift-off correction, and signal mapping to identify localized tissue changes. It is designed as a rapid screening and monitoring aid for field and prehospital environments, without ionizing radiation

projects.title: NAFAT - Network Authentication Feasibility Assessment Tool
projects.desc: NAFAT solves the operational gap of blind network assessments. As a CLI dual-use framework, it empowers Red/Blue teams to evaluate target feasibility preemptively. By measuring live TCP RTT and protocol overhead, it calculates rate-aware speeds below IDS thresholds. Combining 8 core features including banner grabbing and JSON reporting NAFAT delivers data-driven auditing with zero prior art found across GitHub, papers, and databases (Sep 2026).

projects.title: Innovative In Wound & Burn Treatment Using Nono-Emulsion Gel Technology
projects.desc: The invention relates to a nanoemulsion gel for topical use that accelerates wound and burn healing and reduces scar formation. It contains Centella asiatica, Alpinia galanga, multi-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid, vitamin E, and chitosan in a medium-chain oil, stabilized with Polysorbate 80 and propylene glycol. The nano-droplets are incorporated into a Carbopol 940 gel matrix, providing anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, moisturizing, and collagen-supporting effects. The gel is packaged in an

projects.title: SADIN
projects.desc: Employees paste passwords, network details and confidential documents into AI tools, and once that data is sent, the organization can't get it back. SADIN is a protective middleware that checks each request on the device or on the organization's own server. Secrets are replaced with placeholders, classified content is blocked, and every decision is logged, but employees still get their answers. SADIN works in Arabic and English, including Arabic screenshots read with OCR, and is aligned with NCA

projects.title: ذرى | DHARA
projects.desc:
ذرى… يحتضن موضع الخطر، ليحدّ من امتداد أثره.
ذرى (Dhara) هو نظام ذكي للسلامة الصناعية يجمع بين الاستشعار والاحتواء الموضعي والعزل التلقائي، بهدف التعامل مع التسرّبات عند مصدرها والحدّ من انتشارها بشكل مباشر. تُركّب وحداته حول النقاط الحرجة في الأنابيب، مثل الوصلات والصمامات، وتتكامل مع أنظمة المراقبة والإنذار لدعم الاستجابة السريعة. يستهدف ذرى تقليل فقد المواد وحماية العاملين والمنشآت، مع قابلية تطويره لتطبيقات صناعية متعددة وفق نوع المادة وظروف التشغيل.

projects.title: Bee-guard
projects.desc: Bee-Guard is a radiological response simulation with a 3D-printed prototype. A swarm of 3 UAVs maps radiation using GPS data, identifies hotspots, and assesses casualties through heart- and respiratory-rate data. It provides an autonomous network, ground communication, radiation-aware routing, and a decision-support dashboard. The simulation improved situational awareness and response prioritization while reducing unnecessary exposure. Casualty data are simulated and not clinically validated.

projects.title: RAICJ Guard
projects.desc: RAICJ Guard is a research-informed governance prototype designed to support responsible AI use in Saudi criminal justice. It provides a structured five-stage assessment covering risk classification, evidence integrity, fairness, human oversight, explainability, and accountability. The prototype identifies governance concerns and required safeguards while keeping consequential decisions under human authority.

projects.title: NanoSense AI
projects.desc: NanoSense AI is a self-powered smart filter monitoring system for industrial facilities. A Triboelectric Nanogenerator (TENG) layer embedded in the filter fabric converts dust friction into electrical signals, eliminating batteries. An Edge AI classifier detects clogging and rupture in real time, triggering auto-clean or critical alerts before emissions escape. This reduces energy waste, prevents leaks, and shifts maintenance from reactive to predictive. Battery-free, scalable, and cost-effectiv

projects.title: عالِم منصة تعليمية قرآنية ذكية تجمع الطالب والمعلم وولي الأمر…
projects.desc: عالِم منصة تعليمية قرآنية ذكية تجمع الطالب والمعلم وولي الأمر والإدارة في منظومة واحدة، وتوظّف الذكاء الاصطناعي لتطوير حفظ القرآن وتجويده وتدبره، مع أدوات تساعد المعلم على إدارة الحصص، إنشاء الواجبات والاختبارات، متابعة أداء الطلاب، وتقديم تغذية راجعة ذكية—لتجعل تعليم القرآن أكثر تفاعلاً، سهولة وفعالية.

projects.desc:

Designed to detect, predict, and extinguish fires in their earliest stages without human intervention, Mukafeh operates with an extraordinary detection accuracy exceeding 98.5%. By eliminating human delay and exposure to risk, it turns potentially catastrophic blazes into instantly managed incidents.

Key Highlights:

98.5%+ AI Precision: Advanced c
