The system analyzes optical responses from biological samples and converts them into digital signatures for rapid pathogen classification.

projects.title: Onyx – A Quantum Resilience Awareness, Assessment & Mitigation Platform for OT and ICS
projects.desc: As quantum computing advances, algorithms such as RSA and ECC face growing security risks. With NIST targeting the transition away from vulnerable cryptography by 2035, quantum readiness is becoming urgent. This is especially critical for OT/ICS environments, where legacy systems are difficult to replace. ONYX helps users learn, assess, and prepare through AI-powered assessment, sandboxed security analysis, and practical mitigation guidance turning quantum risk into actionable readiness.

projects.title: Sifr: A Privacy-Preserving Digital Verification Framework Using Zero-Knowledge Proofs
projects.desc: This project introduces a privacy-preserving verification solution using Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP). It enables users to prove eligibility, such as meeting an age requirement, without revealing unnecessary personal information. The solution provides a secure verification layer that reduces data exposure while maintaining reliable verification. A working prototype was developed and evaluated through functional, security, and performance testing.

projects.title: An autonomous USV-based system revolutionizing port and coastal…
projects.desc: An autonomous USV-based system revolutionizing port and coastal security through smart naval mine detection. By replacing risky, high-cost manual verification, this innovation leverages a Dual-Stream AI model that fuses multibeam sonar with water-column data. It eliminates false alarms using multi-angle consensus and temporal analysis, while empowering defense operators with reliable, Explainable AI (XAI) to secure vital maritime lanes.

projects.title: Rasd AI (رصد AI)
projects.desc: A smart autonomous vehicle uses two cameras—one regular and one thermal—along with LiDAR to scan and map its surroundings in real time. Powered by AI, it detects objects, recognizes people, and checks them against a suspect database. It works in both day and night using thermal vision in low light. The system can also detect possible weapons, and all data is combined into one clear and complete view.

projects.title: رقيب نظام التفتيش الذكي للمركبات
projects.desc:
Overview: RAQEEB is an automated, AI-powered smart vehicle inspection system that combines computer vision, artificial intelligence, and image analysis to detect violations and security threats at checkpoints.  
 Database & Alert Integration: The system captures vehicle images, recognizes license plate numbers, logs precise GPS location coordinates into a database, and automatically triggers security alarms when suspicious or wanted vehicles are identified.

projects.title: A Lightweight Cryptographic Layer for Securing Processed Data and Metadata in UAV Detection Systems
projects.desc: AeroShield is an integrated UAV detection and security system that protects radar signals, acoustic fingerprints, and processed data from tampering and replay attacks. It delivers real‑time integrity, lightweight cryptographic protection, and forensic traceability, while supporting future expansion such as advanced radar fingerprinting, multi‑sensor fusion, and AI‑based classification.

projects.title: ASSAS – AI-Driven Road Damage Detection, Prioritization, and Prediction System
projects.desc: ASSAS transforms traditional road monitoring into an integrated smart platform that connects road damage detection, severity assessment, maintenance prioritization, damage progression prediction, and execution tracking. Powered by AI and computer vision, it supports municipal teams and engineers in turning insights into actionable, trackable operations, enabling faster response, enhancing road safety, and supporting smart cities.

projects.title: دورك (Dawrok)
projects.desc: Dawrok is a platform that connects university students with the right teammates by matching GPA, personality and peer ratings. GPA comes from the university system and stays private, while AI analyzes each student's personality and strengths. Instructors form balanced teams in one click, rating questions are tailored to each student with fake ratings detected, and every student gets a private growth plan. The result: fairer workload, fewer conflicts, better learning.

projects.title: فاحص الكسور الذكي هو قفاز مبتكر محمول ومنخفض التكلفة، صُمم لدعم…
projects.desc: فاحص الكسور الذكي هو قفاز مبتكر محمول ومنخفض التكلفة، صُمم لدعم المسعفين وفرق الطوارئ في الكشف الأولي عن الكسور في موقع الحادث. يعتمد على حساسات حركة وتقنيات برمجية لتحليل استجابة العظم وإظهار النتيجة بألوان واضحة: الأخضر للسليم، الأصفر لإصابة بسيطة، والأحمر للاشتباه بوجود كسر، مما يساهم في تسريع التقييم واتخاذ القرار الطبي.

projects.title: A converter-free solar desalination system delivers affordable…
projects.desc: A converter-free solar desalination system delivers affordable freshwater for remote and off-grid communities. By directly coupling solar panels to dynamically reconfigured heaters, it optimizes solar power use without converters or batteries. The compact, low-maintenance prototype produces sufficient fresh water for a family, offering a practical, scalable approach to renewable-powered desalination.

projects.title: ASWAR
projects.desc: إطار برمجي لتوصيف الخطر الفيزيائي للسلوك الخبيث في أنظمة التحكم الصناعية (PLC)، ويعالج الفجوة بين اكتشاف التهديد وفهم عواقبه الفيزيائية. بعد تحديد السلوك المشبوه، يحلل أثر شدة التلاعب ومدة استمراره، ويقيس زمن الوصول للخطر (Time-to-Hazard)، وهامش السلامة، وسلوك التعافي؛ بهدف دعم تقييم المخاطر واتخاذ قرارات أكثر استنارة قبل نشر منطق التحكم في البيئات الصناعية.

projects.title: MNKAL
projects.desc: منخال (MNKAL) هو جهاز ذكي لتنقية حبوب البن والحبوب الأخرى من الشوائب مثل الحجارة والأوراق والأغصان، باستخدام تقنية الغربلة والاهتزاز الميكانيكي. يتميز بمرشحات قابلة للتبديل تتيح معالجة أحجام وأنواع مختلفة من الحبوب بجهاز واحد، مع دمج الذكاء الاصطناعي وإنترنت الأشياء والتوأم الرقمي لمراقبة الأداء، واكتشاف الشوائب والأعطال، ودعم الصيانة التنبؤية عن بُعد. يهدف منخال إلى رفع جودة التصفية، تقليل التدخل اليدوي والتكاليف، وحماية معدات المعالجة مع قابلية التوسع مستقبلًا للسوق المنزلي.

projects.title: SignBridge is a market-ready AI smart system transforming…
projects.desc: SignBridge is a market-ready AI smart system transforming communication for the deaf community. By instantly converting sign language into text and speech, it bridges social and civic barriers in public, medical, and educational sectors. With low production costs and high market scalability, SignBridge delivers a high-impact, socially responsible solution that empowers users while offering an outstanding investment return for smart city ecosystems.

projects.title: KAYINAT is an open-field earthworm biotechnology system for soil…
projects.desc: KAYINAT is an open-field earthworm biotechnology system for soil rehabilitation and organic-waste reuse. It uses locally suitable worms, adjustable-depth feeding, climate-adapted care, vermicompost distribution, and selective harvesting. It support soil structure, water infiltration, and nutrient cycling. IoT sensor measure soil, salinity, worm populations,  desolved Oxygen, Temperature and nutrinets. KAYINAT complements—not replaces—soil testing and responsible nutrient management.

projects.title: Holostrata — Spatial Learning Management Platform
projects.desc: Holostrata combines a hologram table and XR learning management system into a comprehensive education solution. Learners explore interactive 3D content together, while educators manage lessons, guide practical training, assess skills and track progress. The platform connects immersive learning with measurable outcomes. German utility model application documentation dated 23 June 2026; representative reference: G26354DE.

projects.title: RASAD: Early Warning for Websites Impersonating Saudi Entities in Their First Days
projects.desc: RASAD finds fake websites that copy Saudi services like Absher, Balady and banks, in their first days, before people are tricked. It is free and runs on a normal PC every morning. What makes it different is Arabic: free tools like dnstwist cannot detect Arabic look-alike names, so we built a way to compare Arabic letters pixel by pixel. In 10 days RASAD found 23 fake sites, caught a fake Balady site 59 hours after it was registered, and Netlify closed a fake Absher site after our report.

projects.title: Oystres fungi
projects.desc: أويستر فونجي هي شركة تقنيات حيوية ناشئة تركز على تحويل النفايات العضوية إلى موارد قيمة. نستخدم الفطريات لإنتاج بدائل غذائية ومواد بناء مستدامة، مما يدعم رؤية المملكة في تحقيق الحياد المناخي والتطور الصناعي. نؤمن بأهمية الابتكار في الاقتصاد الدائري لتحقيق مستقبل أفضل

projects.title: درب: جهاز ذكي لسلامة الطرق ومنصّة وطنية
projects.desc: Darb is a small in-vehicle device with dedicated software for SOS and automated tracking, linked to a national platform. It sets street-level speed limits, detects crashes, tracks stolen vehicles, orders a clear lane for emergency vehicles and steers traffic away from congestion, guiding drivers with numbers, icons and voice. Built on the mandatory eCall requirement, it helps cities become smart cities. A working prototype on a smartphone already demonstrates 20 functions.

projects.title: OliveCycle: An Integrated Waste-to-Value Platform for Sustainable Biodiesel Production
projects.desc: Waste-to-Value converts olive industry residues into sustainable biodiesel through a circular-economy approach. The innovation uses waste olive oil as a low-cost feedstock and olive pulp to produce a reusable heterogeneous catalyst. This integrated waste-to-fuel and waste-to-catalyst strategy reduces agricultural waste, promotes renewable energy, and transforms olive residues into valuable resources.

projects.title: منصة ذكية للاستشعار والاستجابة الفورية للأحداث الحرجة (يقظ YAQIZ)
projects.desc: في المنشآت التشغيلية والحيوية قد تتحول مخالفة بسيطة لإجراء حرج -دخول غير مصرح إلى منطقة محظورة، أو بدء تشغيل قبل استيفاء شرط سلامة- إلى حادث أمني أو تشغيلي. الأنظمة الحالية تكتشف وتنبه ثم تعتمد على إنسان يلاحظ ويتصرف، وتعامل إقرار الموظف بتنفيذ التعليمات كدليل على التنفيذ. يقظ يدمج الكاميرات والحساسات وأنظمة التحكم بالدخول والإجراءات المعتمدة في حلقة واحدة: يكتشف الحدث، يفهم سياقه، يقيم خطورته وفق السياسات، يرسل توجيها فوريا للشخص المعني، ثم يتحقق من النتيجة، ويصعد تلقائيا ويحفظ كل ذلك في سجلاته

projects.title: عصاك تدلك
projects.desc: عصا ذكية مبتكرة لتعزيز سلامة واستقلالية الأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة البصرية أثناء التنقل. تعتمد على حساسات لرصد العوائق والمخاطر وتحديد اتجاهها، ثم تنبيه المستخدم عبر مقابض اهتزازية؛ حيث يختلف الاهتزاز حسب اتجاه الخطر، مما يساعده على تجنبه دون الاعتماد على التنبيهات الصوتية. كما تتضمن تقنية GPS لتحديد موقع المستخدم ودعم سلامته أثناء التنقل

projects.title: أرفف تسوق ذكية للمكفوفين
projects.desc:
أرفف تسوق ذكية للمكفوفين مزوّدة بمستشعرات لمس ومرتبطة بتطبيق خاص في جوال الكفيف يمنحه تجربة  تسوق استثنائية.
عند لمس الكفيف للوحة الرف يتم تشغيل صوت ناطق بمحتويات الرّف ومواصفات المنتج، بالإضافة إلى زر مادي بارز يمكن للكفيف الضغط عليه في حال رغبته في شراء المنتج ليتم إضافته في السلة الافتراضية داخل تطبيق مركز التسوق ومرتبط مباشرة بنظام المحاسبة ليتم تجهيز الطلب من قبل موظف المبيعات المسؤول.
 يهدف الابتكار إلى منح  المكفوفين  الوصول الكامل لخدمات المرافق العامة واستقلالية التجربة.

projects.title: DINOVA-T
projects.desc: DINOVA-T is a smart table accessory that automatically replaces used table surfaces with a clean surface in just 15 seconds, without staff intervention. It reduces waiting time, improves operational efficiency, and enhances the dining experience. The system collects used surfaces and converts the resulting waste into agricultural compost, supporting a circular and sustainable solution. Showcased at ITEX 2026, DINOVA-T won a Silver Medal and received strong interest from visitors and companies.

projects.title: Tamkeen
projects.desc: Tamkeen is a mobile learning application designed to empower older adults in Saudi Arabia to use digital services with greater confidence and independence. It provides simple step-by-step learning through text, images, and videos, supported by an AI digital assistant that offers text and voice guidance. The project also includes a safe simulation environment for practicing selected government and social media services before using them in real life.

projects.title: OBSIDIAN: Real-Time Arabic Social Media Monitoring and Analysis System
projects.desc: Arabic social media produces fast-moving data streams that overwhelm manual monitoring and obscure emerging risks across dialects. OBSIDIAN closes this gap with real-time X ingestion, five-class classification, event correlation, evidence preservation, explainable risk scoring, and governed human review. Trained and evaluated on 15,000 posts, it achieved 98.13% accuracy and 0.9813 macro-F1, passed 53/53 checks, and processed 100,000 posts—turning fragmented content into actionable events.

projects.title: SpineSight
projects.desc: SpineSight is a medical AI platform that analyzes lumbar X-rays and turns imaging findings into structured reports and practical care guidance. It helps physicians identify spine abnormalities, decide when referral is needed, and plan treatment and rehabilitation. Developed using over 8,000 images, SpineSight has been used in approximately 1500 cases across five departments at the University of Jordan Hospital.

projects.title: HAMI — حامي | Saudi Arabia's National AI Safety Intelligence Platform
projects.desc: HAMI (حامي — The Protector) is Saudi Arabia's first dual-layer national AI safety platform. The public layer serves 13 million residents and visitors in 50+ languages via emergency chat, SOS, and safety alerts. The government layer transforms these interactions into real-time security intelligence for the Ministry of Interior — detecting threats 8–15 minutes earlier, in any language, even without internet. Aligned with Saudi PDPL 2021.

projects.title: CCITDS is multi-sensor system that detects human stowaways and…
projects.desc: CCITDS is multi-sensor system that detects human stowaways and container tampering in sealed cargo containers. Five sensors — thermal, CO₂, acoustic, strain, pressure — fuse into a single traceable threat score, paired with an on-premise AI layer that explains each alert in plain language without fabricating evidence. Developed at Najran University for Vision 2030 border security.

projects.title: A Sustainable and Secure Framework for National Gold Reserves
projects.desc: S Global Resources Pte Ltd provide a business model for investment at scale for artisanal/small-scale mining that accounts for 20% of the global supply of gold and currently generates a combined $25-30 billion annually, green tech to encourage artisanal miners to avoid the use of mercury and to close the gap of financing between financial institutions and artisanal mining. We believe this can be done by incorporating blockchain technology into our system and build up the supply chain system.

projects.title: This project protects medical images shared between hospital…
projects.desc: This project protects medical images shared between hospital servers against tampering and unauthorized access. Original and modified microscopic blood-smear images and masks support AI detector training. AI screens for manipulation and hidden data, while five LLM judges assess the evidence. Encryption, verified decryption and access controls protect patient records. Microscopy is the initial use case, with MRI and X-ray extensions planned.

projects.title: موائم
projects.desc: Mwaiem (موائم) is a GovTech digital public service platform that accelerates the process of issuing commercial licenses and preliminary approvals by creating a 3D model based on engineering drawings using Digital Twin tech, its AI engine simulates technical and municipal compliance prior to official submission of commercial registration. Mwaiem cuts license processing times from 10 to 4 days, lowers rejections to 0.1%, yields SAR 51.4M in savings, and accelerates SAR 30M in investor profits.

projects.title: Digital Quran Authentication and Certification
projects.desc: Digital Quran Authentication and Certification is a deep-tech platform that protects the integrity and authenticity of Quranic content. It integrates two complementary technologies: a US-patented system for verifying and certifying Quranic content across digital, print, and hardware platforms; and QariGuard, a US patent-pending AI system that detects deepfake Quranic recitations, verifies reciters, and assesses audio authenticity. This innovation builds global trust in Quranic contents.

projects.title: سيرة المركبة الذكية - Smart Vehicle Biography
projects.desc: Smart Vehicle Biography is an interactive prototype that demonstrates how a trusted digital vehicle history can link faults, repairs, outcomes, and supporting evidence across the vehicle lifecycle. It shows how AI can support repair memory and readiness assessment, while presenting part, workshop, technician, warranty, and fault-return information. Final decisions remain under human control.

projects.title: PhotoBond™: Copper-Bridged Graphite–TiO₂ Nanocomposite for Clean Water and Clean Energy
projects.desc: US Patent 10,981,792 B2 details a stable graphite–TiO₂ nanocomposite linked by coordinate covalent bonds through a central copper ion or nanoparticle. This chemically bonded structure achieves up to 97% photocatalytic degradation of Rhodamine B and has potential applications in catalysts, solar cells, biosensors, and supercapacitors. You can read the full patent documentation on the official United States Patent and Trademark Office database.

projects.title: عسّاس
projects.desc: عسّاس هو منظومة أمنية ذاتية متكاملة تعتمد على مجموعة من الطائرات المسيّرة المدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي، لتنفيذ الدوريات والمراقبة المستمرة داخل المنشآت والمناطق المحظورة. تحلل المشهد الأمني لحظيًا، وتتعرف على الأشخاص وتتحقق من الزي والتصاريح، وترصد الدخول أو الخروج غير المصرح به، مع التتبع الآلي للهدف ونقل موقعه والتنبيهات والبث الحي إلى مركز العمليات. وتعود الطائرات تلقائيًا للشحن عند انخفاض البطارية، ثم تستأنف مهامها بعد الشحن، بما يضمن استمرارية المراقبة ويرفع كفاءة التغطية والاستجابة الأمنية.

projects.title: SolarMorgue: IoT-Enabled Solar-Grid Mortuary System with 3D Design and Smart Thermal Control
projects.desc: SolarMorgue is a solar-powered three-body mortuary refrigeration system designed for areas with unreliable electricity. It integrates photovoltaic power, battery storage, grid backup, temperature monitoring, and automatic power control. SolidWorks and Proteus were used for mechanical and electrical simulation. The system targets 2–4°C operation, while testing identified structural reinforcement and additional battery capacity as key improvements before prototype validation and field validation.

projects.title: ResearchMate
projects.desc: ResearchMate AI is a bilingual AI-powered research coach that transforms how secondary students learn scientific research. Rather than writing research for students, it guides them through the complete research journey, from identifying a problem and formulating questions to methodology, analysis, and scientific communication. Through adaptive coaching, feedback, skill assessment, and progress tracking, ResearchMate builds independent researchers, not AI-dependent learners.

projects.title: (Bacterial Shields Technology (BST): A Safe, Scalable Platform for Vaccines and Oncology (BACTEC
projects.desc: BACTEC PHARMA is a Saudi biopharmaceutical startup developing the first domestically manufactured bacterial ghost vaccines and targeted oncology drug delivery systems in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, built on a single patented platform—Bacterial Shields Technology (BST).

projects.title: rattl.app
projects.desc: منظومة ذكاء اصطناعيّ تعليميّة متكاملة تتكوّن من ثلاثة منتجات مترابطة: رتّل منصّةُ الطفل لتأسيس الحروف والأرقام والمهارات الأساسية وتعليم القرآن بالتفاعل الصوتيّ والتصحيح الفوريّ؛ وMF Core العقلُ التعليميّ الذي يحلّل أداء الطالب ويشخّص الأخطاء بدقّة ويحدّد الخطوة التالية اعتمادًا على بنكٍ معرفيّ يتجاوز مليون عنصر؛ وMF-TTS محرّكُ الصوت العربيّ الذي يولّد التوجيهات التعليمية بصوت طبيعيّ. المنظومة تستمع للطالب، وتفهم أداءه، وتتّخذ قرارًا تعليميًّا، وتتفاعل معه صوتيًّا — ولا تنقله إلى المستوى التالي

projects.title: ميسورة هو أول نظام ذكاء اصطناعي يتعرف على لغة الإشارة
projects.desc:
ميسورة هو أول نظام ذكاء اصطناعي يتعرف على لغة الإشارة 
العربية في الوقت الفعلي، مصمم لمساعدة الصم وضعاف السمع 
على تعلم وتلاوة القرآن الكريم باستقلالية تامة — دون الحاجة 
لمترجم بشري.

يجمع النظام بين MediaPipe لاستخراج نقاط اليد، ونموذج 
ResNet-50 المدرب على 31 فئة من حروف لغة الإشارة العربية، 
ومحرك تثبيت إشارات مخصص صممناه من الصفر (EMA + نظام ثقة 
ثلاثي المستويات) لحل مشكلة الغموض في الانتقالات بين حروف 
لغة الإشارة — وهي مشكلة تقنية لم تُحل سابقاً في أي نظام 
مماثل.

projects.title: CoreShield AI
projects.desc: CoreShield AI is a sovereign privacy gateway that lets regulated organizations use external AI models without exposing sensitive data. It applies a four-stage pipeline — Detect, Cloak, Send, Restore — replacing sensitive entities with reversible tokens before any request leaves the organization, then restoring them in the response. Arabic-first, PDPL-aligned, with a tamper-evident audit chain of every operation. CoreShield removes the trade-off between AI adoption and data protection.

projects.title: SKYNOR SENTINEL
projects.desc: SkyNor Sentinel is an intelligent surveillance and early-warning platform designed to support border monitoring in remote and challenging environments. It integrates aerial platforms, sensors, AI-based analytics, and a unified command dashboard to detect unusual activity, fuse multi-source data, prioritize alerts, and support faster, more accurate security decision-making.

projects.title: A solar-driven photocatalytic system for hydrogen production…
projects.desc: A solar-driven photocatalytic system for hydrogen production directly from real seawater using a multiphase CdO/Co₃O₄/NiO heterojunction and sulfite-assisted charge separation. The system achieves 642.7 ± 4.2 μmol g⁻¹ h⁻¹ hydrogen evolution at 75 mM Na₂SO₃, with 94.5% activity retention after five cycles and metal leaching below 100 ppb. The technology demonstrates stable operation under both simulated and natural sunlight, offering a promising approach for seawater-compatible solar hydrogen pro

projects.title: عالم مغامرات فلكول
projects.desc: Falkool World is an innovative EdTech platform that transforms school curricula into engaging story-based learning experiences using AI. It offers educational stories, animated videos, interactive games, and activities that simplify complex concepts, boost student engagement, and personalize learning with smart insights for students, teachers, and parents. We transformed the primary and middle school science curriculum into 70+ educational stories within an integrated digital learning experience

projects.title: PMU Guard: Security Gateway for LLM Applications
projects.desc: PMUGuard (Prompt Injection, Malicious Intent, Use versus Mention) is a security gateway for enterprise LLM applications. It screens prompts and text extracted from web pages, tool outputs, and uploaded files for injection attempts and harmful intent, distinguishing actionable requests from legitimate discussion. It supports English and Arabic with PROCEED, RESTRICT, or BLOCK decisions. Its lightweight design targets millisecond CPU inference for short prompts, with no GPU needed.

projects.title: روبوت إنقاذ للمساحات المحصورة
projects.desc: Rescue robot for confined spaces, designed to safely reach individuals trapped in wells, deep pits, and sewage systems without exposing rescuers to hazardous conditions. It integrates a compact structure, remote visual monitoring and control, and articulated arms with gripping end-effectors to guide and secure a rescue rope around the trapped individual’s limb. A stabilization and mobility system enables confined-space operation, enhancing rescue precision while minimizing human intervention.

projects.title: Nezar H Khdary
projects.desc: Patent US 12,227,436 B2 (2025) is a world-first, fully eco-friendly method for cleaning up oil spills. Modified multi-layered carbon fibers absorb oil while repelling water, and rollers then press the oil out for collection. No chemicals or dispersants are released into the sea. The fibers are reactivated and reused many times, leaving no waste and protecting marine life. The method costs less than current techniques, and the recovered oil can be reused.

projects.title: Tahsili – AI-Powered Question Bank & Exam Automation Platform
projects.desc: Tahsili closes AI-era education's last manual gap: writing tests. It turns any PDF into a live local question bank via AI extraction, then exports instantly to Word, print-ready PDF, self-grading interactive quizzes, and Google Forms—both ways. Generate multiple randomized test versions from one bank in a click, with full support for complex math formulas. Your data stays yours, fully offline and portable. Ships with 4,000+ ready science questions. Also available globally as MCQ Studio.

projects.title: NASAQ - نسق
projects.desc: Nasaq is a platform that translates natural language instructions into automated drone swarm orchestration, allowing the operator to command the mission rather than individual drone. The system decomposes high-level commands into discrete tasks, allocates them, and replans dynamically. A deterministic validator guarantees the safety of every plan, while all alerts arrive fully explained with supporting evidence—ensuring human operators retain final authority.

projects.title: Autonomous Robot System for Landmine Detection Using AI-Based Computer Vision
projects.desc: This project proposes an autonomous robot to safely and efficiently detect landmines. It uses a hybrid GPS and SLAM navigation system to cover complex environments. For detection, it combines a metal detector with a YOLOv8 Al-powered camera. The robot transmits its live location and precise mine coordinates in real-time to a remote station, triggering immediate alerts. This offers a smart, risk-free solution for automated mine clearance.

projects.title: Kashcool AI-Powered Digital Learning Infrastructure for Schools
projects.desc: Kashcool is an AI-powered digital learning infrastructure for K–12 schools, integrating curriculum-aligned interactive content, assessments, an AI Digital Teacher, personalized learning, and real-time teacher and school intelligence. It connects with existing school systems to create one intelligent learning ecosystem that identifies learning gaps, personalizes support, and enables data-driven decisions.

projects.title: artabat
projects.desc: منصة ارتباط هي منصة وساطة إلكترونية للأعمال (B2B) متخصصة في إدارة منافسات خدمات الشركات الأمنية المدنية الخاصة في المملكة العربية السعودية، وتهدف إلى توفير بيئة رقمية آمنة وموثوقة تجمع بين الجهات المستفيدة والشركات الأمنية المدنية الخاصة المؤهلة. وتمكّن المنصة الجهات المستفيدة من طرح منافساتها إلكترونيًا، واستقبال العروض الفنية والمالية والترسية وإصدار عقد إلكتروني موثّق وإدارتها بكفاءة، بما يسهم في رفع مستوى الكفاءة التشغيلية وتسريع إجراءات المنافسات.

projects.title: NexusSheild: Securing Saudi Arabia's Water-Food Future with Trustworthy AI.
projects.desc:
NexusShield is a secure AI digital twin of Saudi Arabia’s water-food nexus. It links aquifers, soils, crops,
energy and food supply in one graph model, forecasts groundwater, salinity, and yield with calibrated
uncertainty, and shields farm sensor data. This project is piloted in Al-Jouf with the Hafr Al-Batin Lab hub. This is in line with Vision 2030's goals of sustainable resource management, reducing reliance on non-renewable water, and achieving food self-sufficiency by 2040. God willing

projects.title: SI-CAR (Secure and Intelligent Crowdsensing Application for Road…
projects.desc: SI-CAR (Secure and Intelligent Crowdsensing Application for Road Safety) is a mobile app that lets Moroccan citizens report road hazards, risky behaviors, and accidents with photos. A lightweight deep-learning model (SLIF) rejects forged or low-quality images, and faces and license plates are blurred automatically. A blockchain system (BlockCrowd) rewards reliable contributors, and a new access-control model (A&R-BAC) protects the data shared with NARSA and other road-safety authorities.

projects.title: حصّة — محرك الجدولة المدرسية الذكي
projects.desc: حصّة منصة تقنية متطورة تولّد وتشغل الجدول المدرسي تلقائيًا رغم القيود والاشتراطات بحلٍّ مثبَت رياضيًا وخالٍ من التعارضات، وتراعي قواعد كل مدرسة: نصاب المعلمين والحصص المتتالية والموارد واجتماعات النمو المهني. عند غياب معلم تقترح البديل وتعيد الجدولة بأقل تعطيل، وتنبّه المعلمين عبر الجوال. وتشعر ولي الأمر بتعديلات الجدول بروابط محدثة ومؤمنة جُرّبت على بيانات مدرسة فعلية (41 معلمًا و21 فصلًا) فولّدت جدولًا كاملًا بلا مخالفات في نحو 19 ثانية، مع عزل تام لبيانات كل مدرسة. حصة نحو استخدام صفري للورق

projects.title: نظام مراقبة الأمنية والتحليل التنبؤي للتهديدات في المدن(AMAN-AI)
projects.desc: The concept involves an intelligent, distributed system for city security and predictive threat analysis, gathering data from cameras, audio units, drones, and human reports. The system relies on artificial intelligence engines for image and video analysis, LLM language and voice processing, along with federal learning technology for local data processing and privacy protection. A central unit integrates the evidence, calculates confidence and risk scores, and coordinates automated responses (such as alarms, traffic light adjustments, march rerouting, and notification of authorities) to minimize false alarms and expedite response times.

projects.title: ميدلينك منصة ذكية متكاملة لدعم القرار السريري وإدارة مخاطر المرضى…
projects.desc: ميدلينك منصة ذكية متكاملة لدعم القرار السريري وإدارة مخاطر المرضى في أقسام التنويم النفسي تربط المريض بسوار ذكي ينقل علاماته الحيوية وحركته لحظيًا وتدمجها مع بياناته السريرية والسلوكية وتاريخه المرضي وخط أساسه الشخصي تحلل المنصة المخاطر متعددة الأبعاد وتقدم تنبيهات مبكرة ومفسرة للفريق الطبي والتمريضي مع بقاء القرار النهائي بيد المختص.

projects.title: نواة | Nawah
projects.desc: نواة نظام متكامل (أجهزة وبرمجيات) يحوّل مصروف الطالب إلى محفظة بنكية مدرسية رقمية مؤمَّنة بالتحقق البيومتري، فلا يستطيع أحد الشراء باسم الطالب غيره. يشحن ولي الأمر المحفظة ويتابع الإنفاق لحظيًا، ويفحص المقصف الذكي كل عملية شراء تلقائيًا ويوقفها إن تعارضت مع حساسية الطالب الغذائية. ويصنّف النظام مصادر الأموال (كفالات، دعم، مصروف شخصي) ليضمن صرف كل مبلغ في غرضه، مع تقارير شفافة لكل طرف وربط بخدمات النقل والأنشطة والإشعارات.

projects.title: CLOUT88 is an AI-enabled, multi-tenant strategy and execution…
projects.desc: CLOUT88 is an AI-enabled, multi-tenant strategy and execution platform that transforms raw ideas into governed, funded and measurable business outcomes. It connects idea pitching, Digital Strategy Cards, objectives, KPIs, initiatives, strategic budgeting, risk and blind-spot management, assessments and executive reporting. CLOUT88 helps startups and enterprises align people, priorities and investment, strengthening accountability, informed decisions and sustainable transformation.

projects.title: ExtensionGuard
projects.desc: ExtensionGuard هو نظام أمني مبتكر يكشف التهديدات المخفية داخل إضافات المتصفح، حتى عندما يُقسَّم السلوك الضار بين تقنيتي ‏WebAssembly و‏JavaScript ليبدو كل جزء آمنًا منفردًا. يتتبع النظام المسار الكامل للأوامر والبيانات حتى وصولها إلى صلاحيات المتصفح الحساسة، ليكشف هجمات قد تتجاوز أدوات الفحص التقليدية ويحمي المستخدم قبل وقوع الضرر.

projects.title: AMANAH is a Saudi, Arabic-first B2B platform that turns scattered…
projects.desc: AMANAH is a Saudi, Arabic-first B2B platform that turns scattered trade-credit follow-up into one governed, evidence-backed case. AI recommends the best of six payment routes, checks buyer commitment through privacy-minimal Ta'akkad reports, and structures settlement options for overdue invoices. Every sensitive step, from approving credit to accepting a settlement, stays with an authorized person and leaves an audit trail. AI recommends. People approve. Every step leaves evidence.

projects.title: SIRAJ: SAIF140177
projects.desc: SIRAJ reimagines waste management in residential complexes through source separation, separate transfer pathways, and dedicated processing for food, paper, cardboard, and plastic. Its smart design activates processing at defined fill levels and links each apartment to a points-and-rewards system that encourages proper sorting. SIRAJ aims to reduce waste volume, odors and energy use, simplify collection and transport, and prepare materials for recovery and recycling, creating cleaner

projects.title: TECTRONIX FLOW — من الفكرة إلى حزمة تصنيع إلكترونية كاملة
projects.desc: منصة سعودية تعتمد الذكاء الاصطناعي لتحويل فكرة إلكترونية مكتوبة بالعربية أو الإنجليزية إلى حزمة تصنيع كاملة: مخطط الدائرة، تصميم لوحة PCB، ملفات التصنيع الصناعية، قائمة مكوّنات حقيقية متحقَّق منها، والفيرموير — خلال ساعات بدل أسابيع. تعتمد مكوّنات رسمية موجودة فعلاً لا مقترحات وهمية، وترفض بصدق ما لا تستطيع بناءه. تختصر زمن تطوير الأجهزة محلياً، وتقلّل الاعتماد على الاستيراد، وتفتح التصميم الإلكتروني أمام الطلاب والجهات التعليمية والمبتكرين.

projects.title: The reflective collar and tracking device are designed to help and…
projects.desc:
The reflective collar and tracking device are designed to help and protect drivers at night by reducing the risk of collisions with large animals, such as camels. Reflective collar are placed around the camels’ necks and legs, reflecting vehicle headlights from a long distance and giving drivers enough time to slow down and avoid collisions.

In addition, the tracking device makes it easier for camel and livestock owners to locate their animals and helps prevent them from getting lost.

projects.title: "مفقود" تطبيق ذكي يُلغي تشتت بلاغات المفقودات التقليدية في مختلف…
projects.desc: "مفقود" تطبيق ذكي يُلغي تشتت بلاغات المفقودات التقليدية في مختلف القطاعات والمنشآت عبر محرك مطابقة يعتمد على الذكاء الاصطناعي (رؤية الحاسوب ومعالجة اللغة الطبيعية). يحلل التطبيق الصور والأوصاف تلقائياً ليولد نسبة تطابق دقيقة تُسرّع الاسترداد، مع تقديم تجربة مستخدم سلسة وأمان عالٍ للتحقق من الملكية. كما يقدم نموذج عمل استثماري واعد (SaaS) قابل للتوسع والربط مع كافة المؤسسات، المجمعات، والمقرات الذكية.

projects.title: EcoSphere Smart Tree Adoption & Sustainability Platform
projects.desc: The EcoSphere platform, launched by Jouf University in 2023, is a comprehensive environmental sustainability program that brings together modern technology, digital education, and community involvement. Its objective is to make the university a more environmentally friendly campus while extending its impact to the wider community through tree planting, tree adoption, and AI-driven monitoring of tree growth and maintenance.

projects.title: AERODRIVE A Sustainable Solution for Military Supply Transport Under Saudi Vision 2030
projects.desc: AeroDrive introduces a new approach to military logistics through an autonomous mobility system designed for high-risk and remote environments. By integrating advanced mobility with purpose-driven industrial design, it enables safer and more efficient delivery of critical supplies while reducing human exposure to danger. Designed for adaptability, resilience, and local manufacturing, AeroDrive represents a forward-looking Saudi vision for the future of defense mobility.

projects.title: MADQAQ
projects.desc: MADQAQ Sentinel is a cyber-physical procedure-integrity system for secure checkpoints. It verifies required steps and their order by cross-checking physical observations with digital event records. Its conformance engine identifies omissions, order inversions, phantom completions, and channel contradictions, while minimizing persistent identity data. In M0 validation, it matched expected classifications in 6/6 synthetic scenarios and passed 10/10 automated tests.

projects.title: منصة ذكاء زراعي مستقلة تحول أي مزرعة إلى منظومة ذكية دون الحاجة…
projects.desc: منصة ذكاء زراعي مستقلة تحول أي مزرعة إلى منظومة ذكية دون الحاجة لبناء بنية تقنية محدده من الصفر ترتبط بأي حساس أو جهاز أو نظام موجود وتجمع بياناته وتتحقق من موثوقيتها ثم يحلل الذكاء الاصطناعي البيانات ليحدد الاحتياج المثالي لكل جزء من المزرعة بدقة مع مستوى ثقة واضح حتى عند محدودية البيانات تبدأ المنصة بصناعة القرار للمزارع وتتعلم من النتائج ثم تنتقل تدريجياً من المراقبة والتوصية إلى تنفيذ القرارات آليا وصولا إلى الأتمتة الكاملة دون الارتباط بمصنع ومع توفر بيانات وأجهزة أكثر تصبح القرارات أدق.

projects.title: SkillProof – AI-Aware Evidence Assurance for Human Capability
projects.desc: SkillProof is an innovative system for verifying evidence of human capabilities in AI-supported work environments. Instead of evaluating only the final output or attempting to prevent AI use, the system collects traceable evidence of an individual’s ability to understand, verify, judge, adapt, and execute. It adaptively adjusts the level of verification based on the strength and consistency of evidence through interactive questions, practical tasks, and human verification.

projects.title: سبق
projects.desc: سَبْق منظومة لدعم سلامة رجل الأمن، شعارها «المعلومة قبل المواجهة». تعمل بطبقتين: رصد مستمر على مدار الساعة يقرأ لوحات المركبات العابرة وينبّه رجل الأمن فورًا عند رصد مركبة مبلغ عن سرقتها أو هروبها أو لوحة مسروقة أو مفقودة، دون إزعاجه بالمركبات السليمة؛ واستيقاف موجّه يعرض بطاقة حالة مختصرة قبل الاقتراب. ثم تتحول الحالة إلى ملف موثّق بلقطة وتسلسل أحداث يتابعه مركز العمليات حتى الإغلاق. نموذج أولي ببيانات وهمية، يدعم القرار البشري ولا يتخذه.

projects.title: The Drowsiness Detection Safe Driving System is an AI-powered…
projects.desc: The Drowsiness Detection Safe Driving System is an AI-powered solution that turns drowsiness detection into active accident prevention. Using computer vision and Jetson Nano, it monitors the driver in real time and responds through three smart safety levels: AI voice engagement, seat vibration, and finally hazard lights with automatic braking. Designed to be adaptable, cost-effective, and easy to integrate into different vehicle types, it offers a proactive approach to road safety

projects.title: Food waste is a growing issue, as many fruits and vegetables spoil…
projects.desc: Food waste is a growing issue, as many fruits and vegetables spoil before they are consumed. Evaluating grocery freshness usually depends on visual inspection, which may not always be accurate. This project presents an AI-based Grocery Quality Classification model designed to evaluate the quality of fruits and vegetables. The model uses a transfer learning approach based on the YOLOv8l-cls model to identify and classify 32 categories of commonly consumed fruits and vegetables in Saudi Arabia.

projects.title: PTRU نظام ذكي متكامل ومستدام لإدارة موارد المباني، يستعيد الطاقة…
projects.desc: PTRU نظام ذكي متكامل ومستدام لإدارة موارد المباني، يستعيد الطاقة الحرارية والمياه المهدرة ويعيد توجيهها للاستخدام، مع إمكانية توظيف جزء من الطاقة الحرارية المستعادة عند الحاجة لدعم تهيئة أو معالجة المياه قبل إعادة استخدامها. كما يدمج التخزين والطاقة الكهربائية والأحمال ضمن حلقة تكامل تشغيلية واحدة، بإدارة ذكية وتنبؤية تهدف إلى خفض الهدر والاستهلاك والاعتماد على الموارد الخارجية ورفع كفاءة وموثوقية تشغيل المباني.

projects.title: We built an edge AI system that detects low-altitude drones like…
projects.desc: We built an edge AI system that detects low-altitude drones like the Shahed-136 in real time. A Raspberry Pi runs a machine learning model to filter out ambient noise and spot unique drone signatures. Verified threats trigger immediate alerts on a web dashboard via WebSockets. For long-range audio capture, a single microphone is mounted inside a parabolic dish. The entire unit is solar powered with an onboard screen, offering a simple, low-cost way to cover radar blind spots.

projects.title: SLPEdge delivers low-latency local processing packaged within…
projects.desc: SLPEdge delivers low-latency local processing packaged within protected, climate-conditioned, rapidly relocatable infrastructure. Engineered for defense, tactical, and remote industrial environments, SLPEdge maintains uninterrupted edge compute power even during backhaul disruptions, zero-connectivity, or satellite outages. By pairing ruggedized hard-wall modular platforms with multi-bearer connectivity (5G, fiber, satellite), SLPEdge ensures continuous local data processing.

projects.title: نظام الخزان المزدوج (ذو الحجرتين ) متتابع التعبئة لترشيد استهلاك المياه
projects.desc: نظام مبتكر لخزانات الطرد يعتمد على حجرتين مائيتين متتابعتي التعبئة بسعتين مختلفتين، يتيح استخدام كمية المياه المناسبة حسب الحاجة بدل استهلاك كامل سعة الخزان في كل مرة، مع إمكانية تحقيق وفر يصل إلى نحو 62% وفق سيناريو الاستخدام المحسوب. يتميز بحل ميكانيكي بسيط ومنخفض التكلفة، وقابل للتطبيق على الأنظمة القائمة في المنازل والمباني والمساجد، بما يسهم في خفض استهلاك المياه دون الحاجة إلى استبدال الخزان بالكامل.

projects.title: Spoofing Detection in Biometric Systems Using AI
projects.desc: An AI-powered biometric anti-spoofing system designed to detect fraudulent attempts using photos, videos, and masks. The solution employs real-time liveness detection and deep learning to distinguish genuine users from spoofing attacks. Using the CelebA-Spoof dataset, the VGG16 model achieved 97% accuracy, enhancing the security and reliability of facial biometric systems.

projects.title: shqardiah robot
projects.desc: An AI-powered smart reception robot designed to enhance visitor experience and improve service efficiency. The robot welcomes and guides visitors, provides information and answers inquiries using AI, monitors visitor traffic in real time, supports smart health screening, sends instant alerts, and provides detailed reports and analytics through an integrated dashboard. It can be remotely managed and supports multiple languages,making it ideal for government entities, ministries, hospitals, and l

projects.title: Our Lexicon Grows with Us
projects.desc: منصة تعليمية رقمية تفاعلية تعالج ضعف الثروة اللغوية والفهم القرائي. تختار الطالبة كلمة من بنك يضم 200 كلمة، ثم تبني خريطتها اللغوية بكتابة معناها ومرادفاتها وضدها وتوظيفها في سياق. تراجع المعلمة المشاركات وتعتمدها، مع منع تكرار الكلمات وعرض المتميزات. كما تقيس المنصة أثر التعلم باختبارات قبلية وبعدية وتقارير رقمية؛ لتحويل المفردات من حفظ مؤقت إلى معرفة تُفهم وتُستخدم

projects.title: BinaAxis puts the owner at the centre of the project before…
projects.desc: BinaAxis puts the owner at the centre of the project before construction starts. Describe what you want, get three costed design options, preview them room by room, request up to three revisions, then a licensed engineering office approves them in-platform. You receive an itemised bill of quantities and verified contractor quotes. Six AI agents prepare designs, checks and documents in the background; licensed engineers keep decision authority. One record links owner, contractor and supplier.

projects.title: Child Eye
projects.desc: Child Eye is an innovative smart platform for real-time child health monitoring using AI and IoT, integrated into a 3-in-1 childcare product combining a trolley, bed, and car seat. It analyzes sleep patterns, crying, vital signs, and environmental data to create a Digital Twin that monitors changes in the child’s condition. Intelligent alerts and reports help parents make early, informed decisions for safer, smarter, and personalized childcare.

projects.title: HIMA — Passive Drone Early-Warning Network
projects.desc: HIMA is a proposed passive early-warning network for small, low-flying drones over Saudi critical sites and crowds. Low-cost nodes built from off-the-shelf parts mount on existing poles, towers and traffic assets. They listen for rotor sound and drone Remote ID broadcasts, classify on the node, and send only alerts. A planning model picks node sites for the most protection per riyal and shows honestly where coverage ends. Operators see each alert's evidence and confidence; humans decide.

projects.title: NaseemTech
projects.desc:
NaseemTech aims to cut cooling bills using the ground beneath our buildings. A fan moves air through buried pipes, where cooler soil absorbs heat. Automatic controls direct air toward a room or an outdoor AC unit. The added system needs no refrigerant or evaporative water.

NaseemTech: Sustainable Cooling is The New Address

projects.title: SOLID™ is a cost-effective, locally engineered and field-tested…
projects.desc: SOLID™ is a cost-effective, locally engineered and field-tested teleoperation platform for unmanned ground vehicles. It integrates real-time vehicle control, 360° PTZ live video with infrared capability, telemetry, GPS tracking, and wireless communication in a unified hardware–software system. Its modular design supports adaptation to different vehicles, sensors, communication technologies, and mission requirements.

projects.title: جهاز طويق لخدمة الصم والبكم
projects.desc:
جهاز طويق لخدمة الصم والبكم:
مشروع تقني يعتمد على الذكاء الاصطناعي والرؤية الحاسوبية لتحويل لغة الإشارة إلى نصوص مكتوبة عبر كاميرا، بهدف تسهيل التواصل وتمكين ذوي الإعاقة السمعية والكلامية

projects.title: PalmDrop | Organic Palm Mulch | Nature’s Intelligence for Water Conservation
projects.desc: PalmDrop is a circular-economy solution that transforms palm biomass waste into biodegradable organic mulch mats reinforced with palm-derived biochar. Applied around plants, the mats reduce irrigation-water evaporation, suppress weeds, retain soil moisture, and improve soil properties. The solution can integrate moisture sensors and a digital platform to measure water-saving impact and support data-driven irrigation. It upcycles palm waste into a scalable product for arid, water-scarce regions.

projects.title: SADAN
projects.desc: Is an Intelligent Privacy-Preserving Surveillance Layer for Anonymous Cross-Camera Re-Identification its layer added on top of a surveillance system. It objectifies real image of people into a 3D model using   computer vision, with the model linked to a serial number that lets us identify the person if needed. This keeps the person’s movement, location and position clear, tracked live across more than one camera. If an incident requires identifying someone, can be revealed by authorized facility

projects.title: روبوت "درعة" منظومة أمنية ذاتية استباقية لحماية المنشآت
projects.desc: روبوت "درعة" منظومة أمنية ذاتية استباقية لحماية المنشآت. ينفذ دوريات مسح أوتوماتيكية رأسية بالمصاعد عبر الاستشعار الليزري لتغطية المبنى بالكامل وإلغاء الزوايا العمياء. يحلل الحرارة من مسافة 150 متراً، ويكشف الدخان والانبعاثات الصوتية مع مطابقة الوجوه أوتوماتيكياً. عند استشعار الخطر، يتعقب الهدف ميدانياً، يرسل بلاغات فورية، ويبث التغذية المرئية الحية. تربطه لوحة تحكم مركزية تعالج البيانات وتحللها لحظياً لضمان اتخاذ قرار فوري، سيادة أمنية مطلقة، وخفض التكاليف التشغيلية.

projects.title: GridAegis: Real-Time Threat Detection & Encrypted Communication for Smart Grids
projects.desc: GridAegis detects cyberattacks on smart-grid industrial control networks (IEC 104/MMS) in real time and secures the communication channel with AES-GCM encryption. It pairs a validated machine-learning detector with a human-in-the-loop review mechanism, reaching over 99% accuracy, 85,700+ packets/second throughput, and under 12 microseconds latency per packet — a practical, deployable defense layer for critical smart-grid infrastructure.

projects.title: Smart Irrigation Rover with Zone-Based Soil Monitoring and Leaf-Health Imaging
projects.desc: A low-cost mobile IoT rover (three wheels, wooden body) designed to measure soil moisture and temperature, send data over Wi-Fi, and switch a small water pump when the soil is dry, reducing water waste. Planned additions are GPS zone reporting, gas sensing, obstacle detection and camera-based leaf-color checks. The project is at prototype stage; test results will be reported after laboratory trials.

projects.title: Craftsman Licensing
projects.desc:
Designed a smart licensing integration concept connecting Balady workflows with smart city platforms to enhance municipal efficiency.
Key Contributions:
• Analyzed licensing workflows and identified operational bottlenecks
• Gathered stakeholder requirements and business needs
• Designed a seamless data integration framework
• Proposed automation features to streamline approval processes
• Conducted financial and risk analysis for scalability assessment
Impact:
Enabled a scalable licensing model

projects.title: Virtual Computer Lab is an immersive VR-based learning environment…
projects.desc: Virtual Computer Lab is an immersive VR-based learning environment that enables students to explore computer components, understand their functions, and practice PC assembly through interactive 3D simulations. It transforms traditional hardware education into a safe, engaging, repeatable, and scalable hands-on experience while reducing reliance on physical equipment and laboratory resources.

projects.title: TWENTY SCHOOL – An AI-Powered Adaptive Learning Platform for National and International Assessments
projects.desc: Twenty School is an AI-powered adaptive platform for national and international assessments. It diagnoses each student’s level, builds a personalized learning path, and provides interactive learning, adaptive practice, smart hints, and test simulations. AI supports teachers with weekly reports and intervention recommendations, while school leaders receive clear performance dashboards. The current prototype focuses on the Saudi Achievement Test.

projects.title: Enshedny is a mobile application developed to facilitate access for…
projects.desc:
Enshedny is a mobile application developed to facilitate access for people with special needs by providing real-time information on accessible facilities using GPS and mapping technologies. The app addresses the challenges that disabled individuals face in finding up-to-date information about accessible services, enhancing their independence and ability to navigate public spaces.
The project is currently operating in 4 countries and is not a prototype.
https://enshedny.com/

projects.title: Ayser Shuttle
projects.desc:
Ayser Shuttle: Where Desert Becomes Harvest.

The desert doesn't lack land. It lacks the right environment. That's where Ayser Shuttle comes in.

Five technologies. One system.
Patented smart partial shading · Automated irrigation with integrated reservoir · Fertigation · Wind-and-sand protection · Stable deep moisture.

The result:
Less water. Less heat. Stronger growth. Higher yields. On any land, in any climate.

Because the land deserves a chance. And you deserve a harvest.

Request a demo t

projects.title: تظهر ميزة صامد
projects.desc: تظهر ميزة صامد | SAMED عند وقوع الحروب أو الهجمات السيبرانية أو الانقطاعات الكبرى أو الكوارث، حين تصبح الموارد محدودة وتتأثر عدة قطاعات في وقت واحد. يعمل صامد كطبقة قرار ذكية فوق الأنظمة القائمة، فيربط الكهرباء والمياه والاتصالات والصحة والنقل والوقود، ويتنبأ بزمن فقد الخدمات الحيوية، ثم يحدد أقل تدخل وأفضل توزيع للموارد لإبقائها مستمرة لأطول مدة ممكنة، حتى مع ضعف الاتصال بالمركز.

projects.title: STEMpathy: Innovation for Humanity
projects.desc: STEMpathy منصة ذكية للابتكار الاجتماعي تنطلق من فلسفة أن الموهبة الحقيقية تبدأ من الإنسان. تقود المتعلم ليبدأ بالتعاطف مع احتياج إنساني حقيقي وفهم المستفيد والعيش مع تحديه، ثم يوظف معارف STEM وموهبته لتصميم حل معه، واختباره وتطويره وقياس أثره. ومن خلال دورة ابتكار منهجية وإرشاد بالذكاء الاصطناعي، تحوّل STEMpathy الموهبة من إنجاز فردي إلى قوة تصنع حلولًا قابلة للتطبيق والتوسع، ليصبح السؤال: ليس ماذا يستطيع الموهوب أن يصنع؟ وإنما لمن يستطيع أن يصنع فرقًا؟

projects.title: حارس الأفق
projects.desc:
Border areas and rugged mountain terrain are hard to monitor around the clock. Patrols cannot cover every path, and building new stand-alone surveillance towers in remote sites is costly: foundations, access roads, and grid power. Yet electricity transmission towers already stand in many of these areas, offering height and wide line-of-sight.

Aim: to propose mounting solar-powered thermal and night-vision cameras on existing towers, linked to a central monitoring center that guides field teams.

projects.title: FARUQ-SA
projects.desc:
«الفاروق» منظومة ذكية لرصد وتتبع المسيّرات بالاعتماد على اجهزة استشعار نوعية، وأبراج الاتصال الحالية دون تأثير على أداء شبكات الاتصالات وتجربة المستخدمين.
مما يمكّن «الفاروق» من قابلة التوسع لحماية أمن ومقدرات هذا الوطن العظيم دون الحاجة إلى استثمار مبدئي كبير.

projects.title: بوصلة سعودية
projects.desc: بوصلة سعودية منصة رقمية ذكية تُبرز التراث السعودي الأصيل وتوظف الذكاء الاصطناعي وقاعدة بيانات تكاملية من الجهات المختصة لتقديم توصيات ومسارات مخصصة ومجدولة زمنيًا للزائر والمواطن وفق هدفه واهتماماته وموقعه ومدة زيارته.تستجيب لتحدي كثرة الخيارات وتنوع الوجهات وصعوبة ترتيبها وتربط المستخدم بالوجهات والفعاليات والتجارب والمنتجات التراثية وتُتاح عبر تطبيق وشاشات ذكية في المطارات والمترو والمراكز التجارية لتسهيل اكتشاف المملكة ودعم الحرفيين والمنتجين وتعزيز أثره ثقافيًا وسياحيًا واقتصاديًا.

projects.title: GHAWTH: Robotic Well-Rescue Platform
projects.desc: GHAWTH, powered by DeepRescue AI, is a remotely operated robotic prototype designed to support assessment of narrow wells before rescuers enter. It combines live video, preliminary non-contact vital-sign indicators, and AI-assisted posture analysis to support rescue planning. Robotic rope threading is under development and requires further testing. Future work includes 3D mapping of the well to estimate dimensions and identify obstacles, improved stabilization and arm performance, and gas sensin

projects.title: When a license plate can hide a vehicle’s true identity…
projects.desc: When a license plate can hide a vehicle’s true identity, verification must go beyond what the camera sees. Our project combines camera-based recognition with RFID technology to detect stolen vehicles, swapped or hidden plates, and identity mismatches. The system enables fast, automated screening at selected checkpoints while securely linking each vehicle to its verified digital record.

projects.title: "سكون" منصة تفاعلية سياحية اجتماعية تُبرز المباني العامة والمعالم…
projects.desc:
"سكون" منصة تفاعلية سياحية اجتماعية تُبرز المباني العامة والمعالم المهمة معماريًا، ثقافياً واجتماعياً ، عبر توثيق بصري إبداعي يروي قصة كل مكان وتاريخه ودلالاته التصميمية. تعتمد المنصة على واجهة مستخدم تفاعلية سهلة الاستخدام، تتيح تصفح المعالم حسب التصنيف والموقع، وتقييمها ومشاركة التجارب الفعلية، لتحقيق أقصى استفادة اجتماعية ممكنة. تُنتج بذلك دليلاً ثقافيًا وسياحيًا موثوقًا يجمع بين الهوية العمرانية السعودية وصدق تجربة الزوار والمقيمين
تحت شعار "لإبداع أكثر حياكم في السعودية"

projects.title: منهجية التفكير ثلاثي الأبعاد : نظام تشغيل عقلي
projects.desc: منهجية التفكير ثلاثي الأبعاد  هى منهجية عربيه للتفكير  التطبيقيى المكمل لـ STEM، تحول التمكين المعرفي في البيئة المثالية إلى نظام تشغيل عقلي يمكّن المتعلم من التعامل مع التغير والابتكار. تبدأ بكسر النمط والفشل الذكي، ثم تدير دورة متكررة من الاستكشاف والتحليل النقدي لاكتشاف السبب الجذري، وتوليد البدائل إبداعيًا، واختبار الحلول علميًا وقياس أثرها. وتنسجم مع مبادئ التعلم واللدونة العصبية، وتوثق المشكلة والفشل والحل والنتائج في نموذج إنجاز، لإنتاج ابتكار قابل للتطبيق والقياس والإثبات.

projects.title: RedSea BioMP is a nature-based biotechnology platform using…
projects.desc: RedSea BioMP is a nature-based biotechnology platform using indigenous Red Sea microorganisms and enzymes for controlled microplastic biodegradation. Based on research along Jeddah’s coast, it has 22 bacterial isolates, eight fungal isolates, and five diatom forms. Degradation will be tested in controlled settings and verified by gravimetry, FTIR, SEM/EDX and GC-MS. The project also aims to formulate a microbial enzyme cocktail for eco-friendly detergent production.

projects.title: ReadyOps
projects.desc: ReadyOps is an AI-powered early-warning and decision-support platform for critical security projects and programs. It transforms fragmented project data into actionable insights, linking risks and dependencies to operational readiness. With explainable forecasts, traceable evidence, and corrective-action comparison, ReadyOps helps leaders anticipate delays, understand root causes, and make faster, informed decisions to keep essential capabilities on track and ready when needed.

projects.title: Hybrid Post-Quantum TLS 1.3 with PQAT for Tactical Communication Systems
projects.desc: Quantum computing represents a new computational paradigm with the potential to accelerate selected problem classes beyond modern classical systems. Rapid development threatens the public-key infrastructure on which tactical communications depend: RSA, ECDSA, and ECDH are vulnerable to Shor’s algorithm. To address this threat and harvest-now-decrypt-later risks, this work combines NIST-standardized ML-KEM and ML-DSA in hybrid TLS 1.3 and introduces PQAT for explicit post-handshake assurance.

projects.title: SAIF-SAT— National Smart Navigation Shield
projects.desc: SAIF SAT is an AI-powered early-warning system designed to protect the Kingdom’s skies and critical infrastructure from GNSS jamming and spoofing. Low-cost, receive-only ground stations monitor GPS, Galileo, BeiDou and GLONASS, using cross-constellation evidence to identify suspicious interference, estimate its source and alert authorities. Threat data remains in the Kingdom, while the same AI architecture can be deployed aboard SAIF SAT-1, a Saudi CubeSat for scalable national monitoring.

projects.title: بناء نموذج أولي مادي انسيابي لهيكل طائرة مسيّرة، تم أجراء  اختبارات…
projects.desc: بناء نموذج أولي مادي انسيابي لهيكل طائرة مسيّرة، تم أجراء  اختبارات أولية للحركة والاتزان. ونموذج محاكاة لمعالجة عدم اليقين بشأن وجود إنسان خلف النباتات، يهدف المشروع إلى مساعدة فرق البحث في العثور على أشخاص تخفيهم النباتات . تلتقط الطائرة صورًا عادية وحرارية للمكان من عدة زوايا، ثم يقارن النظام بينها للبحث عن حرارة قد تدل على وجود شخص، مع مراعاة أن الأوراق أو الأرض قد تكون ساخنة أيضًا. إذا كانت الصور غير واضحة، تظهر النتيجة «غير مؤكد» بدل اعتبار المكان خاليًا. صُنع نموذج أولي للطائرة .

projects.title: MASARI
projects.desc: MASARI is a pre-launch mobile-first digital health platform transforming outpatient flow and safe mobility across Saudi healthcare facilities. Featuring three pathways: Green (routine), Gold (elderly+60/fall-prone), and Red (early warning), it combines Nafath verification with predictive fall analytics, for example, to tackle Jeddah’s 47.4% fall rate. Its 24-month strategy targets all hospitals and PHC, Lean’s Heem API, and military healthcare, fully aligned with Vision 2030 and PDPL regulations

projects.title: Smart Energy Pyramid Rooms
projects.desc: الغرف الذكية للطاقة ابتكار هندسي يجمع بين العمارة المستدامة وإنتاج الطاقة الشمسية في تصميم هرمي متعدد الأوجه، يتيح توزيع الألواح الشمسية بزوايا تشغيل قابلة للتعديل، مع الاستفادة من التهوية الطبيعية وإدارة الطاقة الذكية. يهدف الابتكار إلى تطوير وحدات معمارية قابلة للتوسع، تسهم في تحسين الاستفادة من الطاقة المتجددة وتقليل الاعتماد على الشبكة الكهربائية، مع إمكانية استخدامها في المزارع والمرافق السياحية والمباني المستدامة

projects.title: NATOOR SKY
projects.desc: From detecting aerial objects to understanding their movement in real time — NATOOR SKY combines physical sensors, AI-powered computer vision, and sensor fusion to detect and track aerial objects through a unified dashboard. Inspired by advanced monitoring principles such as Captor-E, it presents a low-cost prototype for multi-source monitoring, with future potential for advanced sensors and detection technologies. The current prototype focuses on detection, tracking, and alerts.

projects.title: UNIFORD CITY | مدينة يوني فورد التعليمية التطبيقية
projects.desc: UNIFORD CITY نظام تعليمي تطبيقي يحوّل المدرسة إلى مدينة مصغرة يتعلم فيها الطلاب من 6–18 عامًا عبر الممارسة بدل التلقين. ينتقل الطالب بين أحياء تعليمية مترابطة، ويتخذ قرارات واقعية مصغرة، ويؤسس مشاريع، ويدير موارد ومعاملات، ويستخدم التقنية والذكاء الاصطناعي لحل تحديات حقيقية. ويحوّل النظام هذه التجارب إلى ملف قدرات يقيس تطور المهارات والأداء، ضمن نموذج قابل للتطبيق والترخيص والتوسع بين المدارس.

projects.title: SHALFA - An Autonomous Unmanned Vessel for Target Detection and Tracking using Computer Vision
projects.desc: SHALFA هو قارب بحري ذكي غير مأهول متعدد المهام، تم تطويره لدمج تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي والرؤية الحاسوبية والتحكم عن بُعد في منصة بحرية واحدة. يتيح النظام المراقبة والتعرف على الأهداف وتتبعها آليًا، مع أنظمة تحكم وتشغيل متعددة وسيناريوهات محاكاة دفاعية آمنة. يمثل المشروع نموذجًا أوليًا لتوظيف الذكاء الاصطناعي والروبوتات في التطبيقات البحرية، بما يعزز القدرات التقنية المحلية ويدعم تطوير حلول بحرية ذكية قابلة للتوسع.

projects.title: ابتكار متكامل لتحليل الأنسجة يبدأ بالتعرّف الجزيئي النوعي باستخدام…
projects.desc: ابتكار متكامل لتحليل الأنسجة يبدأ بالتعرّف الجزيئي النوعي باستخدام مجسات VHH النانوية، ثم التقاط الإشارات داخل النسيج مكانيًا، وتحويلها إلى تمثيل ثلاثي الأبعاد، وتحليلها بالذكاء الاصطناعي لإنتاج خريطة جزيئية-مكانية توضح حالة النسيج وتوزيع المناطق المتضررة أو النخرية أو المرتبطة بالأورام. يجمع الابتكار بين الكيمياء الحيوية، والتصوير، وهندسة الأجهزة، والذكاء الاصطناعي والتحليل الكمي ضمن مسار واحد قابل للتطوير حسب نوع النسيج.

projects.title: Execra — Sovereign Governed Execution Engine for Autonomous Agents
projects.desc: Execra is a sovereign engine that moves AI agents from explaining procedures to executing them. It understands requests in Arabic (MSA and dialects), turns them into deterministic plans grounded in their legal references, and executes them through existing system APIs with pre-call authorization and mandatory human approval for irreversible actions, logging every step in an immutable audit trail. It runs in-Kingdom with no external calls, under PDPL-derived controls. Patent pending (SAIP).

projects.title: Sayen
projects.desc: Sayen is an intelligent platform that redistributes unused medications among government healthcare facilities instead of disposing of them, reducing waste and costs. It matches available medications to other facilities' needs based on demand, quantity, medical priority and time to expiry, while ensuring quality and fitness for use. Sayen supports sustainable medication management and the Kingdom's vision for a more efficient healthcare sector.

projects.title: Autonomous Drone Swarm for Thermal Suppression, Containment, and Debris Deceleration During Descent
projects.desc: This innovation introduces an autonomous post interception response layer using a coordinated drone swarm. The system detects and tracks falling debris, predicts its trajectory, performs in flight thermal suppression, then deploys a cooperative energy absorbing net to contain and decelerate debris before ground impact. It integrates detection, prediction, suppression, containment, and risk data sharing in one coordinated architecture.

projects.title: لُجّة | LUJJAH
projects.desc: LUJJAH is a modular intelligent tactical iROV designed to reduce direct human exposure during underwater reconnaissance and mine-threat screening. Its physically validated Pixhawk–Raspberry Pi platform provides stable depth control, live video, and telemetry, while a simulation-validated AI detector achieved 97% test accuracy, 100% recall on held-out synthetic mine families, and 97.2% hard-negative specificity—supporting safer, scalable coastal-security operations.

projects.title: Rehabix
projects.desc: Rehabix continues rehabilitation after hospital discharge. A phone or laptop camera tracks the patient's joints on-device, measures joint angles, counts repetitions and gives instant form feedback, and no video ever leaves the device. A red-flag safety screen runs before every session, and pain spikes alert the doctor's dashboard, so clinicians keep sight of home recovery, including medical-tourism patients who return home. Live at rehabix.vercel.app

projects.title: SeaPrint
projects.desc: SeaPrint is an AI-powered maritime surveillance system that detects vessel-related disturbances on the sea surface, even when the vessel itself is not clearly visible. It combines camera video with Digital Twin and sea-state data to separate natural wave motion from suspicious localized disturbances, then estimates direction, path, and confidence. SeaPrint can complement radar and AIS to strengthen monitoring of ports, coastlines, and sensitive waters.

projects.title: درع تكتيكي من اكسيد البزموث والمركبات النانوية للحماية من المقاذيف والإشعاعات الضارة
projects.desc: درع تكتيكي ذكي متعدد الحماية، يجمع بين الحماية من المقذوفات والطلقات الحية والحماية من الإشعاعات الضارة الناتجة عن القنابل الحديثة باستخدام مركبات نانوية من اكسيد البزموث، ومدمج بمنظمة حساسات استشعارية لمراقبة المؤشرات الحيوية وموقع الفرد IMU لاكتشاف السقوط/التسارع. يوظف الذكاء الاصطناعي لتحليل البيانات واكتشاف الحالات الخطرة وإرسال تنبيهات فورية لغرفة العمليات، بما يعزز سلامة الفرد ويسرّع الاستجابة واتخاذ القرار.

projects.title: Equiva is a voice-first AI platform that recognises hidden skills…
projects.desc: Equiva is a voice-first AI platform that recognises hidden skills and flags possible learning needs. Learners speak about their experience in their own language; AI maps it to recognised competencies and screens for signs of special educational needs and disabilities (SEND), triaging who needs support or specialist referral. A qualified human assessor approves every output; Equiva never diagnoses. Offline-first and in design and prototyping, it is planned for the UK, Ghana and Cameroon.

projects.title: Too Face
projects.desc: بعد نجاح الاختراق على جهاز يعمل: الرصد يُنبّه، وتشفير القرص لا يحمي الجلسة المفتوحة، فتخرج البيانات وهي مقروءة. هذه فجوة متبقية لا تسدّها منصات السوق كطبقة عاقبة. تو فيس طبقة دفاعية مستقلة على نهاية النقطة: طعوم من خصائص الملفات المحلية، تشفير يُفقد المسروقات جدواها، واحتواء محصور بالجهاز مع أدلة تحقيق محلية — دون سحابة ودون إحلال للمنظومة القائمة. التزام دفاعي دون هجوم مضاد. منتج جاهز للتجربة.

projects.title: Smart Waterless Air-Jet Cleaning for Solar-Powered Traffic and Security Systems
projects.desc: A smart, waterless and contact-free cleaning system for photovoltaic panels powering roadside security and traffic-monitoring equipment. The system uses pulsed high-velocity air jets, optional transparent anti-soiling coating, and environmental sensing to remove desert dust only when needed. It reduces water use and manual maintenance while improving solar-energy reliability for distributed field infrastructure, including potential Saher applications.

projects.title: Erada OS is a smart B2B SaaS platform built from real operational…
projects.desc: Erada OS is a smart B2B SaaS platform built from real operational experience at Child Willing Specialist Rehabilitation Center in Bahrain. It digitalizes rehabilitation and special-needs services by integrating assessments, individualized plans, therapy, attendance, billing, staff, transportation safety, parent communication, and quality reporting in one system. Designed to improve efficiency, safety, accountability, and data-driven decisions, it is scalable across Bahrain, the GCC, and beyond.

projects.title: NetShell: A Grounded AI Terminal for Secure Network Operations
projects.desc: NetShell is a native desktop SSH terminal with an AI agent inside the live session. It works from the real device, runs read-only checks and answers from evidence, not memory: every claim is tied to a command it ran, and it says "not checked" when unsure. Changes are staged, run only on an explicit click, and verified by reading the device back. Each session shows what was checked, why, and what it means, so new engineers learn the process, not just the answer. Local-first, with your own AI key.

projects.title: Fake base stations, sold openly as "StingRays
projects.desc: Fake base stations, sold openly as "StingRays" — impersonate real towers to silently harvest the 15-digit IMSI that permanently identifies every phone. Because GSM and early LTE never authenticate the network in return, and because every existing detector inspects individual base-station parameters that a patient adversary can simply clone, current defences are evadable. We propose CellPrint as a fingerprints that aggregate and structural signature of an entire location area for protection.

projects.title: DILSA
projects.desc:
Running a home means keeping track of countless little things. Repairs need arranging, supplies need restocking, and plans need coordinating. Each task may seem simple, but managing them all takes time and effort.
DILSA helps bring it all together. It understands what’s going on, proposes solutions, and coordinates with your family and service providers. Its connected systems combine AI and personal memory to support your plans, expenses, and household assets, and keep the right people informed

projects.title: Q-ZFlow: Quantum-Ready Plasma Twin for Predictive Fusion Stability
projects.desc:
The AI surrogate predicts future electrostatic potential.
Vorticity and zonal-flow shear are then derived and compared
against the reference solver. Validation uses relative L2
error, correlation, and runtime benchmarking. Q-ZFlow is a quantum-ready plasma simulation model combining Hasegawa–Mima physics, numerical solvers, and physics-informed AI to predict vortices, turbulence, and zonal flows in fusion plasmas. It compares classical and quantum approaches, validates predictions.

projects.title: FlexSight – Smart Thermal Safety & Early Warning System
projects.desc: FlexSight is an IoT-based early-warning system designed to detect overheating and protect critical infrastructure. Our team aims to adapt it for maritime vessels, where abnormal temperatures threaten equipment and safety. Through continuous monitoring, automated alerts, and a centralized dashboard, FlexSight helps crews detect risks and respond faster. Designed to complement existing maritime systems, it aims to reduce operational risks, prevent equipment damage, and enhance maritime safety

projects.title: SANAMAN is a consent-led AI beauty platform
projects.desc: SANAMAN is a consent-led AI beauty platform. From one consented photo, it proposes explainable makeup, hair and skincare looks; the customer approves her look before booking, at an all-in SAR price. The approved look becomes a Beauty Blueprint: a step-by-step plan the matched professional unlocks only after accepting. Salons and suppliers share one governed record with minimum data per role. AI proposes. The customer approves. The professional delivers.

projects.title: Sabeel: Operational Intelligence for Municipal Maintenance
projects.desc: Sabeel is a municipal maintenance platform that connects field evidence, engineer review, maps and reports in one traceable record. Its working road inspection module uses AI to identify visible defects and record their locations. Engineers can review findings, correct errors and add missed defects. The platform generates Arabic reports, with planned extensions for manual evidence, test results and project progress, followed by predictive maintenance and maintenance planning.

projects.title: Impact Reducer for Drainage Stacks in High Rise Buildings
projects.desc: The submitted invention is an Impact Reducer for Drainage Stacks in high-rise building drainage systems. Installed at the vertical-to-horizontal transition, it creates a smooth zig-zag flow path that reduces the momentum and energy of falling wastewater, minimizing impact and hydraulic turbulence. An innovative bypass vent prevents negative pressure, while a cleanout enables maintenance. The fitting can be manufactured by injection-molding method using any approved suitable plastic material.

projects.title: تركيبة حبر نانونية للطباعة الليزرية | Nanostructured Ink Composition for Laser Printing
projects.desc:
اختراع سعودي حاصل على براءة اختراع، يتمثل في تطوير تركيبة حبر نانوي للطابعات الليزرية، تجمع بين مكونين أساسيين ونوعين من البوليمرات المتخصصة. 

تتمثل أبرز مزايا الابتكار في إطالة عمر الحبر وزيادة الاستفادة منه، للمساهمة في تقليل الاستهلاك والهدر، واستغلال الطاقة الطباعية القصوى، مع دعم جودة الطباعة واستقرارها.

وتتيح التركيبة حلاً قابلًا للتطبيق على الطابعات الليزرية القائمة، بما يعزز التوفير وكفاءة الإنفاق والاستدامة في المؤسسات والجهات الحكومية وبيئات الطباعة ذات الاستخدام المرتفع.

projects.title: Cabin Notifier — Smart & Inclusive Aircraft Cabin Notification System
projects.desc: Cabin Notifier is an inclusive smart aviation system that delivers cabin announcements and safety alerts to passengers’ smartphones and smartwatches, including Deaf and hard-of-hearing travelers. Passengers can also report emergencies and hazards to the crew or request service. With passenger consent, it can share heart-rate data and alert cabin crew to abnormal readings. Designed to work without Internet access, it proposes a new Saudi-led standard for accessible and inclusive air travel.

projects.title: Selective Metallodrugs for Targeted Cancer Therapy
projects.desc: Patented (US 10,774,095 B2), this technology provides a low-cost method for synthesizing selective metal–ascorbic acid (vitamin C) complexes using copper, gold, or silver. Unlike traditional chemotherapy agents like cisplatin that cause severe toxicity to healthy tissue, these water-soluble metallodrugs act as targeted cancer-cell inhibitors and eradicators. In vitro studies show significant concentration-dependent viability loss in human liver and prostate cancer cells.

projects.title: HajjGuard AI
projects.desc: An intelligent AI-powered decision-support system designed to help keep Hajj and other mass gatherings safe and operational during infectious disease threats. By integrating origin risk intelligence, pilgrim quota optimization, wearable-based early warning, crowd cluster detection, and outbreak simulation, HajjGuard AI transforms complex health and crowd data into timely, explainable recommendations. The system enables authorities to anticipate risks and manage pilgrim capacity.

projects.title: TIBAQ: An Execution Trust Layer for AI Agents
projects.desc: TIBAQ is an execution trust layer for AI agents. Before an agent executes a sensitive action in finance, government, healthcare or supply chains, TIBAQ verifies it against the agent's delegated authority, organizational policies (Arabic-first), records and context, then allows, denies, or escalates to a human. Approved actions carry a signed stamp the target system verifies, so even a deceived agent cannot exceed its mandate. Works with any AI vendor, on-premises, aligned with NCA and SDAIA.

projects.title: ALD AZO based transparent Thin Film Transistor and Circuits
projects.desc:
The innovation utilizes high-precision, low-temperature Atomic Layer Deposition at temperatures to fabricate fully transparent electronic components from single, abundant, non-toxic materials. The device architecture integrates AZO transparent electrodes, a nanolaminated high gate dielectric, and a multilayer semiconducting channel using super-cycle ALD engineering.
This technology employed in solar cell manufacturing to reduce energy consumption and develop transparent electronic devices.

projects.title: المنظومة الدفاعية للاستجابة التكتيكية المتكيفة
projects.desc: من ابتكارين حازا تقديرًا رسميًا إلى منظومة دفاعية واحدة: يجمع المشروع تقنيتين محميتين ببراءات اختراع؛ الأولى حازت أفضل ابتكار عسكري من الهيئة العامة للصناعات العسكرية، والثانية المركز الثاني ضمن تصنيف وزارة الصناعة. يعمل دون كاميرات، ويميّز الأطفال والقوات الصديقة فلا يستهدفهم، وينفجر عند اقتراب القوات المعادية دون حاجة للمس. ويبقى خاملاً حتى وقوع انفجار مجاور، ثم ينشط لاستهداف تجمع القوات المعادية، مضيفًا عنصر المفاجأة والحسم الميداني، مع تعطيل ذاتي عند نهاية عمره التشغيلي.

projects.title: Satellite Tracking and Orbit Visualization
projects.desc: This project is an interactive satellite-tracking system that visualizes the real-time distribution and orbital paths of satellites around Earth. It provides detailed orbital data, including orbital period, inclination, apogee, perigee, launch date, and satellite identification, enabling accurate observation and analysis of satellite movement and orbital characteristics through an interactive geographical interface.

projects.title: Homolock
projects.desc: HomoLock is an innovative security system designed to protect cloud data during processing and storage. It uses Homomorphic Encryption algorithms to enable mathematical and analytical operations on fully encrypted data without the need to decrypt it within the cloud environment. This approach enhances data confidentiality and privacy while reducing the risks of data leakage and unauthorized access.

projects.title: Self-Propelled Palm Service Vehicle with Axial Alignment
projects.desc: The invention relates to a self-propelled palm service vehicle adapted for unpaved orchard environments. The vehicle comprises a robust undercarriage frame (100), a four-wheel-drive (4WD) drivetrain system (110), and a diesel engine (120) equipped with enhanced cooling that drives a hydraulic pump (140). A hydraulic scissor lift (160) elevates an upper work platform (200) provided with a forward-facing, upper U-shaped circumvention opening (210) axially aligned with a lower U-shaped circumventio

projects.title: MoFin is a social innovation app transforming how communities…
projects.desc: MoFin is a social innovation app transforming how communities handle informal credit. By digitizing the traditional "merchant notebook" into a collaborative, offline-first smart ledger, MoFin eliminates financial disputes and preserves relationships. It empowers local traders and customers with transparent, real-time shared links and immutable records. MoFin enhances quality of life by removing debt anxiety, fostering financial inclusion, and building trust in neighborhood economies.

projects.title: AegisMesh | A Distributed Agentic Platform for Unified Cybersecurity Operations
projects.desc: AegisMesh is a distributed agentic cybersecurity platform that unifies fragmented security tools through ARCP, an open protocol for agent registration, discovery, communication, and control. MindAI interprets analyst requests, selects capable agents, orchestrates multi-step workflows, and correlates results. A unified desktop application provides centralized control, semantic agent discovery, natural-language task execution, real-time alerts, and intelligent alert enrichment.

projects.title: An off-grid security and safety device that enables group…
projects.desc: An off-grid security and safety device that enables group communication, location tracking, and situational awareness without relying on Wi-Fi, cellular coverage, or satellite communication. Designed for tactical missions and operations in remote areas beyond urban infrastructure. The Hardware is based on open source hardware and the software made entirely is the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia without dependency on any outside resources

projects.title: Agriculture depends on human labor, much of it spent building farm…
projects.desc: Agriculture depends on human labor, much of it spent building farm infrastructure before anything grows. Dandelion aims to change this, starting in arid, remote regions, where long on-site work is hard to sustain and conditions are uncertain. We propose modular infrastructure designed for automated installation, checking and recovery. Human-assisted remote operation comes first; each task is automated once proven. Vision: farm capacity built, expanded and recovered with little on-site labor.

projects.title: EDE is a locally built malware analysis platform that runs fully…
projects.desc: EDE is a locally built malware analysis platform that runs fully on-premises: no file leaves the organisation.
